title: Staff Engineer - Machine Learning
description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.



Job Description

About This Role — The Mission

You will be one of the engineers on a focused AI team solving hard scientific problems in precision product development. You will own two real responsibilities from day one — not toy tasks, but actual team workflow contributions that senior engineers depend on. You will be introduced to physics-informed AI, Bayesian methods, and product development ML systems within your first year under direct mentorship from engineers and researchers who have worked at world-class institutions. If you are the kind of person who learns fast and wants to be in the middle of hard problems early in your career, this is an unusual opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Experiment Tracking & Evaluation Reporting: Own MLflow experiment logging for assigned team model runs; conduct model evaluations using standard metrics; produce structured evaluation reports reviewed by team. Your reports directly inform model iteration decisions.
  • Training Data Quality Validation: Validate training datasets jointly with team — feature distribution checks, label verification, anomaly flagging. Your quality flags are the final check before data enters the model training pipeline. You close the data quality loop between workstreams.
  • Deep Learning Model Contribution: Build and train CNN-based models for image classification and defect detection under team’s guidance. Contribute to model evaluation cycles, configuration comparisons, and training run analysis.
  • ML Pipeline Contribution: Package models in Docker; contribute to CI/CD scripts under guidance; run inference tests and support deployment validation in product development environments.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. AI major or strong research focus in degree strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • Fresh graduate to 1 year. Work experience not required — demonstrated ML project competency is the primary criterion. Strong final-year project or thesis with a clear ML component; research internship preferred.

Must Have Skill:

  • Python: Strong proficiency — clean, readable ML code; NumPy/Pandas basics
  • PyTorch: Foundational — build, train, and evaluate a basic neural network independently from scratch
  • CNN Architecture Basics: Understand and implement a basic image classifier; conceptual understanding of convolutional layers
  • Surrogate Modeling Concepts: Why data-efficient ML matters in limited-data scientific settings
  • Active Learning Awareness: Conceptual understanding of uncertainty-guided data selection
  • MLflow Basics: Log experiments, parameters, and metrics for a training run
  • Docker Basics: Write a Dockerfile to containerize a Python/ML application
  • Model Evaluation: Standard metrics; produce a structured evaluation report
  • Learning Mindset: Self-directed learning outside coursework; evidence of picking up new concepts quickly.

Good-to-Have Skill:

  • U-Net or ViT exposure — academic project or course sufficient
  • Uncertainty quantification basics — Monte Carlo dropout, ensemble methods
  • Bayesian methods introduction — any probabilistic ML course or project
  • Time-series or sensor data — any project with sequential or temporal data
  • RL introduction — any RL course or gym environment experiment
  • RAG basics, any LLM project
  • AWS fundamentals; entry-level cloud ML deployment

Additional Information



WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

WD is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
Company: ST Engineering Aerospace Ltd

Location: 540 Airport Road


Job Description

You will help to design and develop Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) systems and algorithms for our drone systems and be part of a tight-knit team that provides safe, reliable drone systems and quality services to our distinguished customers in Singapore and around the region.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop and modify guidance, navigation, and flight control systems and algorithms for our unmanned aircraft systems.
  • Develop and modify 6-DOF and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation environments.
  • Select, test, evaluate and integrate new sensors or navigation systems onto our drone systems.
  • Write, modify, and test firmware and flight code that runs on the flight control computers of our drone systems (in C or C++).
  • Analyze flight data to verify flight performance and to help to troubleshoot issues that are found during the flights of our drone systems.
  • Generate documentation on the specifications, design, test procedures and test results of the GNC systems and algorithms that were developed.
  • Participate in design and code reviews.
  • Support ground and flight test activities.
  • Work in a collaborative manner with staff in other engineering (e.g. system, software, safety, flight test, etc.) and business groups.


Requirements

  • Good to have 1-3 years of industry or other relevant experience in GNC.
  • Strong background in system modelling, system identification, parameter estimation, frequency response analysis, classical and modern control theory.
  • Experience in system modelling and control, analysis, and simulation in aircraft applications.
  • Experience in developing model-based design and analyse using MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Knowledge in inertial and other type of sensors for navigation (e.g. accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, GNSS receivers, pressure sensors, ranging sensors, etc.).
  • Knowledge in Kalman filtering, digital signal processing and sensor data fusion.
  • Proficient in C/C++ programming language.
  • Proficient in software and development tools such as Linux, ROS and Git.
  • No work experience required.


ST Engineering is a global technology, defence and engineering group with a diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence and public security segments. The Group harnesses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems, enabling a more secure and sustainable world. Headquartered in Singapore, it has operations spanning Asia, Europe, the Middle East and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. ST Engineering reported a revenue of over $11 billion in 2024 and ranks among the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange. It is a component stock of MSCI Singapore, FTSE Straits Times Index and Dow Jones Sustainability Asia Pacific Index.


About Commercial Aerospace business

ST Engineering’s Commercial Aerospace business is a world-class Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) service provider with proven solutions for practically every stage of an aircraft life cycle. With 50 years of reputable track record in aviation, backed by a highly experienced team of engineers and technicians across facilities in Asia Pacific, the U.S. and Europe, we know what it takes to keep the world flying safely.

title: Sanitation Associate (1st shift)
description:
Schedule: 1st shift Mon-Fri 6:30am-3pm
Base Hourly Wage or Compensation Range: $16.02 - 18.02 per hour
Position Overview

The Sanitation Associate is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and organized work environment throughout the warehouse and surrounding areas. This role includes performing scheduled sanitation duties, operating cleaning equipment, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and sanitation standards. The Sanitation Associate plays a vital role in supporting workplace safety and operational efficiency in a high-volume logistics center.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities

Sanitation & Janitorial Services

Follow established sanitation and cleaning schedules for the logistics center.

Sweep, mop, dust, and clean designated warehouse and office areas.

Remove trash, recyclables, and debris in compliance with facility standards.

Maintain restrooms, breakrooms, and other employee common areas.

Equipment & Supply Management

Safely operate sanitation and maintenance equipment (e.g., floor scrubbers, trash compactors).

Monitor and replenish sanitation supplies and materials as needed.

Inspect cleaning tools and equipment for safe operation and report issues promptly.

Safety & Compliance

Comply with company safety and sanitation standards, including OSHA and customer requirements.

Properly handle cleaning chemicals and follow Hazard Communication (HazCom) standards.

Support audits and inspections by ensuring sanitation areas meet compliance expectations.

General Maintenance Support

Assist with light facility maintenance tasks as directed.

Report damages, spills, or unsafe conditions to management immediately.

Support warehouse operations through additional cleaning or maintenance duties during peak periods.

Perform other related job duties as assigned or required.

Required Qualifications

High school diploma or GED Equivalent – or equivalent relevant experience.

Basic math and reading skills.

Comfort working at elevations up to 25 feet, when required.

Ability to follow oral and written instructions.

Experience using basic tools and equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in sanitation, janitorial, or warehouse environments.

Familiarity with warehouse operations in a 3PL or distribution environment.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the physical ability to:

Stand and/or walk for extended periods (up to 10 hours, depending on shift)

Sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl as needed

Climb stairs, ladders, and/or scaffolds at various heights including ground-level and racking zones frequently

Reach with hands and arms overhead and below waist level

Lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds

Occasionally lift heavier items with or without assistance

Use fine motor skills/manual dexterity to operate equipment, tools, or keyboards

Frequently use hands and fingers to handle, grasp, or control objects

See clearly at close range and at distance, with peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Hear and understand verbal instructions, alarms, and equipment signals in a noisy environment

Work Environment

This position operates in a warehouse and distribution center environment. The employee is frequently exposed to:

Varying temperatures, including but not limited to refrigerated or non-climate-controlled areas

Loud noise levels, such as machinery, forklifts, and conveyor systems

Dust, odors, and airborne particles

Concrete flooring and moving mechanical equipment

Frequent exposure to powered industrial vehicles and warehouse traffic

The employee is required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as steel-toed shoes, safety glasses, and high-visibility vests.

Location/Remote Eligibility

This role may be performed on-site only.

Schedule

Work hours may vary by shift assignment and may include evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Linux Kernel
description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
We are a systems software team building the foundational software for large-scale GPU computing cluster. We work at the hardware/software boundary across the Linux kernel, accelerators, storage, firmware, and platform validation. We value rigorous engineering, clear interfaces, measurable performance and reliability, and upstream collaboration where appropriate. The team partners closely with hardware, architecture, product, validation, and production engineering groups to move new capabilities from design through dependable deployment.

About the Role
You will own substantial Linux kernel features and production issues from design through validation and deployment. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes and reviews low-level code, diagnoses failures across hardware and software boundaries, and delivers measurable improvements in reliability, performance, security, and maintainability. You will influence designs and help other engineers succeed, while remaining directly accountable for implementation and results.

Responsibilities
- Backport, design, implement, optimize, and maintain Linux kernel components and associated user-space interfaces for production compute platforms.
- Own complex features through requirements, design review, coding, integration, validation, rollout, and post-deployment support.
- Debug kernel crashes, hangs, race conditions, memory corruption, boot failures, performance regressions, and hardware/software interaction defects from the production environment in real cases.
- Analyze traces, logs, crash dumps, performance counters, and workload behavior to identify root causes and verify corrective action.
- Improve observability and diagnostic tooling for field issues, and develop automated unit, integration, stress, fault-injection, and regression tests;
- Partner with silicon, firmware, security, validation, platform, and production teams to enable new hardware and resolve cross-layer defects.
- Contribute patches and technical discussions upstream when upstream adoption is the appropriate long-term path; maintain downstream changes responsibly when it is not.
- Review designs and code, document operational constraints, and share practical kernel-debugging knowledge with the team and partner team.

Qualifications
Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
- Deep understanding of operating-system fundamentals, including concurrency, memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, and device I/O.
- 3+ years of professional experience developing systems software in C, with working knowledge of C++ and scripting languages used for automation and diagnostics.
- Hands-on Linux kernel development or debugging experience in one or more areas such as device drivers, platform enablement, virtualization, networking, security, power management, or core kernel infrastructure.
- Demonstrated ownership of production-quality software, including testing, code review, incident diagnosis, and sustained maintenance.
- Clear written and verbal communication across hardware and software disciplines.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience contributing to the upstream Linux kernel or another substantial open-source systems project.
- Familiarity with kernel tracing and debugging tools such as ftrace, perf, eBPF, crash, kdump, lockdep, KASAN, or equivalent facilities.
- Experience enabling new silicon or server platforms, including firmware interfaces, PCIe devices, interrupt routing, IOMMU, or power and thermal behavior.
- Evidence of improving a production system’s availability, latency, throughput, security, or recovery time through hands-on engineering.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to turn complex data into actionable business insights. Working closely with business stakeholders and data engineering teams, you will lead analytical projects, uncover trends and opportunities, and develop impactful dashboards and visualisations to support data-driven decision-making.

This role is ideal for someone with strong SQL and data visualisation skills, sound business acumen, and the ability to translate complex findings into compelling data stories that drive business outcomes.

  • Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, business opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.
  • Design, develop, and enhance dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView.
  • Define and maintain consistent business metrics, analytical logic, and reporting standards.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to define data requirements, support data pipeline development, and validate data quality.
  • Independently deliver analytics projects that support strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Ensure analytics solutions comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and data governance standards.
  • Proactively identify risks, stay updated on industry developments, and promote best practices in risk management and compliance.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 5 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related projects.
  • Strong SQL programming skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • At least 5 years of experience with data visualisation tools, such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and communicate findings effectively.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills, with the ability to influence business decisions through data.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex insights clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver projects within deadlines.
  • Experience in banking, insurance, or financial services is an advantage.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
🚀 Ready to take AI beyond experimentation and into production at scale?

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who combines deep AI/ML expertise with exceptional software engineering capabilities to build the next generation of intelligent, autonomous systems.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Agentic AI, machine learning and distributed systems — designing AI agents that can reason, plan, use tools and execute complex, multi-step tasks, while engineering the robust architecture required to bring these capabilities into production.


We’re looking for someone who understands that building impressive AI demos is one thing. Building reliable, scalable and production-ready AI systems is another.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and want to help turn emerging AI capabilities into real-world solutions, this could be the opportunity for you.


🔥 What you’ll be doing

Build the next generation of Agentic AI

  • Design and develop autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems with reasoning, planning, tool use and memory.
  • Explore and implement agent orchestration patterns, LLM-powered applications and advanced AI techniques.
  • Develop and optimise machine learning models and pipelines across training, evaluation and inference.
  • Translate emerging AI research into practical, scalable solutions.

Engineer AI for production at scale

  • Architect and build robust microservices and distributed systems to support enterprise AI applications.
  • Develop production-grade services and APIs using Python, Java and frameworks such as Spring Boot.
  • Build event-driven architectures and integrations using technologies such as Kafka.
  • Drive reliability, performance, scalability and fault tolerance across AI services.
  • Implement MLOps practices and CI/CD pipelines to streamline model deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

Provide technical leadership

  • Lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions.
  • Work closely with data scientists, product teams and platform engineers to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.
  • Mentor engineers and promote high standards in software development, testing and code quality.
  • Champion engineering best practices and identify opportunities to improve how AI solutions are built and deployed.


🎯 What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on microservices engineering and architecture experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and Java, ideally combining AI development with enterprise-grade software engineering.
  • Practical experience building agentic AI systems, including tool calling, planning, reasoning and multi-step execution.
  • Strong knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, alongside the wider Python ML ecosystem.
  • Experience with MLOps, model deployment, monitoring and production lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs, containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A proven track record of taking complex technical solutions from concept through to production.


⭐ Experience that will make you stand out


We’re particularly interested in engineers who have hands-on experience with:

  • Agentic AI frameworks and orchestration patterns, including LangChain or AutoGen.
  • Large language models (LLMs), transformer architectures and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Advanced model optimisation, fine-tuning and PEFT techniques, including LoRA and QLoRA.
  • Distributed model training using technologies such as Ray, DeepSpeed, FSDP or PyTorch Distributed.
  • Vector databases, MLflow, Kubeflow and continuous feedback loops for model improvement.

A postgraduate degree, research contributions or open-source involvement in AI/ML would be advantageous, but demonstrable engineering capability and experience delivering AI into production matter most.


💡 Who should apply?

You might be an experienced AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer or Software Engineer with deep AI/ML expertise who wants to build systems that go beyond conventional model development.

You enjoy working across the AI and engineering stack. You care about architecture, clean code, reliability and performance just as much as model quality. And you’re excited about making agentic AI work in real-world environments.

TENTEN Partners is an equal opportunity firm and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by applicable laws.

title: Algorithm Engineer
description:
About the Role


Our client is a fast-growing technology company specialising in intelligent matching and recommendation systems, with a platform that connects millions of users at scale. They are seeking a Senior Algorithm Engineer to develop and optimise core machine learning algorithms that directly shape user experience and drive measurable business outcomes. This is a high-impact individual contributor role sitting at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world product delivery — ideal for someone who thrives on turning complex data challenges into scalable solutions.


Key Responsibilities



Lead the development and optimisation of recommendation and matching algorithms, continuously improving key performance metrics across multiple product verticals



Drive algorithm-powered initiatives that enhance both user experience and commercial outcomes through data-informed experimentation



Own the end-to-end model development lifecycle, spanning data processing, feature engineering, model training, and post-deployment monitoring



Analyse product performance data to identify algorithmic gaps and design improvement strategies grounded in quantitative evidence



Research emerging deep learning methodologies and adapt state-of-the-art techniques to address real-world product and business challenges



Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including product, engineering, and data — to integrate machine learning solutions into production environments



Design and implement A/B testing frameworks to rigorously validate model improvements before full-scale rollout



Build scalable machine learning pipelines that support rapid experimentation and iterative model development




Requirements



Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, with at least 2 years of hands-on algorithm development experience



Solid foundation in recommendation systems, search algorithms, or advertising optimisation, with a demonstrated track record in at least one of these domains



Strong understanding of machine learning principles; experience in causal inference, time series forecasting, multi-task learning, or reinforcement learning (is a bonus)



Proficiency in mainstream machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch, with strong programming skills in Python or equivalent languages



Experience with online learning systems and real-time algorithm deployment (is a bonus)



Professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required, as this role involves regular collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and technical teams based in China






If you are passionate about technology and meet the above requirements, please don't hesitate to apply. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Appreciate your understanding. Data provided is for recruitment purposes only.

title: Technology Development Device / TCAD Engineer
description:
About the job


At UMC, your growth is engineered for resilience. We combine long-term stability with non-linear, adaptable career paths, giving you the opportunity to make real impact, while growing with purpose.


With our newly expanded Fab and facilities in Singapore, we’re investing in a future-ready workforce equipped to lead in the world’s most advanced manufacturing environments.


With us, you can expect at UMC:

  • Career Resilience: Be part of a stable, values-led company with a track record of supporting our people, even in uncertain times
  • Growth that Fits You: Explore flexible development paths, cross-functional opportunities, and internal mobility
  • Meaningful Impact: Help deliver technologies that power everything from AI to smart mobility and sustainable innovation


Main Responsibilities

You’ll lead work that powers the day-to-day technologies behind modern life, from mobility and connectivity to smart systems and sustainable design. As a Technology Development Engineer (Device/TCAD) in our team, you will:

  • Conduct TCAD-based research and simulations to explore novel device concepts and architectures.
  • Develop, document and calibrate TCAD simulation decks in collaboration with cross-functional project teams.
  • Execute TCAD design of experiments (DOE) and generate tuning decks to support device optimisation.
  • Design test keys and layout structures for silicon validation, including bench-level electrical measurements and performance analysis.
  • Run structured experiments to fine-tune device parameters while safeguarding long-term reliability.


You are someone who brings precision, resilience, and purpose to everything you do. You thrive in a collaborative, tech-forward environment and are ready to lead work that drives impact and transformation.


We’re looking for someone with:

  • A master’s degree in electrical & electronic engineering or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in TCAD simulation, deck development, and calibration.
  • Familiarity with layout design and test structure, plus excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
  • Self-driven and data-minded, with a growth-oriented mindset and strong sense of ownership.


Ready to Precision-Engineer Your Future?

Whether you're seeking your next challenge or ready to lead meaningful innovation, UMC is where you can shape what comes next.

Lead What’s Next. Apply Now.


About United Microelectronics Corporation


United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) is a leading global semiconductor foundry with over 40 years of innovation powering technologies across AI, automotive, consumer electronics, connectivity, and IoT. As one of the industry’s most established players, we enable breakthrough technologies through precision-engineered semiconductor manufacturing for customers across every major sector of the electronics world.


Headquartered in Taiwan, UMC has been present in Singapore since 2004 and continues to invest in local talent, technology, and advanced manufacturing. Our recent Fab expansion reflects our long-term commitment to building Singapore as a key hub for semiconductor innovation, and to creating stable, meaningful careers through innovation, teamwork, and progress.


Join a team where your expertise powers real-world innovation. At UMC, you’ll find long-term stability, growth that adapts to your path, and work that drives impact, right down to the nanometre.

title: Algorithm Engineer
description:

• Independently deliver model-development work end to end: data processing, feature extraction, model training, deployment and monitoring

• Drive algorithmic improvements and technical innovation suited to the business, working closely with engineering, product and stakeholders

• Hands-on experience in causal inference, time-series forecasting, spatiotemporal data mining, multi-task learning, online learning, reinforcement learning or operations research optimisation

title: Control Systems Research Engineer (All Levels)
description:
About Us

LITEON is a world-leading provider of optoelectronic semiconductor components and power management modules. At LITEON we put people at the core - LITEON has built a culture of trust and empowerment that enhances employee involvement, engagement, and commitment to excellence.


About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our Cloud Infrastructure Platform and Solutions (CIPS) Research Team. Our CIPS Research team is focussed on developing future technology systems to support growth in the rapidly evolving data center sector. The successful candidate will be directly involved in early-stage research projects, working with academic institutions, suppliers, customers, and partners to deliver proof of concept designs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Complete literature reviews and studies to explore existing and future control systems.
  • Identify problems, future needs or market gaps to establish areas of further work.
  • Design, model, and simulate advanced control algorithms for power converters, electric drives, and energy systems.
  • Implement control software on embedded platforms (DSPs, MCUs, or FPGAs).
  • Integrate real time diagnostics, fault detection and control loops with sensors, actuators and communication interfaces in real hardware to demonstrate feasibility.
  • Write research reports, design guides, patents and performance reports.


Requirements

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronic / Control Engineering or related field.
  • Strong experience with control theory, digital control and signal processing.
  • Understanding of common power electronic architectures (AC/DC, DC/AC, DC/DC, etc) and control methods.
  • Knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink, embedded software (C/C++), architecture design and software version control.
  • Solid understanding of microcontroller architectures, sensors, and communication protocols.
  • Hands-on prototyping and testing experience using oscilloscopes, electronic loads and power analysers.
  • Expertise in using simulation tools to aid the development and assessment of the proposed solution (MATLAB, Simulink, Python, LTspice, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated passion for innovation and commitment to continuous learning.
  • We welcome applicants at all experience levels, from recent graduates to seasoned professionals.


Why Join Us

  • Work in a world-class R&D environment with well-equipped labs, top-tier industry connections and collaborative teams.
  • Shape the future of energy-efficient data storage and AI cloud computing – from renewable energy integration to next generation infrastructure.
  • Opportunities to publish, patent and innovate designs for future products.
  • Competitive compensation, research autonomy and a continuous learning culture

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:

Univers is the Platform for Physical AI, helping organizations orchestrate complex energy,

infrastructure and operational systems with intelligence that understands, predicts and acts in the

physical world.


Our AIP platform connects IT, OT and IoT data across enterprise systems, assets, sensors and edge

environments, creating a real-time operational foundation for monitoring, optimization,

automation and AI-driven action. Across energy, utilities, buildings, manufacturing, transportation

and logistics, Univers helps organizations improve performance, resilience, resource efficiency and

sustainability.


With more than 400 million connected sensors and devices, more than 1,005 GW of energy assets

under AI management and more than 800 customers globally, Univers operates one of the world’s

largest real-time intelligence platforms for physical infrastructure.

For more information, please visit https://univers.com/


Job Summary


This role will own the vision, strategy, and execution of product testing across Univer’s products. You will develop the frameworks, processes, and standards needed to evaluate our AI-powered products, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure we deliver reliable, high-quality solutions to our customers.


This role requires someone who understands both software testing and AI product evaluation — someone who can think critically about how AI systems should be tested, measured, and improved.

You will work closely with product and engineering teams to establish a world-class testing function.


Key Responsibilities:


· Develop and execute Univers’ overall testing strategy across AI-powered products

· Create testing frameworks and methodologies for evaluating product functionality, usability, accuracy, reliability, and performance

· Design and implement processes for testing AI outputs, including quality benchmarks, evaluation criteria, and success metrics

· Build structured test plans, test cases, and documentation to support product releases

· Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities through rigorous product testing

· Partner with Engineering team to improve product quality and development processes

· Establish repeatable workflows for regression testing, user acceptance testing, and release validation

· Analyze testing results and provide actionable insights to improve product performance

· Develop best practices for AI evaluation, including assessing accuracy, consistency, hallucination risks, and edge cases

· Help define quality standards as Univers’ scales its products and customer base

· Build and evolve the testing function, including future team growth and processes


Basic Qualifications:


· 5+ years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, product quality, or a related technical role

· Proven experience testing platform, SaaS applications, AI-powered products, machine learning systems, or LLM-based applications

· Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies and how to measure AI system performance

· Experience designing testing frameworks and quality processes from the ground up

· Have 3+ years of experience in QA or quality assurance, with a track record of leading test efforts for complex products

· Are comfortable being the person who builds the QA function from scratch — defining the processes, picking the tools, and setting the bar for quality

· Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear insights and recommendations

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

· Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer-facing teams

· Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities

· Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and tooling

· Experience building quality teams or functions within a growing organization


Preferred:


· Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale automation frameworks.

· Demonstrated ability to debug highly complex, intermittent, and cross-domain issues.

· Excellent communication skills and ability to influence without authority.

· IoT Protocols: Domain expertise in industrial and IoT communication protocols (Modbus, OPC-UA, BACnet, CAN, MQTT, CoAP, WebSockets, HTTP/REST).

title: Principal Platform Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Platform Infrastructure Engineer

GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Platform Infrastructure Engineer to join the Operations Engineering Practice (OEP) at the Government Technology Office (GTO). OEP aims to explore technologies, drive innovation, and establish practices in operations engineering - enabling GovTech and Agencies to build and operate resilient digital services.

The Principal Platform Infrastructure Engineer role is a senior technical leader responsible for establishing, evolving, and scaling an operations engineering practice area across the organization. The role drives standards, frameworks, tooling, and capability development that improve the reliability, resilience, and operational excellence of digital services. Working across engineering teams at GovTech, the Principal Platform Infrastructure Engineer influences technical direction, enables adoption of best practices, and leads strategic initiatives that uplift operational maturity at an organizational level. The Principal Platform Infrastructure Engineer owns a specific practice area such as Incident Management, Observability, Automation, Resiliency Engineering, or AIOps.

What you will be working on

  • Practice Leadership: Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the assigned Operations Engineering practice area. Establish organizational standards, policies, frameworks, and reference architectures. Identify gaps in current operational capabilities and develop improvement plans. Track industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously modernize the practice.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the organization's subject matter expert for the assigned practice area. Provide technical guidance on complex operational and reliability challenges. Lead technical evaluations, pilots, and proof-of-concepts. Develop reusable patterns, playbooks, and implementation guides.
  • Capability Development: Design and deliver capability-building initiatives across engineering teams. Create training materials, workshops, and communities of practice. Mentor engineers and technical leaders in adopting operational excellence practices. Define competency expectations and skills development pathways.
  • Adoption and Transformation: Partner with engineering teams to drive adoption of standards and best practices. Facilitate improvement initiatives across multiple domains and business units. Identify opportunities to reduce operational toil and improve engineering productivity. Measure and report adoption and effectiveness of practice initiatives.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead cross-functional programs that improve reliability, resiliency, and operational maturity. Partner with product, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver organization-wide outcomes. Contribute to long-term operational modernization efforts including automation, resilience engineering, and AI-assisted operations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver measurable improvements in reliability and service availability, operational efficiency, reduction of manual toil, incident response effectiveness, observability, engineering productivity, operational maturity, and adoption of standard operating practices.
  • Influences hundreds of engineers across multiple teams. Operations engineering standards and practices adopted organization-wide. Leads strategic operational excellence initiatives. Shapes the future direction of Operations Engineering capabilities.

What We Are Looking For

What You Bring

  • Technical Experience: 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Deep expertise in at least one operational excellence domain such as Incident Management, Observability, Automation Engineering, Resiliency Engineering, AIOps, or Service Reliability Engineering.
  • Experience designing and operating large-scale production systems.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, automation, monitoring, and operational practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
  • Experience leading organization-wide technical initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to build consensus across diverse engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience establishing engineering standards or practices at scale.
  • Experience building communities of practice. Experience developing training, capability-building, or workforce transformation initiatives. Experience operating in large enterprises or government environments.

What we offer you:

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company as we believe that diversity is meaningful to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. This includes generous leave benefits to meet your work-life needs. We trust that you will get the job done wherever you are, and whatever works best for you – so work from home or take a break to exercise if you need to*. We also believe it’s important for you to keep honing your craft in the constantly-evolving tech landscape, so we provide and support a plethora of in-house and external learning and development opportunities all year round.

Subject to the nature of your job role that might require you to be onsite during fixed hours.

As a Direct Care Provider Lead, you will have the opportunity to lead and inspire a dedicated team, ensure high standards of client care, and contribute to the development and implementation of individualized support plans. Your leadership will help shape the daily experiences of our clients, guiding them toward greater independence and well-being.

If you are ready to embrace a challenging and rewarding position that combines leadership, client care, and team collaboration, this is the role for you.



Some of what you will be doing

  • Provide specialized care, support, and training to SOCR clients, including assistance with daily living activities (e.g., hygiene, meal preparation, community activities) and adherence to individualized care plans and behavioral support strategies.

  • Maintain the home environment, including inventory of supplies, personal possessions, PPE, and equipment; oversee household maintenance, safety, and cleanliness.

Professionals who have:

OR
  • Two years of experience as an Attendant Counselor 1 or in an equivalent or higher-level state classification
OR

Desired skills and abilities:

title: Site Reliability Engineer – Kubernetes/Linux Platform (Remote – APAC)
description:
This is a fully remote role open to candidates across the APAC region


About Saturn Cloud


Saturn Cloud builds infrastructure for running AI, machine learning, and data workloads at scale. Our platform helps teams develop, deploy, and operate compute-intensive workloads across modern cloud and GPU infrastructure.


We’re looking for a Site Reliability Engineer based in the APAC region to help operate and troubleshoot the production infrastructure supporting Saturn Cloud Token Factory.


This is an infrastructure/SRE role rather than a traditional customer support position. You’ll be expected to independently diagnose production incidents across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, containers, storage, and cloud infrastructure, participate in incident response and SLA coverage, and work directly with customers and GPU infrastructure providers when necessary.


We value engineers who actively use modern AI coding agents to improve the speed and quality of their engineering and operational work.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and troubleshoot production incidents across GPU-backed Kubernetes environments
  • Diagnose issues spanning Kubernetes, Linux, networking, containers, storage, and cloud infrastructure
  • Investigate Kubernetes scheduling failures involving resource requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, PriorityClasses, quotas, and related configuration
  • Troubleshoot container runtimes including containerd, Docker, and OCI runtimes
  • Operate and debug Kubernetes networking, including Services, Ingress, DNS, NetworkPolicy, CNI, and load balancers
  • Diagnose TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS issues in production environments
  • Troubleshoot Kubernetes storage and CSI issues, including PVCs/PVs, block storage, shared filesystems, and mount failures
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and production observability using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
  • Build diagnostic and operational automation using Bash and Python
  • Work directly with customer and infrastructure-provider teams during production incidents
  • Determine whether failures originate within Saturn Cloud, Kubernetes, customer infrastructure, networking/storage, or underlying GPU infrastructure
  • Produce clear technical evidence for escalation when an issue belongs outside Saturn Cloud’s infrastructure layer


What We’re Looking For


Core Skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools to accelerate engineering, debugging, automation, and operational workflows
  • Deep hands-on experience troubleshooting Kubernetes in production
  • Strong Linux systems administration and debugging skills
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes scheduling and resource management
  • Experience with containerd, Docker, or other OCI-compatible container runtimes
  • Experience with Helm and Kubernetes deployment/configuration management
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes networking
  • Strong TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS troubleshooting skills
  • Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes storage and CSI
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable observability tooling
  • Bash and Python experience for diagnostics and operational automation
  • Experience with at least one major managed Kubernetes environment such as EKS, GKE, AKS, or OKE


GPU Knowledge


You don’t need to be the team’s deepest GPU specialist, but you should be comfortable operating GPU workloads and identifying when an incident has moved beyond the Kubernetes or container layer.


Experience should include:

  • NVIDIA GPU Operator and Kubernetes device plugins
  • GPU resource allocation and scheduling
  • nvidia-smi and basic GPU health diagnostics
  • NVIDIA Container Toolkit/runtime
  • CUDA and driver compatibility concepts
  • Identifying GPU, driver, or hardware failures that require deeper infrastructure escalation


Strong Pluses

  • Cilium or Calico
  • Terraform
  • KAI Scheduler, Grove, Volcano, or other batch/GPU schedulers
  • vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, Triton, or other inference systems
  • Multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms
  • Experience operating infrastructure against contractual availability SLAs
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers during production incidents


What Success Looks Like


When an inference endpoint becomes unavailable, you can systematically trace the issue through the load balancer, ingress, Kubernetes Service, workload, scheduler, container runtime, and node.


You can determine whether the root cause belongs to Saturn Cloud, Kubernetes, the customer’s network or storage environment, or the underlying GPU infrastructure, and provide useful evidence to the appropriate team.


You’re comfortable being the primary incident owner, not simply collecting logs and passing the problem to someone else.


Why Saturn Cloud

  • Remote-first culture with a high-trust, high-ownership environment
  • Work on production infrastructure at the center of modern AI and GPU computing
  • Solve technically challenging reliability problems across Kubernetes, cloud, and GPU infrastructure
  • Help shape the operational practices of a rapidly evolving AI infrastructure platform


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible PTO
  • Fully remote position

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer for our Enterprise Platforms Engineering team who demonstrates a strong commitment to engineering excellence, communicates effectively, and can work with teams with various levels of experience to help create solutions to a wide range of problems.


This role will be responsible for the design, build, and delivery of software development infrastructure to support Singtel internal tools and platform development. Partnering closely with different teams in Singtel, this position will help direct project teams toward automated codebase deployment that satisfies business needs and aligns with Singtel’s IT & Security strategy.


You should be someone who brings new thinking and is motivated by the challenge of driving change and adopting new technologies. We are looking for someone who can work independently, take initiative and build trusting relationships across teams. The successful candidate will champion the application of industry best practices, cloud architecture strategies, and engineering standards to ensure successful cloud solutions across a wide variety of projects. This role will help drive technology standards, evolution, and governance for cloud, and as required, will evolve cloud standards to address emerging business requirements.


Responsibilities:


  • Platform Engineering & Delivery: Design, build, deploy and operate highly available platform environments across on-premises, private cloud and public cloud infrastructure. Support end-to-end customer/platform delivery from infrastructure readiness through production handover.
  • Kubernetes & Infrastructure Operations: Deploy, administer, upgrade and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, Linux systems, virtualization, networking, storage, load balancers and supporting platform services.
  • Automation & GitOps: Automate infrastructure and application deployment using Terraform, Ansible, scripting, CI/CD and GitOps/ArgoCD, reducing manual operations and improving consistency.
  • Production Reliability: Monitor production environments, respond to incidents, perform structured troubleshooting and RCA, and implement preventive improvements. Maintain HA, backup, restore and DR capabilities.
  • Security & Compliance: Perform vulnerability remediation, patching, security hardening, certificate/secrets management and access-control reviews, working with security teams to address CVE/CIS/audit findings.
  • Lifecycle Management: Manage OS, Kubernetes and platform component upgrades, patching, certificates and technology end-of-life remediation.
  • Delivery Ownership: Proactively identify blockers, dependencies and delivery risks, communicate them early, and drive cross-team resolution to meet project and customer commitments.
  • Operational Readiness: Produce SOPs, runbooks, architecture/deployment documentation, RCA reports and operational handover materials; provide knowledge transfer to support teams.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, evaluate technologies and continuously improve automation, reliability, security and ways of working.


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience

title: Lead Embedded Firmware & Electronics Engineer — Wearables (BLE, Ultra-Low-Power)
description:
About Lumysi

Lumysi is a US-based wearable technology startup developing a jewelry-inspired health and fitness bracelet. Our screenless titanium wearable continuously tracks health, activity, sleep, recovery, and women's health metrics while keeping the look and comfort of a premium accessory. The product combines biometric sensors, ultra-low-power embedded systems, Bluetooth connectivity, interchangeable straps, and a mobile app that turns health data into personalized insights.


The Role

We are hiring a senior engineer to own the firmware and the hardware/firmware integration of the Lumysi wearable end to end, from bring-up of new prototype boards through production release. You will be the technical reference for embedded development. You will set the firmware architecture, make the hard trade-offs between battery life, sensor quality and connectivity, and raise the bar for a growing engineering team.


This is a hands-on role. You will write production C/C++ every week, work at the bench with a scope and a power profiler, and collaborate directly with the founders, hardware engineers, the mobile team, sensor suppliers and contract manufacturers.


What You'll Own


• Firmware architecture on Nordic (nRF52/nRF53) and Espressif platforms: RTOS design (Zephyr/nRF Connect SDK or FreeRTOS), task model, memory, boot flow and modularity.

• Bring-up of new board revisions, working from schematics and datasheets: clocks, power rails, memories, sensors, PMIC and peripherals.

• The device power budget. You will implement sleep modes, wake-up sources, sensor duty-cycling and BLE connection parameters to reach multi-day battery life, and validate them at µA level with power-profiling tools.

• Biometric acquisition: drivers and pipelines for PPG, IMU and skin-temperature sensors, covering sampling strategy, FIFO/buffering, timestamping and data quality under motion.

• BLE: custom GATT services, reliable sync of stored data to iOS/Android, connection robustness and sniffer-based debugging. You will also work with hardware on RF/antenna performance inside a titanium enclosure.

Battery and charging: PMIC, charger and fuel-gauge integration, battery protection and accurate state-of-charge reporting.

• Security and updates: secure boot, signed OTA/DFU with rollback, secure element integration, and PKI-based device identity and provisioning.

• Manufacturing: factory test firmware, calibration, provisioning flows and production-line support with our contract manufacturer.

• Engineering discipline: code reviews, coding standards, CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, release management and documentation. You will also mentor and unblock other engineers on the team.

• The firmware perspective in schematic reviews, component selection and design for testability.


Must-Have


• 7+ years of professional embedded development in C/C++ on resource-constrained MCUs, both bare-metal and RTOS.

• Firmware lead or primary firmware owner of at least one battery-powered, BLE-connected product that shipped to volume production. You have lived through EVT, DVT, PVT and post-launch field issues, and can walk us through them in detail.

• Deep BLE experience: GATT design, connection and advertising tuning, throughput vs. power trade-offs, and iOS/Android interoperability.

• Proven ultra-low-power optimization on real hardware, backed by measurements.

• Strong electronics fundamentals. You read schematics and layouts confidently, understand power rails, analog front-ends and noise, and can tell whether a bug lives in hardware or firmware.

• Board-level debugging with JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, BLE sniffers and power analyzers.

• Sensor drivers over I2C, SPI and UART, plus interrupts, DMA, timers and ADCs.

• Git, CI and structured testing, with Python for test tooling and automation.

• Professional working proficiency in English, and comfort working directly with founders and external partners in a fast-moving startup.


Strong Plus


• Wearable, medical or consumer devices with biometric sensors (PPG, SpO₂, IMU, skin temperature), including signal quality, calibration and motion artifacts.

• Zephyr / nRF Connect SDK and MCUboot in production.

• Embedded security: secure elements, secure boot, cryptographic provisioning.

• RF/antenna tuning in compact or metal enclosures, FCC/IC/CE pre-compliance and Bluetooth SIG qualification.

• Production ramp with contract manufacturers.

• Experience as a founding or first senior engineer at an early-stage hardware startup.


What We Offer


• Ownership of the firmware and embedded architecture of an international wearable product.

• Direct collaboration with the founders, engineering team and manufacturing partners.

• Real decision-making power from day one: your choices ship.

As a Showroom Associate, you'll be one of the friendly faces welcoming customers into Lectric Rides. You'll help visitors find the perfect bike or trike, answer product questions, lead test rides, and assist customers through the purchasing process.

This is a customer-facing retail sales position, not a mechanic or technician role. Our service technicians handle repairs and maintenance, allowing you to focus on sales, customer service, and keeping the showroom running smoothly.

No bike mechanic experience required! We'll teach you about our products and help you build the knowledge to confidently assist customers.

We are proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunity employer.

Our mission is to provide the most accessible and adventurous eBikes ever. Our purpose is to change people's lives by increasing their mobility in a fun and memorable fashion, while being energy efficient. Our vision is to create a mode of transportation that anyone can ride at an affordable price. Through authenticity, we aspire to be the most fearless, innovative, and relentlessly inspirational global brand in our industry.

title: Network Engineer – AI Cloud
description:
About the role

We run AI clusters for training and inference. As a Network Engineer, you own the networks behind our GPU clusters: the high-speed compute fabric, the data centre Ethernet fabric, out-of-band management, and connectivity to carriers and the internet.

This is a hands-on role. You will design and build out networks at new sites, keep production fabrics stable and fast, and own network issues through to root cause and permanent fix.


What you'll do

Build-out

  • Design network topology for new GPU clusters and sites: compute fabric, Ethernet fabric, management network and edge connectivity, sized for scale and failure tolerance
  • Deploy, configure and validate networks at new data centre sites, from day-0 out-of-band and management switches to production fabrics
  • Bring up InfiniBand/RoCE compute fabrics and leaf-spine Ethernet fabrics for new GPU clusters
  • Review bills of materials, rack elevations and cabling plans so each site matches the design
  • Run fabric acceptance tests before clusters go live

Fabric and connectivity operations

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration consistency and performance of InfiniBand/RoCE and Ethernet fabrics
  • Operate and tune subnet managers (UFM/OpenSM), QoS and congestion control on the compute fabric
  • Manage data centre edge and WAN connectivity: BGP with carriers and internet exchanges, data centre interconnect
  • Troubleshoot link, optics, cabling and fabric performance issues, and drive root cause analysis on network incidents
  • Work with vendors on firmware upgrades, defects and RMAs


What we're looking for

  • 4+ years in data centre, service provider or large-scale cloud networking, with hands-on production operations
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating InfiniBand and/or RoCE fabrics, including subnet managers, QoS and RDMA
  • Deep routing and switching knowledge: BGP, IS-IS or OSPF, ECMP, EVPN/VXLAN, leaf-spine (Clos) designs
  • Experience with at least one major vendor platform: NVIDIA, Cisco, Juniper or Ruijie.
  • Strong troubleshooting from the physical layer up: optics, cabling, interface counters, packet captures, MTU and routing issues
  • Solid Linux skills
  • Fluent in both English and Mandarin, spoken and written
  • Clear written communication: design notes, change plans and incident reports others can follow


Working arrangement

  • Based in Singapore, with regular travel to our data centres across Southeast Asia
  • On-call rotation required: business hours by default, plus rotating coverage for critical incidents outside business hours

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines substantial engineering experience with a strong commitment to people management. Automation and infrastructure as code

  • Maintain documented and reusable infrastructure code and configurations in Git

Monitoring, logging and operations

  • Support centralised logging platforms such as Graylog and Cribl
  • Participate in incident management, change management and scheduled maintenance
  • Work with internal teams and vendors to investigate and resolve infrastructure issues

Endpoint management

  • Support IT asset management and end-user technology needs


What will help you succeed

You do not need to match every item perfectly. We are interested in your practical skills, problem-solving approach and willingness to learn.

This position may suit someone with approximately 3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience. However, we also welcome candidates who have developed comparable skills through technical education, certifications, apprenticeships, self-directed learning, practical projects or another career pathway.

Apply now through LinkedIn and take the next step in your infrastructure engineering career.

title: Software Test Engineer (AI), TikTok Search
description:
Responsibilities
The TikTok Search Engineering Test Team owns the end-to-end quality of TikTok's global search experience—from query understanding, retrieval, and ranking to generative search experiences (LLM Answers and RAG) and search safety. TikTok Search operates across hundreds of markets and languages, connecting billions of users every day with the videos, creators, products, and information they are looking for. Every relevance regression, latency fluctuation, or unsafe result directly impacts user trust and business outcomes.

We are redefining how search quality is built. By leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation, we are reimagining the entire search testing lifecycle—from query set construction and relevance evaluation to ranking diagnostics, LLM-generated answer evaluation, RAG pipeline verification, and search safety red teaming.

Our mission is to build next-generation AI-powered evaluation and testing capabilities that enable TikTok Search to iterate faster, ship smarter, and remain trustworthy at global scale. You will work at the intersection of Search Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Generative AI, helping shape the future of AI-native Search Quality at TikTok.

As a Software Test Engineer (AI) on the Search team, you will:
- Design and deliver AI-powered testing and evaluation solutions for TikTok Search, covering query understanding, retrieval, ranking, generative search (LLM Answers and RAG), personalization, and multimodal and vertical search scenarios such as video, image, e-commerce, user, and creator search.
- Build LLM-based evaluation pipelines for search relevance, answer faithfulness, groundedness, freshness, coverage, diversity, and safety; construct and continuously maintain multilingual, multi-market query sets and golden datasets that reflect real user intent.
- Drive change impact analysis across the search stack—including index, retrieval, ranking models, and prompt and model changes—through AI-assisted diff analysis, offline replay, side-by-side (SBS) evaluation, and interleaving experiments; strengthen release quality gates and pre-launch verification capabilities.
- Partner closely with search engineering, algorithm, product, and content operations teams to identify quality and engineering productivity pain points across the search lifecycle, propose practical AI-powered solutions, and drive them into production.

- Familiarity with distributed systems and search and recommendation infrastructure fundamentals (e.g. inverted indexes, vector indexes, retrieval, ranking, embeddings), plus basic knowledge of iOS and/or Android as search entry points.
- Hands-on experience in one or more testing domains, including automation testing, performance and stress testing, algorithm evaluation, or test platform and tool development.
- Strong interest in Generative AI and Large Language Models, with an understanding of common LLM capabilities, evaluation paradigms (e.g. LLM-as-a-Judge, RAG evaluation, and human evaluation), and real-world search applications.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience evaluating or testing search, recommendation, ranking, or LLM and RAG systems, including relevance labeling, SBS evaluation, NDCG, MRR, and Recall analysis, faithfulness and groundedness measurement, or hallucination detection.

- Hands-on experience with Generative AI–related projects, including LLM application development, AI agent evaluation, model evaluation, AI-assisted testing, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or building AI testing frameworks.

As part of its continued investment in data and AI capabilities, the organization is seeking to appoint an experienced Data Scientist to develop innovative solutions that enhance customer engagement, optimize revenue opportunities, and improve business decision-making.


This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of business, data science, and AI, applying both traditional statistical methodologies and emerging AI technologies to deliver measurable commercial and revenue impact.


Responsibilities


You will design, develop, and deploy data science and AI solutions that drive business growth, revenue optimization, and customer engagement across the organization. Leveraging traditional statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning, and Generative AI, you will identify commercial opportunities, develop actionable insights, and build scalable solutions that support business decision-making.


Working closely with business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers, and AI engineers, you will translate commercial challenges into analytical use cases across customer segmentation, propensity modelling, cross-selling, customer lifetime value, pricing, and revenue optimization. You will lead the end-to-end data science lifecycle, from problem formulation and experimentation through model development, deployment, and performance monitoring.


You will also explore opportunities to leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic workflows to enhance customer intelligence, automate analytical processes, and improve business productivity. A key focus will be measuring the commercial effectiveness of data science initiatives through experimentation, business KPIs, and quantifiable revenue outcomes.


Requirements


We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist with 5–10 years of experience applying statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex business problems. You should have a proven track record of delivering data science solutions that generate measurable business, customer, or revenue impact, preferably within financial services or other commercially driven industries.


Strong expertise in Python, SQL, statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and machine learning is essential, together with practical experience in techniques such as regression, classification, customer segmentation, propensity modelling, and experimentation. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including Generative AI, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or AI-driven analytical workflows, will be highly advantageous.


Candidates should demonstrate strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect analytical outputs to business outcomes such as revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and profitability. Experience working with business and technology teams to take models beyond experimentation into production and operational adoption is important.


The ideal candidate will combine strong traditional data science fundamentals with practical AI capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable commercial strategies.

title: Machine Learning Engineer – Deep Learning for HFT
description:
About Our Client

Our client is an established quantitative trading firm seeking an AI / Machine Learning Engineer to develop and deploy deep learning models for high-frequency trading and market making.


Reporting to the Head of HFT, you will work on large neural networks trained on raw tick-level order-book data across multiple markets and venues. The role offers ownership across data preparation, model research, training infrastructure and integration into a live C++ trading platform.


You will join a small team with minimal hierarchy, direct access to decision-makers and meaningful ownership of your work. The firm offers top-of-market compensation with P&L-linked upside.


We welcome experienced researchers and engineers from quantitative finance, technology companies and AI research labs, as well as exceptional recent PhD graduates with strong practical experience. Prior financial markets experience is not essential.


Job Responsibilities

  • Research and train deep learning models on large-scale order-book and market data to predict short-horizon market behaviour.
  • Develop sequence and time-series models, exploring architectures and training methods suited to noisy, rapidly changing financial data.
  • Own data preparation, feature and label construction, training pipelines and reproducible experiments.
  • Evaluate models against robust baselines using time-aware out-of-sample validation, with careful controls for data leakage and overfitting.
  • Improve training efficiency and scalability through GPU computing, distributed training and performance optimisation.
  • Work closely with HFT researchers and engineers to optimise inference and integrate models into a latency-constrained C++ market-making system.
  • Evaluate production model behaviour and use live feedback to guide further research.


Work Experience and Requirements

  • A Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent evidence of exceptional research and engineering ability.
  • Typically 3–10 years of relevant post-degree experience. Exceptional recent PhD graduates with substantial hands-on model training and implementation experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Personal ownership of training deep learning models at scale, demonstrated through datasets exceeding 100 GB or multi-GPU training.
  • Strong Python skills and regular hands-on use of PyTorch or JAX, together with proficiency in C++, Rust or CUDA.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and optimising deep learning models. Experience deploying models under latency or throughput constraints is preferred; recent PhD graduates may demonstrate relevant ability through research implementations, benchmarking or industry internships.
  • A rigorous experimental research track record, demonstrated through first-author publications at leading ML conferences, Kaggle Master status or above, or industry research evaluated against credible baselines.
  • Strong mathematical and statistical foundations, with the ability to design experiments, interpret results and assess model generalisation.
  • Experience in sequence modelling, time-series prediction or efficient deep learning is particularly relevant.
  • Custom CUDA / Triton kernels, distributed training, inference optimisation, or order-book and market microstructure experience would be advantageous.
  • An interest in applying deep learning to financial markets. Prior trading experience is welcome but not required.


Application Process

Interested candidates should submit their resume to Tina Wang at tw@empowerpartners.sg, quoting “Machine Learning Engineer – Deep Learning for HFT” in the subject line. Please include relevant Google Scholar, GitHub or Kaggle links where available.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
