title: Software Engineer, Ministry of Education (Parents Gateway)
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[Background]

Experimental Systems and Technology Lab (ESTL) of GovTech is an engineering team within the Ministry of Education (MOE). We are made up of engineers, user experience designers and education officers.

Our team designs and develops software products that help MOE transform how it delivers services through digitalisation and innovation.

One of these products is Parents Gateway (PG), MOE’s key digital platform connecting schools and parents across Singapore.

Parents Gateway supports important interactions between schools and families — from receiving school information and providing consent, to managing parent-teacher engagements and other everyday school-parent interactions.

We are now entering the next phase of Parents Gateway.

The team has an opportunity to rethink and rebuild the product for the years ahead, modernising its architecture, improving the experience for schools and parents, and establishing the engineering foundations that will support its future evolution.

You can find out more about ESTL at estl.edu.sg.

[What you will be working on]

Parents Gateway (PG) is MOE’s key digital platform connecting schools and parents across Singapore. The platform consists of a parent-facing mobile application, a web platform for school staff, and the backend services and cloud infrastructure that power them. It supports key school-parent interactions such as announcements, consent forms, parent-teacher engagements and other services, with integrations across the wider MOE ecosystem.

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer, you will join us at an exciting stage where we are building the next generation of PG largely from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to shape its architecture, engineering foundations and technical practices, while building a platform that operates at national scale.

Your Responsibilities Include

  • Build the Next Generation of PG: Develop, test and maintain features across the mobile app, web platform and backend services of the new Parents Gateway.
  • Feature Delivery: Turn product and design requirements into working software, from breaking down the work and implementing it through testing, release and follow-up.
  • Technical Design: Contribute to technical designs for the features you work on. Raise trade-offs and questions early, and learn from design discussions with senior engineers.
  • Quality & Testing: Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code. Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Production Support: Help monitor, troubleshoot and fix issues in production, and help make the platform more reliable over time.
  • Continuous Improvement: Help improve the team's tools, CI/CD pipelines, documentation and engineering practices.

You will also work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Education Officers and fellow engineers to turn real problems faced by schools and parents into simple, accessible and reliable experiences.

[What we are looking for]

We are looking for an engineer with solid fundamentals who enjoys learning, cares about the people using what they build, and wants to grow into taking ownership of production systems.

You Should Have

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Professional software engineering experience, or substantial internship or project experience, building real-world applications.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Java or similar.
  • Experience building one or more of: mobile apps, web applications, or backend services and APIs.
  • A good understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, software design, version control and automated testing.
  • Awareness of secure coding practices and of how to build software that is reliable and maintainable.
  • The ability to learn new technologies quickly and work across different parts of a system.
  • The ability to break down problems and deliver working solutions, asking for guidance when needed.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work well in a cross-functional team.

It Is a Plus If You Have

  • Experience with React Native, React, or Node.js.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, or to tools such as Docker, Terraform or CI/CD pipelines.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

description:

Our in-store positions are likely to include evening, weekend, and holiday shifts per the needs of the business. Must complete and maintain any required food and work safety trainings/certifications.
About the role: Leads management of department program and staff, including production, financial stewardship, customer service, department conditions, merchandising, food and work safety, staffing, training and performance management. Ensures the department provides an exceptional customer shopping experience, with the highest level of service and product knowledge. Provides exceptional customer service and contributes to a positive and collaborative team environment. This is a management/leadership position. You are responsible for providing leadership in line with company values and promoting a positive and progressive work environment in alignment with our company mission, vision values and policies.
General Requirements:

Engages the customer in a friendly manner by seeking opportunities to exceed customer expectations and enhance the customer experience.
Works a schedule that is informed by the needs of the business and may be subject to change seasonally or due to varying staffing needs and demonstrates reliable and predictable attendance, in accordance with attendance policy and all applicable laws.
Shifts tasks as priorities and circumstances change based on needs and conditions of department and whole store as needed.
Demonstrates a solutions-oriented approach to problems or concerns.
Represents company values. Demonstrates commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment. Works cooperatively and positively with fellow team members, customers and vendors spiriting a respectful workplace where everyone is welcome.
Gives and receives feedback in a constructive manner demonstrating company “Speak Up & Listen” culture. Responds to feedback in order to improve performance.
Conserves company resources. Works in a manner consistent with company mission, vision and values and sustainability program.
Adheres to work and food safety policies set forth by the company and all local, state and federal regulatory agencies. Contributes to store cleanliness, maintains equipment. Informs store/department management of any problems.
Observes all company rules and policies. Understands and complies with specific department or location guidelines, tasks and responsibilities.
Demonstrates sound judgment and decision-making in completing job-related tasks, in behaviors in the workplace, and in interactions with co-workers, customers, and the community.
Consistently utilizes the DEI lens in work tasks and when working with other teams and stakeholders.
Builds trust and respect through dependability, organization and follow through.
Promotes a collaborative team environment through recognition, leading by example and working alongside staff. Demonstrates approachability and fosters open communication. Creates an environment where staff are invested and encouraged to contribute ideas. Demonstrates a pro-active approach in resolving staff issues and conflicts. Demonstrates ability to adapt approach to different learning styles among staff.

Position Responsibilities:

Assesses, prioritizes and delegates tasks and production within both Meat and Seafood departments ensuring that the daily business needs are achieved.
Wraps, weighs and prices meat and seafood products according to department policy, dating and government regulations in regards to tare weights and COOL Act.
Ensures all meat and seafood items are cut, trimmed, and processed in accordance to company standards.
Ensures department is stocked, rotated, faced and adheres to merchandising standards and category schematics. Demonstrates creativity and utilizes all tools and products in order to increase sales and minimize waste.
Demonstrates a solid understanding of labor, sales and margin goals and factors that influence them. Meets labor and margin goals. Develops and executes a plan when results do not meet expectations.
Responsible for in-stock conditions. Maintains appropriate inventory levels to achieve sales and margin goals; adjusts for seasonal needs. Includes setting par levels and establishing daily production levels for case-ready back stock.
Reads and understands merchandising information. Develops and executes merchandising plans to promote peak seasonal/ad item/holiday products, drive sales and create an optimal customer shopping experience.
Coordinates with Operations department to plan and conduct in-store tastings.
Receives and unloads merchandise; checks quality, count for accuracy and condition. Communicates any issues to management and merchandising team.
Maintains the organization, rotation and cleanliness of all back-stock areas with attention to product quality and expiration dates.
Assists customers with product selection. Shares product knowledge with customers. Makes recommendations and suggestions based on customer needs.
Ensures customer needs are met which is to include, special orders are completed on time, schedules are written to meet peak sales hours and all top movers are readily available.
Ensures department compliance with company organic standards.
Proactively leads the department leadership team in analyzing monthly perishable inventory, ensuring accuracy with the final counts.
Trains and educates staff to write orders and production schedules consistent with department goals and standards.
Ensures that department adheres to company invoice, credit, transfer, and inventory procedures.
Maintains professional vendor relationships.
Leverages resources and labor to maximize efficiency, without compromising quality and service standards.
Manages and provides oversight to all areas of the department. Directly manages all department staff, including performance management and review writing, scheduling, and providing ongoing training, coaching, development and feedback. Assesses, prioritizes and delegates tasks and production.
Demonstrates an understanding of basic Human Resources concepts; works with resources at store level to increase knowledge. Establishes and maintains effective verbal and written communication systems.
Tools and Equipment Used (not all inclusive): This position may be required to use the following tools and equipment: baler, hand truck, POS, industrial kitchen equipment (i.e. blast chiller, grill, knives/blades, oven, slicers, grinders, grills, scales, etc.), basic housekeeping / janitorial and standard office equipment.
This position works at a * Medium/ Heavy level. Required frequently and up to continuously to be on feet with a mix of standing and walking throughout shift. Sitting seldom required. Up to occasionally, dependent on location, required to climb stairs, step stool and /or ladders.

Frequently required to use hands and wrists for grabbing, twisting and pulling.
Performs other tasks and duties as assigned.

*Medium/Heavy means the worker has the ability to occasionally (1 – 33%) lift 100 pounds while participating in a team lift* and has the ability to frequently (34 – 66%) lift, push, pull, or carry objects weighing 50 pounds. *Please note we encourage team lifts for any objects over 50lbs.
What you Bring as a Candidate:

Previous customer service, food service, retail or grocery experience required.
2 + years previous supervisory or management experience required.
Knowledge of retail Meat and Seafood departments preferred, however butcher shop, meat fabrication, or seafood industry experience acceptable.
Prior seafood cutting / fabrication experience required.

Entry to mid-level proficiency with MS Office. Working knowledge with POS, inventory or other retail specific software preferred.

Skills to manage financial results, including labor, sales and profit margin.
Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment

Physical and Environmental Work Space: Work occurs in a grocery store environment which includes surfaces that can be wet and slippery, depending on location may have stairs or elevators, moderate noise level, and temperature extremes in controlled environments in the cooler and freezer, and depending on location, working outside in all temperatures. There may be exposure to certain allergens and / or chemicals. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the ADA Amendments Act of 2008, and other applicable state or local law, we will offer reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities.

title: [LPS] L3 Cloud Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Engineer lead (Level 3) to support cloud infrastructure for Commercial and Singapore Government-appointed agency operating across commercial cloud platforms. This role requires experiences managing multi-cloud environments predominantly on Amazon Web Services (AWS), with knowledge in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) capabilities, comprehensive OS lifecycle and patching operations, application deployment and troubleshooting expertise, and proactive operational leadership. This role emphasizes hands-on technical proficiency, security awareness, automation-driven practices, mentorship capabilities, and familiarity with strict uptime, compliance, and audit requirements in network separation environments.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Operations

  • Operate and maintain cloud-native services in production across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform:
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services including: Lambda, ECS/EKS, FSx, Glue, SES, GuardDuty, WAF, Shield Advanced, Security Hub, KMS, Secret Manager, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure Monitor, Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring
  • Monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure performance, uptime, and scalability across all platforms
  • Able to participate in weekend rotation to provide round-the-clock operational support and assist a team of L2 engineers with hands-on troubleshooting of technical issues.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • With working knowledge, able to maintain infrastructure deployment pipelines with 1 of the following: Terraform, Ansible, and/or Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates
  • Troubleshoot environment drift and pipeline failures across multi-cloud environments.
  • Promote and be empowered to drive automation in cloud operations and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Implement and maintain GitOps practices for infrastructure deployment

Operating System Lifecycle & Patch Management

  • Lead OS patching operations across RHEL (v8 to v10) and Windows Server (2016→2025) using AWS Patch Manager, Azure Update Management, WSUS, SCCM, and YUM/DNF
  • Maintain basic knowledge of Linux administration with deep expertise in Wintel Operating System patching and management
  • Schedule, automate, and track patches across all environments
  • Coordinate patch approvals and ensure compliance with organizational policies
  • Execute monthly and quarterly patch cycles with minimal disruption
  • Perform post-patch validation and remediation activities

Application Deployment & Troubleshooting

  • Deploy and troubleshoot applications across Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Support application teams with OS-level diagnostics and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with development teams to resolve infrastructure and OS-related application issues
  • Implement and maintain application monitoring and alerting frameworks

Security & Compliance

  • Execute CIS (Center for Internet Security) security remediations across cloud platforms
  • Perform security hardening based on CIS Benchmarks and government security baselines
  • Conduct vulnerability remediation using tools such as Trend Micro Vision One, Qualys, Tenable, and AWS Config
  • Track SSL certificate renewals across all environments
  • Identify and remediate End-of-Life (EOL) components including OS versions and Lambda runtimes

  • Define and execute the data science and AI strategy aligned with business priorities by partnering with process, equipment, and integration engineering teams to operationalize insights and drive adoption of data-driven decisions

  • Design, deploy, and maintain production-grade machine learning models (MLOps), including monitoring model performance, drift detection, and lifecycle management


Other Responsibilities

  • Promote a data-driven culture across the organization
  • Identify and advocate for scalable data platforms and tools (cloud, IoT, edge analytics where applicable)
  • Collaborate with IT engineering to: (i) Define data architecture and pipelines; and (ii) Improve data quality and accessibility


Skills and Competencies Profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 5–8+ years of experience in data science or machine learning (experience in semiconductor or manufacturing strongly preferred)
  • Strong programming skills in Python, R (or similar)
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
  • Expertise in data analysis, statistical process control, and experimental design (e.g. DOE)
  • Knowledge and experience with time-series analysis (sensor, machine data); predictive maintenance models, and process optimization frameworks
  • Experience working with large datasets and data wrangling
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Able to communicate effectively across functions and work well with different departments

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

As a Senior Data Scientist you'd be able to work on and solve some of the many interesting challenges we are facing, learn new ways of working, and build delightful high-quality products for our customers.

Job Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with deep expertise in statistical modelling, machine learning, and business analytics to drive revenue growth through advanced analytical solutions. In this role, you will design and deploy predictive models including cross-sell, upsell, deep-sell, and look-alike models that directly impact product strategy and customer engagement. You will leverage AWS SageMaker for end-to-end model automation and harness Large Language Models (LLMs) including Claude/Anthropic to enhance productivity, personalisation, and insight generation at scale.

You will work closely with product owners, marketing, and business stakeholders to translate complex data patterns into actionable insights at both product and customer levels, ensuring analytical solutions drive measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy advanced ML models for cross-sell, upsell, deep-sell, and look-alike use cases to maximise customer lifetime value and revenue per customer.
  • Develop customer segmentation, propensity scoring, next-best-action, and recommendation engines that inform personalised engagement strategies.
  • Automate end-to-end model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring) using AWS SageMaker Pipelines and MLOps best practices.
  • Leverage LLMs (Claude/Anthropic) and AWS Bedrock for insight generation, automated commentary, personalised content creation, and agentic workflows that augment human decision-making.
  • Translate model outputs into clear, actionable business recommendations for product managers, marketing leads, and senior leadership.
  • Conduct rigorous A/B testing and champion-challenger frameworks to measure model impact on business KPIs.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure robust feature pipelines and data quality for model inputs.
  • Mentor junior data scientists and establish best practices for model development, documentation, and reproducibility.

In order to be successful at this role, you must have the following:

  • Master's or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a quantitative discipline.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in data science with a strong focus on business/commercial analytics in banking, financial services, or consumer platforms.
  • Proven track record building and deploying production-grade predictive models (propensity, recommendation, segmentation, LTV).
  • Deep expertise in statistical methods: regression, classification, ensemble methods, Bayesian inference, time-series analysis.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker (Training Jobs, Endpoints, Pipelines, Feature Store) for model automation and deployment.
  • Experience with LLM/GenAI tools (Claude, GPT) for prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Exceptional business acumen - ability to connect data patterns to revenue, cost, and customer experience outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills to present complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock for building GenAI-powered applications and agents.
  • Familiarity with causal inference methods and uplift modelling for campaign optimisation.
  • Experience in retail banking products (cards, loans, deposits, wealth) and customer lifecycle analytics.
  • Knowledge of MLOps frameworks, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and drift detection.
  • Experience building real-time scoring systems and feature engineering at scale.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Strong proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker (Training Jobs, Endpoints, Pipelines, Feature Store) for model automation and deployment.
  • Experience with LLM/GenAI tools (Claude, GPT) for prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock for building GenAI-powered applications and agents.
  • Knowledge of MLOps frameworks, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and drift detection.

title: Market Intelligence & Reporting Analyst, Global Ocean Freight
description:
Mondiale VGL is a globally recognised transport and logistics provider with roots in Oceania and operations in 19 markets.

For over 40 years, we’ve connected people, places and possibilities - moving freight and building careers across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Europe and the USA.

We offer fully integrated, end-to-end logistics services, including sea and air freight, import and export, wharf transport, customs clearance, and warehousing.

Our scale and reach help businesses operate more efficiently across borders and supply chains – and our team of 1,500+ people brings diverse perspectives and shared ambition.

We’re proud of our heritage and the platform it provides for people and businesses to grow. Be part of a company that gets things moving – and build a career that moves with it.



Job Description

We are looking for a Market Intelligence & Reporting Analyst, Global Ocean Freight to join Mondiale VGL’s global Ocean Freight team. The role can be based in either Singapore or Hong Kong and will report to the Global Head of Ocean Freight.

This is a global role at the centre of our Ocean Freight business, providing the market intelligence, data and reporting needed to support commercial and operational decision-making across our regions. You will monitor ocean freight rates, carrier capacity, schedule reliability, market developments and other factors affecting global ocean trade, turning this information into clear, practical insights for our Ocean Freight, commercial and senior leadership teams.

You will develop and maintain reporting and dashboards covering areas such as volumes, revenue, gross profit, yield and performance across regions, trade lanes, products and carriers. You will also track performance against allocations, commitments, contract targets and business plans, identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities.

Working closely with teams across the business, including Finance, IT, Business Intelligence and our Manila Shared Services team, you will help create a consistent global view of Ocean Freight performance, improve data quality and make our reporting simpler and more effective. You will also provide analysis to support carrier negotiations, tenders, RFQs and business reviews, as well as preparing presentations and materials for senior management and the CEO.

Alongside the analytical side of the role, you will provide business and administrative support to the Global Head of Ocean Freight, including coordinating meetings and travel, preparing agendas and papers, and keeping track of key actions and follow-ups.



Qualifications

  • At least three years’ experience in analytics, reporting or market intelligence, ideally within ocean freight, shipping or logistics.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, practical business insight.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Qlik or Tableau.
  • Working knowledge of ocean freight markets, rate indices and the carrier landscape.
  • Strong written communication and PowerPoint skills.
  • A high level of organisation, accuracy and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across regions and time zones.
  • Sound judgement and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, data analytics, supply chain or a related field.

Additional Information

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible global role, working with teams across Australia, New Zealand, Asia, Europe and the Americas. You will have the opportunity to shape how we use market intelligence and data across our Ocean Freight business and provide insights that directly support commercial and operational decisions.

If you are analytical, curious and proactive, and enjoy turning data into information people can use, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now to join our global Ocean Freight team in Singapore or Hong Kong.

We believe our people are our greatest strength — and the diversity of our team is central to how we grow and succeed. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to thrive. With operations spanning the globe, we know we’re better together when our team reflects the diversity of the communities and customers we work with every day.

title: Privacy & Anonymization Research Engineer
description:
Pragmatike is seeking a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build systems that safely turn sensitive data into usable AI training material. You will own the detection, redaction, and anonymization pipelines, ensuring privacy without sacrificing data utility.

The role centers on developing methods to detect PII, implement safeguarding transformations, and evaluate privacy risk across production data and ML workflows. Collaboration across time zones is expected.

Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case. Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods. Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation. Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts. Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields. Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards. Strong proficiency in Python and building production data or ML systems. Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification for detecting rare or sensitive content. Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility. Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data – and when each is appropriate. High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes. Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end. Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones. Hands-on privacy-enhancing technologies and sensitive data experience is a plus.

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (Embedded Development, On-Device Integration)
description:
Gateway Search is proud to partner with one of the automotive technology company building AI-powered computing platforms for software-defined vehicles, with a focus on intelligent cockpit systems and autonomous driving. Due to business expansion in Singapore, they are looking to bring in Senior Member of Technical Staff (Embedded Development, On-Device Integration).


Job Summary

As an Embedded AI Engineer, you will develop and optimize on-device AI systems for cloud–edge collaborative computing, integrating model routing, lightweight language models, and AI agent runtimes on embedded hardware. You will focus on improving inference performance, memory efficiency, power consumption, and system reliability, ensuring AI applications run efficiently, responsively, and securely on resource-constrained devices.


Responsibilities

  • Own on-device integration of the model routing stack: runtime bring-up, memory and thermal budgets, model loading and switching, and fallback behaviour when the cloud is unavailable or slow.
  • Co-design the device–cloud interface — what crosses the boundary, when, and with what guarantees — with the routing algorithm team, and push back when a design cannot survive real hardware.
  • Profile and optimise end-to-end latency on real hardware; make the "local first" path genuinely fast rather than nominally fast, including cold start, steady state, and everything in between.
  • Build the measurement harness that tells us what the device can sustain under load, and turn that into hard constraints the algorithms must respect.
  • Own stability in the field: watchdog behaviour, recovery from bad states, and diagnostics that let us debug a device we do not have in front of us.
  • Work with hardware and systems partners on deployment, updates, and diagnostics, and be the person who can tell a vendor bug from ours.


Requirements

  • Strong background in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with solid proficiency in C/C++ and low-level system debugging.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing machine learning inference on resource-constrained devices, including NPU, DSP, or GPU acceleration.
  • Strong understanding of model quantization, operator support, memory optimization, performance profiling, and power efficiency for on-device AI workloads.
  • Demonstrated engineering capabilities through shipped hardware products, optimized inference runtimes or kernels, measurable performance improvements, open-source contributions, or technical competition achievements.
  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering by translating AI models and research implementations into efficient, reliable, and deployable embedded solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to identify performance bottlenecks and address real-world hardware and runtime constraints.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
XP Power is a global leader in providing essential power solutions to the Industrial Technology, Healthcare and Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment sectors. We design and manufacture power controllers, the essential hardware component in every piece of electrical equipment that converts power from the electricity grid into the right form for equipment to function. Listed on the London Stock Exchange we are a fast-growing business, serving our global blue-chip customer base from 29 locations across Europe, North America, and Asia. Joining our team means you’ll work in a high performing global organisation where employees collaborate and strive to make XP Power the first-choice power solutions provider delivering the ultimate experience for our customers and our people.



Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with strong hands-on experience in production test engineering, test automation, test fixture design and ATE development. The candidate will take ownership of the development, implementation, qualification, and continuous improvement of production test systems electronic power conversion / power supplies products. This role requires a strong combination of hardware, software, test automation, troubleshooting, and manufacturing test experience.

Reporting to the Test Engineering Manager, the successful candidate will work closely with Design Team, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers to develop robust and efficient test solutions from product development through mass production.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Power Electronics & Digital Control Testing

  • Develop automated testing for power supply electrical performance and protection.
  • Develop production tests solutions for power supplies, AC/DC and DC/DC converter products incorporating digital control, microcontrollers and communications interfaces.
  • Support debugging of hardware, firmware, communication, and test-system issues

Test Jig & Fixture Development

  • Work with PCB, mechanical, and external suppliers to develop robust and reliable test fixtures.
  • Design and develop production test jigs, fixtures, interface boards, cable harnesses and test adapters as per electrical and mechanical requirements.
  • Ensure electrical and operator safety, ESD protection, grounding, shielding, contacts resistance and connector durability.

Production & Manufacturing Support

  • Provide technical leadership in resolving production test failures and manufacturing issues.
  • Perform failure analysis and root-cause investigation to identify product, test-system, fixture, software/test-program, process, or operator-related issues, and implement corrective actions.
  • Analyse test data, yield, false failures, and test escapes to improve quality.

Test Specification & Process Development

  • Develop test specifications, methods, limits, procedures, test coverage and training materials.
  • Define appropriate test limits based on product specifications, measurement capability, process variation and statistical data.
  • Optimize test coverage, test time, cost and reliability.

NPI & Product Transfer

  • Work closely with design engineers and manufacturing team to define Design for Testability (DFT) requirements and production test strategies for new products.
  • Qualify and release ATE systems, fixtures, and test software.
  • Support production ramp-up and transfer test systems to manufacturing sites.

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the technical owner for assigned production test systems.
  • Drive continuous improvements in automation, test coverage, test time, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Evaluate new test technologies and work with external suppliers.

ATE & Automated Test System Development (Good to have)

  • Develop ATE systems and automated production test programs.
  • Integrate instruments such as AC sources, electronic loads, DMMs, oscilloscopes, and DAQ systems.
  • Develop test software using LabVIEW, Python, C/C++, and instrument communication protocols using SCPI, Ethernet, USB, RS-232/485, CAN, I²C, SPI, UART, etc.

Qualifications

  • Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in test engineering, ATE, production testing, or electronics manufacturing, with strong hands-on experience in automated test systems.
  • Proven experience in developing, debugging, and implementing ATE and automated production test programs.
  • Strong knowledge of analogue/digital electronics and power electronics, with hands-on experience in electrical and performance testing.
  • Strong hands-on experience with test instrumentation, including programmable power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs, oscilloscopes, DAQ systems, and automated test equipment.
  • Experienced in designing, troubleshooting, and improving production test jigs, fixtures, interface boards, and test harnesses.
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety, high-voltage testing, ESD, grounding, creepage, and clearance requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation skills, with the ability to lead corrective and preventive actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to take technical ownership, work independently, and lead cross-functional problem-solving activities.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with design, manufacturing, quality, and external suppliers.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English, with willingness to travel when required.

  • Preferred Skills

    • Experience with test data analysis, SPC, yield improvement, and automated production reports.

title: Wildland Fire & Resource Technician Flex 2/3 (PCN 10-9522)
description:
Job Description


The Department of Natural Resources, Division of Forestry & Fire Protection, is recruiting for a Wildland Fire & Resource Technician 2/3 Flex in Fairbanks.


What You Will Be Doing:

As a Wildland Fire & Resource Technician 2/3, you will:

  • Ensure the "10 Standard Firefighting Orders" and "18 Situations that Shout Watch Out" are implemented during suppression operations, and report safety issues to the supervisor.
  • Engage in fire suppression and fuels treatment activities as a member of an engine, helitack, or hand crew.
  • Safely operate basic firefighting equipment such as chainsaws, hand tools, pumps, GPS, and radios.
  • Perform as an incident commander on initial and extended attack fires, provide accurate size-ups, and develop appropriate suppression strategies and tactics.
  • Be available for Alaska and Lower-48 fire assignments in remote and austere conditions for up to 14-21 days.
  • Attend classroom and fireline training to advance fire management and professional development skills.

As a Wildland Fire & Resource Technician 3, you will also:

  • Perform as a journey-level firefighter
  • Provide training and mentorship to Tech 1s, 2s, and EFF.
  • Ensure subordinates maintain fire readiness
  • Depending on qualification, coordinate and lead wildland fire training classes up to the 300 level.
  • Serve as the initial level of problem-solving with employees.

Mission and Values/Culture:

The Division of Forestry and Fire Protection's mission is to protect the lives and property of Alaskans from wildfires and to manage Alaska's forest resources for maximum sustainable yield. Fairbanks Area Forestry's fire suppression responsibilities encompass approximately 9 million acres in central interior Alaska, including the Fairbanks North Star and Denali Boroughs. In many locations, FAF is the primary and sometimes only fire department response to wildfires.


Fairbanks Area's core structure is comprised of highly motivated firefighters who excel under adverse conditions, possess a strong, can-do work ethic, emphasize personal and professional integrity through continuous improvement, and are committed to building a team-focused wildland firefighter community.

Wildland Fire and Resource Technicians are leaders entrusted with ensuring Alaska fulfills its duty to provide safe, competent, and community-focused wildfire protection and sustainable forest management for Alaska's diverse user groups.

Benefits of Joining Our Team:

Selected candidates will join a high-performing, community-oriented organization that provides tip-of-the-spear firefighting response to wildfires threatening Alaska's residents, communities, and infrastructure. Safety-minded, team-oriented individuals who thrive in a learning environment will have ample opportunities for upward mobility and training.


This position is especially attractive to those who enjoy working outdoors, traveling across Alaska and the Lower 48, are interested in a dynamic, challenge-filled first responder career path, and are committed to public service.


The work schedule is seasonal and can be flexible. However, commitment to the position and the ability to work long hours on short notice in remote field conditions for extended periods are expected and required.

The Working Environment You Can Expect:

Fairbanks Area Forestry resides along the banks of the Chena River in downtown Fairbanks, Alaska. FAF's fire suppression organization is comprised of Type-6 & 7 engines, Helitack, Prevention, the White Mountain Type-2IA hand crew, EFF Type-2 hand crews, and dozer operations. Personnel staff engines, helicopters, and hand crews daily and are ready to respond to wildfires not only within FAF's protection area, but across Alaska.

When not on fires, fire staff are regularly engaged in training and fuels mitigation projects that enhance strategic and tactical fire suppression options and strengthen community wildland fire protection.

A high level of physical fitness is required, and all initial attack personnel are expected to participate in daily physical training and complete the required annual fitness testing.

Fairbanks is the hub of Interior Alaska and an epicenter for outdoor recreation, including camping, boating, hiking, fishing, and photography. Fairbanks International Airport is located minutes away from FAF and is the primary departure point for reaching Alaska's far reaches.

We are looking for a candidate who possesses the following position-specific competencies.

  • Fire Management: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, and theories of fire management, including the characteristics, behavior, and ecology of fire; methodologies, strategies, and equipment used in prescribed fires; fire detection, prevention, and suppression strategies; and integration of fire with natural resource management.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations; is sensitive to cultural diversity, race, gender, disabilities, and other individual differences.
  • Adaptability: Adjusts planned work by gathering relevant information and applying critical thinking to address multiple demands and competing priorities in a changing environment.
  • Teamwork: Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.
  • Physical Strength and Agility: Ability to bend, lift, climb, stand, and walk for long periods of time; ability to perform moderately heavy laboring work.

Minimum Qualifications

Wildland Fire & Resource Technician 2 - starting salary $28.91 per hour

Six months of trainee or entry-level wildland firefighting or forestry field experience. The required experience is met by service as a Wildland Fire and Resource Technician 1 with the State of Alaska or the equivalent with another employer.

And
Red Card qualification under the National Incident Qualification System (see required job qualifications special note).


Wildland Fire & Resource Technician 3 - starting salary $32.67 per hour

Twelve months of wildland firefighting or forestry field experience, including at least six months at the developmental level. The required developmental experience is met by service as a Wildland Fire and Resource Technician 2 with the State of Alaska or the equivalent with another employer.

And
Red Card qualification under the National Incident Qualification System (see required job qualifications special note).


Education substitution applies to the Wildland Fire & Resource Technicians 2 and 3
Completed coursework from an accredited college or vocational-technical school in forestry, fire science, or a closely related field may substitute for six months of general field experience. (For college, 3 semester hours or 4 quarter hours equal one month of work experience. Transcripts or a letter from a vocational-technical school must indicate a college credit equivalency for the completed coursework. For example, at Alaska Vocational Technical Center: Forest Ecology = 3 semester credits; Forest Regeneration = 2 semester credits; Timber Harvesting and Sale Administration = 4 semester credits; and Wildland Fire Management = 3 semester credits.)

There is no substitution for the six months of developmental experience.

There is no substitution for the National Incident Qualification System (Red Card) qualifications.

Special Notes:

  • Applicants must be at least eighteen years of age.
  • Most positions require National Incident Qualification System certifications. Because there are different specialty areas in this field, recruitment and selection will be made from among those candidates who meet the experience and the basic National Incident Qualification System training requirements specifically listed within the recruitment bulletin. The specialty areas are within one of the following functions: fire operations, wildland fire prevention, and aviation support.
  • Applicant must pass the Work Capacity Test at the "Arduous" level as defined in Federal Publication PMS 307, Work Capacity Test Administrator's Guide. This test requires that the applicant complete a 3-mile hike carrying a 45-pound pack over level terrain in 45 minutes or less.
  • Applicant must possess an Alaska driver's license. An individual without an Alaska driver's license who meets the minimum age and experience requirements may apply for the vacancy. An applicant qualifying under this option may receive a job offer conditional upon obtaining an Alaska driver's license. Proof of licensure will be required prior to reporting to duty.
  • Positions may require travel both in and out of state for fire suppression assignments; stand-by or recall status during the fire season; availability for assignments in and out of the area that require absence from the duty station for 14 to 21 days; flying in small fixed-wing aircraft or helicopters; and handling hazardous materials.
  • Some positions may require a commercial driver's license with appropriate endorsements.

Additional Required Information

At the time of application, the applicant must attach the following items as individual documents; failure to provide the requested documentation will result in non-consideration. If you are unable to attach the requested document(s), please email the contact listed below. Required documents include:

SPECIAL NOTICES/Additional Requirements

  • Frequent in- and out-of-state travel on assignments lasting 14-21 days.

  • Frequent travel on helicopters and fixed wing aircraft may be required.

This position is currently under review as part of the Forest and Fire Management job class study. Therefore, both the title and the assigned pay range may change upon completion of the study.


Application Notice

You can ONLY apply for this position through the Workplace Alaska website or by submitting a paper application. Instructions for applying are available on the Workplace Alaska How to Apply webpage. Your application must be received by 5:00 p.m. Alaska Standard Time on the closing date.

Supplemental Questions

The State of Alaska (SOA) uses four proficiency levels to measure and describe an applicant’s ability to apply behaviors, knowledge, skills, and abilities to accomplish a specific task. The four proficiency levels are Mastery, Fluency, Literacy, and Discovery. You must rate your proficiency level for each competency listed in the supplemental questions.

Education

If you have not yet obtained a degree, please indicate the units you have completed. Copies of transcripts are required to verify educational credentials if you use them to meet the minimum qualifications for a position.


Special Instructions for Foreign Education

Education completed at foreign colleges or universities may be used to meet the minimum qualifications listed above. If using this education to meet minimum qualification requirements, you must demonstrate that the credentials have been submitted to a private organization specializing in interpreting foreign educational credentials and that such education has been deemed at least equivalent to that gained in standard U.S. education programs. Alternatively, an accredited U.S. post-secondary institution must report that the other institution's transcript is given full value or that full value is recognized in relevant subject areas aligned with the post-secondary institution's curricula. If they are not, the applicant may not advance to the recruitment interview and selection phase.


Note: Attaching a resume does not substitute for completing the application in full. Noting "see resume" or any similar response on any portion of your application may lead to a determination that your application is incomplete and removal from consideration for this job posting.

A "misdemeanor crime of domestic violence" is an offense that is (1) a misdemeanor under Federal or state law and (2) has, as an element, the use or attempted use of physical force or the threatened use of a deadly weapon, committed by a current or former spouse, parent, or guardian of the victim, by a person with whom the victim shares a child in common, by a person who is cohabiting with or has cohabited with the victim as a spouse, parent, or guardian, or by a person similarly situated to a spouse, parent, or guardian of the victim.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Singapore Exams & Assessment Board

  • Write clear, unambiguous technical specifications that serve as effective context for junior engineers and AI-tools

title: UX Designer
company: JSIT for WST (Wholesale Trade) by Singapore Business Federation (SBF)
description:
This role is posted on behalf of Activate Interactive Pte Ltd with support from the Singapore Business Federation (SBF) under the JSIT WST initiative. SBF/JSIT facilitates outreach and connections only and does not act as an employment agency. All hiring decisions are made solely by the hiring company.


Our member company is seeking a meticulous and motivated UX Designer to join the team In this role, you will play a critical part in designing user-centred digital experiences by mapping complex workflows, developing and testing prototypes, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver intuitive solutions.


Job Responsibilities

  • Understand the Broader Programme Context : Build an understanding of programme objectives, operational needs, policy and technical constraints, and the relationships between products and services. Use this context to guide design decisions and balance immediate user needs with longer-term programme outcomes.
  • Map Complex Workflows Across Touchpoints: Investigate and map end-to-end journeys spanning different user roles, teams, systems, and channels. Identify decision points, branching paths, exceptions, dependencies, and handoffs—including activities outside the digital interface—to uncover gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Transform Complexity into Clarity: Translate complex, technical government workflows into intuitive and accessible experiences. Design for both common tasks and less frequent scenarios, ensuring users understand what to do next and can recover when things do not go as expected.
  • Champion User-Centred Design: Engage stakeholders and end-users to understand their needs, motivations, and operational realities. Advocate for the user perspective throughout the product development lifecycle while accounting for the needs of other users and teams within the wider service.
  • Prototype and Test Early :Turn ideas into sketches, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore alternatives and test assumptions quickly. Choose the level of fidelity needed to answer the question at hand, gather feedback, and help teams make informed decisions.
  • Collaborate and Influence Across Teams: Work with product managers, engineers, and programme stakeholders to align teams on shared workflows, resolve competing needs, and ensure design feasibility and fidelity. Communicate design rationale, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to support informed decisions.


Job Requirement

  • Experience: At least 3 years of professional experience in UX or Product Design, including experience designing for complex workflows involving multiple user roles, systems, or service touchpoints.
  • Workflow and Systems Thinking: Demonstrated ability to understand and model branching workflows, decision points, exceptions, and cross-team handoffs. You can connect detailed user interactions to the wider service and recognize the downstream effects of design decisions.
  • Programme-Level Understanding: Experience working within a broader programme or an environment involving multiple connected products or services. You can understand shared objectives, dependencies, and constraints, and use them to inform product-level design decisions.
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating research, synthesis, interaction design, prototyping, and visual design skills. Include examples showing how you made sense of a complex problem, mapped connected workflows, and used a broader understanding of the service or programme to shape your solution. Explain your contribution, how you tested and refined ideas, key trade-offs, and outcomes.
  • Tool Proficiency: Proficiency in industry-standard design and prototyping tools, such as Figma, and the ability to communicate complex journeys and workflows through clear visual artefacts.
  • Technical Understanding : Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML and CSS, and an understanding of how technical constraints influence user experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for design exploration, prototyping, or communicating ideas is useful. Coding skills are a plus, but not required.


Key Traits

  • User and Stakeholder Empathy: You seek to understand users’ and stakeholders’ frustrations, motivations, and the context in which they work.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: You ask questions that uncover hidden assumptions and dependencies, bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and actively learn new tools and approaches.
  • Breadth and Attention to Detail: You can move between the broader programme view and the details of an individual interaction, keeping both connected as you design.
  • Ownership and Initiative: You contribute ideas, take responsibility for decisions, and follow through beyond handoff to understand whether the delivered solution works for users.
  • Communication: You are an articulate presenter and active listener who can explain complex workflows and design decisions to non-designers and build shared understanding across teams.
  • Organizational Skills: You can manage multiple workstreams, recognise dependencies, and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced agile environment.
  • Team Spirit: You work collaboratively, welcome feedback, and enjoy solving meaningful problems with others.


We thank all applicants for their interest. Due to the volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Please note that applicants must already possess valid work authorization to work in Singapore at the time of application.


You may send your application to: michael.tan@activate.sg

title: Back End Developer (PHP, Java)
description:
Secretlab is an international gaming chair brand seating over two million users worldwide, with our key markets in the United States, Europe and Singapore, where we are headquartered.

Our Tech team is responsible for planning, developing, maintaining, and optimizing our websites. Your role will involve cross-functional collaboration with multiple departments for the development and improvement of new and existing in-house solutions to better assist them in achieving their goals.


This role will be essential for Secretlab’s global audience to enjoy access to our award-winning products, as well as the collaborative work with world-renowned brands such as Game of Thrones, Batman, Cloud9 and international esports organizers Riot Games for their League of Legends global tournaments.


Responsibilities

  • Design hybrid schemas that leverage the strengths of both SQL (for relational integrity) and NoSQL (for scale and flexibility)
  • Design decoupled microservices using event-driven patterns (Pub/Sub, Event Sourcing, CQRS)
  • Own the lifecycle of an event, from emission to consumption, ensuring zero data loss and system stability.
  • Develop and maintain core services across both our Java and PHP ecosystems.
  • Build a secure and scalable infrastructure (clear, well-documented, and easy to maintain code)
  • Work cross-functionally with teams such as Marketing, Operations, and Logistics to gather requirements for designing and enhancing internal solutions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. (Equivalent professional experience will be considered for candidates with an exceptional track record)
  • A minimum of 4+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production-grade backend systems.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience specifically managing event-driven architectures (EDA). You should have experience deploying services that handle asynchronous workflows at scale
  • Demonstrated experience managing Dual-Persistence strategies. You must show how you’ve successfully utilized both SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) for relational integrity and NoSQL (MongoDB/DynamoDB) for high-availability/scale
  • A "Security-First" approach to coding, with a solid grasp of OWASP principles and data encryption at rest/in transit

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB. You know when to trade consistency for availability and how to design schemas for horizontal scale.
  • Expert-level knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL. You should be comfortable with advanced indexing, query optimization, and managing ACID compliance in a distributed environment.
  • Proficient with Redis or Memcached for lightning-fast state management and as a buffer for high-volume event processing.
  • AWS Mastery: Experience with core services including Lambda (for event-driven functions), EC2, RDS/Aurora, and S3.


Bonuses

  • Experience working in the e-commerce sector, knowledge with payment gateway, fraud management, fulfillment

title: Engineering Manager - Pipelines
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Pipelines based in Mexico.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a globally distributed team responsible for building and scaling a managed data pipeline and change data capture product. In this role, you will oversee the development and operation of systems that replicate data from PostgreSQL databases to analytical platforms and other destinations. You will combine technical expertise with strong people leadership, taking ownership of team development, engineering delivery, and product reliability. Working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional stakeholders, you will establish technical standards, manage priorities, and ensure dependable data replication, recovery, and performance. You will also guide hiring, roadmap execution, incident management, and continuous improvement within a remote-first environment. This is an opportunity to shape a developer-focused data product while building a high-performing engineering team in a fast-moving, open-source technology ecosystem.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

As Engineering Manager - Pipelines, you will lead the people, technical delivery, and operational responsibilities of the Pipelines engineering team, ensuring the successful development and reliability of complex data replication systems. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Build and maintain a healthy, high-trust engineering culture within a globally distributed and remote-first team.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, manage performance evaluations, support career development, and oversee onboarding for direct reports.
  • Handle team administration, including leave management, time-off requests, and other people-related responsibilities.
  • Hiring and Team Growth: Own the team's hiring strategy and recruitment process, acting as the hiring manager and conducting initial interviews for all team positions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to identify, attract, interview, and recruit high-performing engineering professionals.
  • Contribute to workforce planning, organizational design, headcount allocation, and the continued development of engineering leadership.
  • Roadmap and Delivery Management: Own the team's technical roadmap and project management processes, using Linear to establish priorities, milestones, and accountability.
  • Manage incoming requests and communications through Slack and other internal channels, ensuring cross-functional requests are appropriately prioritized, assigned, or challenged.
  • Coordinate weekly progress updates and maintain clear communication with stakeholders without introducing unnecessary administrative overhead.
  • Allocate engineering resources to customer support tickets and ensure the team consistently meets its Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Identify and communicate technical risks, dependencies, priorities, and trade-offs to senior leadership in a timely manner.
  • Technical Quality and Reliability: Participate in technical design discussions and help establish high engineering standards across architecture, testing, deployment, and operations.
  • Ensure data pipeline systems maintain correctness, ordering, reliable replication, and effective recovery mechanisms.
  • Support the development and operation of PostgreSQL replication infrastructure, including logical replication, replication slots, and Write-Ahead Log (WAL) retention.
  • Incident Management: Train and operate as an Incident Commander, coordinating teams during production incidents and driving timely resolution.
  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews, ensuring lessons learned are translated into concrete follow-up actions and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Foster a culture of operational ownership, continuous learning, and proactive risk management.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical background in data infrastructure and distributed systems, combined with a genuine passion for developing people and building effective teams. You should bring:

  • At least 5 years of software engineering experience, with sufficient technical depth to establish credibility with engineers working on complex infrastructure systems.
  • At least 3 years of experience managing remote engineering teams.
  • Previous experience leading teams responsible for building and operating data pipelines, change data capture (CDC), database replication, or streaming systems.
  • Strong technical understanding of data systems, including delivery guarantees, event ordering, idempotency, schema evolution, and backfill processes.
  • In-depth knowledge of PostgreSQL replication, particularly logical replication, Write-Ahead Logs (WAL), and replication slots, including their impact on production database performance.
  • Familiarity with analytical data destinations and platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg.
  • Proven experience leading teams through production incidents involving customer data, including coordinating resolution efforts and managing blameless post-incident reviews.
  • Experience delivering developer-facing data products to external customers.
  • Experience managing globally distributed teams working asynchronously across multiple time zones.
  • Strong people management capabilities, including performance management, career coaching, feedback delivery, and the ability to handle challenging management conversations.
  • A genuine commitment to people leadership, with the ability to empower engineers, remove blockers, provide context, and help individuals achieve their full potential.
  • Ability to build psychological safety, encourage constructive feedback, and foster a collaborative and supportive engineering culture.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to introduce structure, manage ambiguity, and guide teams through complex challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a preference for asynchronous communication, clear documentation, and proactive risk reporting.
  • A collaborative, adaptable, and low-ego leadership style, particularly when working with experienced engineers who value autonomy and ownership.

Additional Assets That Would Strengthen Your Application

  • Practical experience with Rust, particularly in systems programming or data infrastructure development.
  • Experience working within open-source technology ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with developer-focused platforms and globally distributed engineering organizations.

Benefits

  • Coworking allowance: Access to a WeWork membership or coworking allowance to support your preferred working environment.
  • Equity ownership: Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing every team member to share in the company's long-term success.

  • Comprehensive health coverage: 100% employer-paid health insurance for employees and 80% coverage for dependents, regardless of location.
  • Annual company off-sites: Opportunities to join company-wide gatherings in different international locations for collaboration, connection, and team-building.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Asynchronous work culture that allows employees to manage their schedules independently.
  • Professional development: Annual education allowance for courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities.
  • International collaboration: Opportunity to work alongside a diverse global team across more than 60 countries and 20 languages.
  • Open-source environment: Opportunity to contribute to and help shape tools within a growing developer-focused technology ecosystem.

Position: Senior Software Engineer (C++ stack) for Semiconductor Equipment Control – FAB Feature Integration (MFC/Qt)


As a Senior Software Engineer for semiconductor equipment control software, you will be involved in the full software engineering lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, analysis, and maintenance, with a growth path towards technical leadership. This role is focused on FAB feature integration and delivery, primarily using C++, and building/integrating desktop and engineering tooling using MFC/Qt.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with architects and tech leads to define design decisions and interfaces within your domain (e.g., module boundaries, integration interfaces, dependencies).
  • Perform requirement analysis and deliver feature integration in FAB environments.
  • Implement and test software features; support integration, regression, debugging, and maintenance.
  • Conduct peer reviews and follow quality practices to ensure maintainability and delivery readiness.
  • Work as part of a Scrum/Agile team, delivering user stories across the stack and collaborating with cross-functional members.


The Job Scope

In practice, you will mainly work on:

  • Desktop and engineering tooling and UI integration using MFC/Qt.
  • Aligning with the broader equipment control software context (e.g., host interfaces such as SECS/GEM and EDA, simulation/testing environments, and a layered architecture).

Technically, this role focuses on developing testable, maintainable, high-quality semiconductor equipment control software features, primarily in C++, and delivering feature integration in FAB environments. In practice, you will mainly work on desktop and engineering tooling and UI integration using MFC/Qt, while aligning with the broader equipment control software context (e.g., host interfaces such as SECS/GEM and EDA, simulation/testing environments, and a layered architecture).

Specifically, the job scope covers the following layers and integration points:

  • Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL): enable programmable access to equipment components.
  • Devices / Domain layers: model module behavior and state machines; integrate across module boundaries.
  • Application layer: support higher-level functions such as recipe management and calibration.
  • UI / HMI layer: implement and integrate on-site engineering tools and desktop UI using MFC/Qt.
  • Simulation & Testing: leverage system/unit testing and simulators to validate integration and regressions.
  • Host Interfaces: collaborate around SECS/GEM, GEM300, and EDA / Interface A as needed to ensure FAB usability.


Job requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automation, or a related field.
  • Experience in equipment control or industrial software development is a plus.
  • Strong C++ object-oriented programming skills; familiarity with the C++ standard library (STL).
  • Desktop UI and engineering tooling experience using MFC and/or Qt.
  • Familiar with git workflows and continuous integration (CI) tools.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or Kanban teams.


DESIRABLE SKILLSET

  • Understanding of factory software context (e.g., Host/EAP, SECS/GEM, EDA) and related integration scenarios.
  • Strong system integration and on-site debugging capability in FAB integration contexts.
  • Experience with unit testing and TDD/BDD practices (e.g., xUnit, Boost.Test, reqnroll).



WHAT WE CAN OFFER

Our employees are our strength and together we want to achieve the maximum. That is why we invest a lot in our employees, through generous development budgets and personal attention. According to our employees, this is what makes the difference at Sioux. We are proud of that. For us, success is more than just a good salary: it is also about feeling valued, getting responsibilities, and to be able continuously develop oneself.

  • Internal training, coaching, and a generous development budget of 5000 SGD/ per year
  • Varied work due to the diversity in technologies, markets, and projects
  • Competitive salary, AWS, and variable bonus
  • An open culture that focuses on collaboration, learning, and having fun
  • An innovative work environment


Job Location

Our office is conveniently located next to the Tai Seng MRT station.
