title: Floodplains by Design Grant Program Lead (Environmental Planner 4)
description:
Description



Keeping Washington Clean and Evergreen



The Department of Ecology is hiring a Floodplains by Design Grant Program Lead (Environmental Planner 4) within the Shorelands & Environmental Assistance (SEA) program.

Location:

  • Headquarters Office in Lacey, WA.
  • Upon hire, you must live within a commutable distance from the duty station.

Schedule:

  • This position is eligible for telework and flexible schedule options.
  • Regular attendance at an Ecology office, including time spent at the HQ building in Lacey, for team meetings and similar activities is expected.
  • Schedules are dependent upon position needs and are subject to change.

Please Note: This is a project position with funding through 06/30/2028, with the potential for further extension based on legislative appropriation.

Application Timeline:

  • Apply by December 6, 2026
  • Applications

    submitted after the date above may be reviewed only if additional qualified

    applicants are needed.



Duties

Ecology’s statewide Floodplain Management Team is growing, and we are excited to invite candidates to apply for the Floodplains by Design Grant Program Lead position. This is a unique opportunity to lead planning, policy coordination, and day-to-day administration of our award winning Floodplains by Design (FbD) grant program, a major component of the umbrella FbD initiative that is shaping the future direction of integrated floodplain management in Washington.

You will have significant internal responsibilities for FbD grant program operations and for ensuring we deliver outstanding service to our partners and customers.

You will work at the intersection of state, Tribal, federal, local, and nongovernmental partners, coordinating closely with Ecology’s nongovernmental (NGO) backbone partner, Bonneville Environmental Foundation (BEF), to ensure the FbD grant program remains effective, responsive, and aligned with the goals of the FbD initiative.

Within Ecology, you will provide authoritative recommendations on FbD grant program operations, including developing tools and processes that support program consistency, adaptive management, and informed executive decision-making. You will help guide the work of regional staff who serve as project managers for individual FbD grants; track and report on FbD grant program spending and accomplishments; and work with senior staff and leaders to develop and advance funding strategies and major policy initiatives.


What you will do:

• Lead Ecology’s engagement on FbD grant program activities with the FbD NGO backbone partner, and coordinate with Tribes, local governments, state and federal agencies, and other partners to support collaborative decision-making, program alignment, and advancement of shared FbD grant program outcomes.

• Develop and refine statewide grant program procedures, tools, and tracking systems; review and approve grant agreements; and support consistent implementation by coaching, advising, and coordinating with Ecology’s grant and financial management staff.

• Represent the FbD grant program on internal and interagency work groups, facilitating information exchange; addressing policy or implementation issues; and ensuring program decisions are communicated effectively to partners and leadership.

• Provide authoritative analysis and recommendations on funding strategies, grant program policies, process improvements, and long-range planning needs to inform Ecology leadership and budget development.

• Support and advise broader FbD initiative activities—such as Steering Group and Action Group meetings—and keep internal staff and external partners informed of FbD grant program plans, schedules, and emerging issues.

• Manage grant program records and information in accordance with agency requirements, and perform additional duties as assigned to support SEA Program priorities.

Qualifications

For detailed information on how we calculate experience, please visit our Recruitment website.

Required Qualifications:

Nine (9) years of experience and/or education as described below:

Professional experience with the following:

  • Managing multi-partner environmental or community-based grants;
  • Coordinating with diverse governmental and nongovernmental partners;
  • Developing and implementing program processes and procedures;
  • Leading policy-related planning efforts; and
  • Preparing or reviewing program-related recommendations, analyses, or documentation

Experience described above must include demonstrated ability in the following skill sets:

1. Program & Policy Implementation
Ability to carry out complex environmental or planning program responsibilities, align operations with defined policy direction, and ensure consistent and effective program delivery.

2. Grant Administration & Process Management
Skill in updating, developing, and applying established grant program processes and procedures; coordinating grant program operations; reviewing agreements for accuracy and consistency; and using tracking tools to support reporting, evaluation, and adaptive program management.

3. Partnership Coordination & Partner Engagement
Ability to work collaboratively and constructively with Tribes, local governments, federal and state agencies, NGOs, and technical partners to exchange information; coordinate activities and assist with developing, implementing, and evaluating progress made towards achieving shared planning and/or policy goals.

4. Communication & Facilitation
Skill in clearly conveying technical information, facilitating discussions to gather input or guide decisions, and presenting well-reasoned recommendations verbally and in writing.

5. Analytical & Strategic Thinking
Ability to identify trends, interpret data or policy information, evaluate options, and recommend approaches for program improvements, statewide consistency, or long-range planning.

6. Coaching & Technical Guidance
Skill in providing direction, mentoring, or process guidance to project managers or planning staff to support consistent implementation of program procedures and improve overall program effectiveness.

Education: Involving a major study in land use, urban, regional, environmental, or natural resource planning, landscape architecture, geography, land use or environmental law, public administration with an environmental emphasis, hazard mitigation, or closely related field


A Bachelor’s degree in the above fields counts for 4 years and a Master’s degree in the above fields counts for 6 years.


Examples of how to qualify:

  • 9 years of experience.
  • 8 years of experience AND 30-59 semester or 45-89 quarter college credits.
  • 7 years of experience AND 60-89 semester or 90-134 quarter college credits (Associate’s degree).
  • 6 years of experience AND 90-119 semester or 135-179 quarter college credits.
  • 5 years of experience AND a Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 years of experience AND a Master’s degree or higher.


Special Requirements/Conditions of Employment:

Must possess and maintain a valid driver license.



Desired Qualifications:

• Experience working on integrated floodplain management, watershed restoration, and/or flood hazard mitigation programs or projects.
• Experience administering an entire grant program (as distinguished from managing individual grants).
• Experience leading or supporting process improvement initiatives or similar efforts.
• Ability to think strategically, maintain strong attention to detail, and work collaboratively.
• Ability to navigate comfortably between routine administrative tasks and creative, visioning-oriented work.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist — TrustIQ


Company: PathIQ Pte. Ltd.

Location: Singapore (on-site / hybrid)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Reports to: Head of TrustIQ


ABOUT PATHIQ


PathIQ is a Singapore-headquartered data and AI company. TrustIQ is our identity and trust API: a client sends a hashed email, hashed phone number or mobile ad ID, and we return consented, privacy-compliant signals that help banks, lenders and credit platforms decide who they are dealing with.


We are small, fast, profitable and building the trust layer that financial services in emerging and digital-first markets have been missing.


THE ROLE


You turn raw signals into scores that financial institutions will rely on.


TrustIQ is moving from returning attributes to returning scores. Working on top of our AWS data platform and ID graph, you will design, build and validate the models behind those scores, and prove to clients that they hold up. This is applied, commercial data science — the output is a score that is accurate, explainable and cheap to serve, not a paper.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN


Score design & modelling

• Design the trust and risk scores TrustIQ returns — define what each score means, what feeds it and how it is calibrated

• Build and tune models with per-attribute, per-country weights, using regression, gradient boosting and back-testing

• Evaluate modelling approaches (classic ML, LLM-based, hybrid) on accuracy, cost and explainability, and recommend what we ship


Feature engineering

• Turn mixed raw sources — programmatic, SDK, telco, transaction and commerce data — into clean, stable features

• Develop signals from device, location, behavioural, spend and identity-stability patterns

• Work with data engineering on the daily batch that stages, cleans and scores data into a precomputed feature and score table


Validation, bias & explainability

• Build the statistical framework that measures score accuracy, stability and confidence by market and segment

• Back-test scores against client outcomes and third-party benchmarks

• Detect and quantify bias — device skew, coverage gaps, demographic and geographic bias — and document it

• Produce model documentation that stands up to a regulated client's model-risk and compliance review


Partner data evaluation

• Assess prospective data sources before we commit — coverage, uniqueness, overlap, accuracy, refresh rate

• Quantify what each source adds to match rate and score quality, and what it duplicates

• Monitor ingested data for drift, degradation and anomalies over time


Accuracy & cost per lookup

• Own the trade-off between score quality and cost per API call — decide which inputs earn their place

• Track match rate, coverage and score performance in production and feed findings back into the models


Client & commercial support

• Design and analyse proof-of-concept tests with financial services clients, and turn results into evidence they can act on

• Present methodology credibly to risk, fraud and data teams

• Support product with feasibility, packaging and pricing input


WHAT YOU'LL NEED


Essential

• 4+ years applied data science, ideally in credit risk, fraud, identity, fintech, telco or alternative data

• Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and strong SQL

• Hands-on experience building and validating scoring or classification models — calibration, back-testing, AUC/KS/Gini, stability monitoring

• Solid grounding in statistics: sampling, significance testing, experimental design, bias correction

• Able to work with large, messy datasets in a cloud environment (AWS preferred) without needing everything pre-prepared for you

• Can explain a model to a non-technical or compliance audience and have them trust it

• Eligible to work in Singapore, or eligible for an Employment Pass


Advantageous

• Experience with credit scoring, fraud detection or KYC / onboarding risk models

• Identity resolution or ID graph experience (hashed email, phone, device IDs)

• Familiarity with model governance and explainability in regulated environments, and with data protection regimes such as PDPA or GDPR

• PySpark for large-scale feature work

• Experience applying LLMs or foundation models to structured or tabular data

• Experience working with banks, lenders or payments companies in APAC


FIRST 6 MONTHS — WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


• 30 days: Deep familiarity with our data assets, ID graph and live client proof-of-concepts; initial assessment of source quality, coverage and gaps

• 90 days: Validation framework in place; first scores built and back-tested for priority markets; modelling approach recommended

• 180 days: Scores live in the TrustIQ feed with measured accuracy, client-validated in at least one proof-of-concept, and a lower cost per lookup


WHY PATHIQ


• Build the scoring layer of a commercially live product from the start, with direct access to the Head of TrustIQ and the founders

• A profitable, growing business — not a burn-and-hope startup

• Rich, large-scale identity, behavioural and location data across APAC and global markets

• Competitive package and profit share


PathIQ is an equal opportunity employer.

Special Investigations Program Lead (ASA 5) - Internal Only
You must be a current employee of the Office of the Washington State Auditor to be eligible.

Our engineering team owns the consumer-facing and merchant-facing products on this platform, along with the BFF services behind them. 1. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
2. Solid frontend development experience, with deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React or another mainstream framework.
3. A proven track record of performance optimization in high-traffic consumer products, with a solid understanding of browser rendering, networking and Core Web Vitals.
4. Experience with hybrid/WebView development and with cross-platform compatibility across iOS, Android and desktop browsers.
5. Data-driven: comfortable defining metrics, running A/B experiments, and tying engineering work to business outcomes such as conversion.
6. Good written and spoken English for cross-regional collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with payments, checkout, e-commerce or fintech products.
- Experience with WebView performance techniques such as pre-rendering and offline packages.
- Experience in multi-end (Native/PC/Server) development.
- Experience leading large cross-team projects or contributing to open source.
- Experience writing tech articles or tech blogs.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

title: Principal Engineer - Machine Learning
description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.



Job Description

About This Role — The Mission

Most ML engineering roles at large companies mean contributing to a platform team where your work disappears into a pipeline that fifty other engineers also touch. This role is different. You will be the primary owner of the ML systems that detect product development defects, model material behavior with limited data, and select the highest-value experiments from an active learning pipeline. Your models will run in product development. Your decisions will matter immediately.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deep Learning Model Implementation & Product Development Ownership: Build, train, evaluate, and maintain CNN/U-Net/ViT models for automated inspection and measurement. Own model performance end-to-end — ablation studies, confidence calibration, product development performance monitoring.
  • Anomaly Detection Systems: Build and maintain real-time anomaly detection for product development sensor and time-series data streams — statistical baseline, threshold calibration, drift alerting. Sole implementation owner for this workstream.
  • Surrogate Modeling & Active Learning Operations: Own implementation and iteration of surrogate model pipelines and active learning systems under Technical lead’s architectural direction. Configure acquisition functions; integrate with versioned feature sets.
  • Data-to-Model Interface Ownership: Own the data contract between the Data Engineer and the ML model stack. Define feature specifications, validate datasets against model input requirements, and escalate data quality issues before they reach the training pipeline.
  • MLOps Maintenance & Product Development Reliability: Maintain model versions, training pipelines, and containers under platform architecture. MLflow tracking, CI/CD contribution, product development monitoring, and degradation escalation.
  • Junior Mentorship & Documentation: Provide code review guidance to team; document model design decisions and evaluation outcomes to production-handoff standard.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field. AI major or strong AI research focus preferred.

Experience:

  • 1–3 years of hands-on ML engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through internships, academic research, or open-source contributions. Must show component-level technical ownership within an end-to-end ML pipeline (training through deployment) — not just execution under direction. Kaggle rankings, arXiv preprints, or significant open-source ML contributions are valued as evidence of depth.

Must have Skills:

  • Python: Strong proficiency — primary ML development language
  • PyTorch: Proficient → Expert — independent model training and evaluation
  • Computer Vision: Strong foundation in CNNs, plus hands-on depth in at least one of: U-Net/segmentation, ViT/transformer-based vision, or time-series anomaly detection. Candidates with depth across multiple areas (e.g. full inspection-scope coverage — segmentation, transformer vision, and anomaly detection together) will be considered for the higher end of the band.
  • Surrogate Modeling: Implement and iterate surrogate pipelines under P110 architectural guidance
  • Active Learning: Configure acquisition functions; uncertainty-guided experiment scheduling
  • Data-to-Model Interface: Define feature specs; validate incoming datasets against model requirements; flag data quality issues before training
  • Practical MLOps: MLflow, Docker, Git, basic CI/CD contribution
  • Model Evaluation & Uncertainty Analysis: Ablation studies, confidence calibration, validation methodology
  • Technical Documentation: Model design decisions and evaluation results to production-handoff standard

Good to have Skills:

  • PINNs implementation under technical guidance
  • Bayesian methods — Bayesian neural networks, Gaussian processes, ensemble uncertainty, calibration
  • Reinforcement learning basics — gym environments, policy gradient concepts
  • AWS fundamentals — S3, EC2, SageMaker basics; entry-level cloud ML deployment
  • RAG pipeline fundamentals

Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically accomplished Engineer II (QA) to lead Incoming Quality Assurance (IQA) and support Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) functions across our plant. In this role, you will maintain plant incoming procedures under our Quality Management System (QMS), establish inspection control plans and First Article Inspection (FAI) workflows for New Product Introductions (NPI), enforce counterfeit parts avoidance protocols, manage calibration and validation programs, and drive rigorous multi-tier audit compliance covering ISO 13485, FDA, and international medical regulatory frameworks.

  • Review and approve NCMRs with "Use-As-Is" dispositions, ensuring materials in the Material Review Board (MRB) are rigorously qualified and classified.
  • Prepare and submit timely Corporate and Plant performance reports covering IQA operations and SQE deliverables.
  • Drive continuous improvement and Lean Six Sigma (LSS) initiatives—utilizing Kaizen and Mini-company approaches—to eliminate operational waste and enhance line productivity.
  • Execute other quality engineering roles and duties as defined in Plant procedures and assigned by management.

  • Strong leadership, interpersonal communication, and analytical thinking abilities.


How To Stand Out

The ideal candidate pairs extensive incoming quality and supplier audit leadership in a high-reliability PCBA/EMS setting with hands-on regulatory compliance across ISO 13485, MDSAP, and US FDA requirements, proficiency in tools like Inspection Maestro and Agile PLM, and a forward-thinking drive to implement AI and automation into quality assurance workflows.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
Reports to: Head of AI & Digital

Type: Full-time


About the role

Apeiron collects and trades used cooking oil across Asia. Like many fast-growing companies, our data is fragmented across many systems and markets, including several ERPs and operational tools across Southeast Asia and China. Your job is to own the company's data foundation. You will engineer the pipelines that bring this data together reliably, model it into clean tables that finance and operations can trust, and keep it accurate and monitored. You will also prepare that data for AI, so that AI tools can search it and answer questions about our business correctly.


What you will do

  • Build and run ingestion pipelines, starting with finance and ERP data, then operational sources
  • Model the data into clear schemas and curated tables that finance and operations teams rely on
  • Define and enforce data contracts, so it is clear who owns each dataset and who only feeds raw data
  • Keep pipelines reliable: repeatable loads, late-arriving data handled, and failures that are visible and alerted
  • Put quality checks where money breaks: amounts, dates, volumes, FX, and invoice against contract
  • Own monitoring, lineage and access control for the data platform, from source system to report
  • Prepare business data for AI ingestion so that AI assistants and search tools return accurate answers
  • Work with finance and country operations in plain language so people can move off spreadsheets


Key skills we need

  • Production data platforms: you have shipped ELT pipelines and production databases in messy, real companies, not only greenfield demos
  • ERP and finance integration: Dynamics or a similar ERP; experience with AR, AP, bank and FX data matters
  • Strong SQL plus Python (or Spark)
  • PostgreSQL data platforms: hands-on with PostgreSQL-based platforms such as Supabase, or similar managed Postgres (Neon, Amazon RDS or Aurora Postgres), including pgvector for embeddings; comfortable moving data from raw to curated tables. Experience with cloud warehouses such as Snowflake is a plus
  • Data contracts and reliability: schemas, late-arriving facts, monitoring, access control
  • Hands-on: you build; you do not only draw architecture slides
  • Cross-functional: you can sit with senior stakeholders and operations teams and explain things without jargon


AI data preparation (must have)

  • Preparing data for AI ingestion: well versed in cleaning, normalising and chunking structured and unstructured data (tables, documents, emails, PDFs) so large language models (LLMs) can use it

Client and communication skills

AI-forward mindset

Design mastery

• A strong eye for what great design looks like and the ability to elevate a client's brand with visuals that feel premium.

• A real understanding of photography and graphic design, including how imagery, composition, and brand assets work together on a page.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume through the Apply button and include:

At Advantagy, you'll work alongside senior strategists and specialists who help businesses grow with clarity and confidence. If you love great design, enjoy working directly with clients, and want to be on the front edge of how AI is changing creative work, we'd love to meet you.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud Engineer | AWS / Kubernetes


Location: Singapore

Employment: Permanent


EC1 Partners is working with a leading global financial technology organisation that is expanding its cloud engineering capability in Singapore.


We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to join a global platform operations team responsible for building and operating highly available cloud infrastructure supporting business-critical applications.


This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on AWS, Kubernetes and infrastructure automation. The environment is continuing to evolve towards cloud-native architecture and microservices, creating significant project work across platform build, migration and automation.


The successful candidate will take genuine ownership of infrastructure projects from design through to delivery, rather than operating solely within a ticket-driven support environment.


The Role

  • Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure primarily across AWS
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes / EKS platforms and containerised workloads
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform
  • Develop and support GitOps workflows using Argo CD
  • Work with Helm Charts and wider Kubernetes tooling
  • Lead cloud infrastructure projects from initial design through implementation and operational handover
  • Improve CI/CD, automation, observability and platform reliability
  • Work closely with application engineering, security and operations teams
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and production issues
  • Contribute to technical standards, platform design and engineering best practices
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production environments


The role is currently expected to be approximately 70% project engineering and 30% operational support, with the project component expected to increase as new initiatives progress.


What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years of professional cloud infrastructure or platform engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on AWS experience
  • Deep experience with Kubernetes, ideally EKS
  • Strong Terraform experience
  • Experience with Argo CD / GitOps
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerised applications
  • Strong Linux knowledge
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
  • Scripting or automation experience, ideally Python
  • Good understanding of cloud networking, IAM, observability and security
  • Evidence of independently owning infrastructure platforms, migrations or major engineering projects
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across globally distributed engineering teams


Experience within financial services, trading or other highly available production environments would be beneficial, but is not essential.


This is an opportunity to join a technically strong global engineering team and play a key role in the continued development of its cloud platform in Singapore.


Apply directly or contact Andrew Scotts at EC1 Partners for a confidential discussion.

title: Information Technology Operations Engineer
description:
Company Description

Higogame is a trailblazer in the mobile gaming and entertainment industry. Since our inception in late 2020, we have been dedicated to transforming the gaming landscape in Southeast Asia and beyond, delivering innovative and immersive experiences that engage millions of players around the globe.

  • Our revenue has seen remarkable growth year after year, with operations extending across multiple regions worldwide.
  • In just three years, we've risen to become one of the top two games of our kind in the local market.
  • We proudly serve around 2 million active users daily and have a total monthly active user base of 5 million worldwide.
  • Our team consists of over 200 talented employees, including a robust R&D division of more than 100 experts.
  • We offer exceptional career development opportunities and foster a multinational culture that empowers everyone to reach their full potential.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of mobile gaming!


About The Role :

We are looking for a proactive and motivated IT Operations Engineer to support our daily IT operations, including end-user support, network maintenance, IT security, and asset management.

You will work closely with our both regional IT team & Corporate team to troubleshoot issues, maintain reliable IT services, and improve operational efficiency.

Fresh graduates are welcome! We value strong problem-solving skills, initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of tasks.


Job Responsibilities:

Onboarding and Offboarding Support

  • Handle computer setup, hardware configuration, installation of basic office software, printers and account application/provisioning for new hires to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.
  • Manage the secure recovery of IT assets during employee offboarding: perform physical hardware inspections, deep erasure and backup of sensitive corporate data, system resets, and asset status updates.

Corporate Network High-Availability Maintenance

  • Conduct routine inspections, architecture optimization, and traffic monitoring of the company's local area network (LAN) and wireless network (Wi-Fi) to guarantee zero network downtime.

Information Security Control and Compliance Enforcement

  • Deploy policies and perform compliance checks for endpoint security software (such as antivirus, internet behavior management, and Network Access Control/NAC) to prevent weak passwords and ransomware.Strictly enforce company data security and confidentiality policies, perform audits on non-compliant peripherals, intercept unauthorized network access, and regularly generate security audit compliance reports.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • R&D Collaboration: Assist the development team with infrastructure provisioning for test and production environments, including initializing basic Linux virtual machines and so on.
  • Marketing Collaboration: Provide technical support by configuring, maintaining, troubleshooting marketing technology platforms and related software to enable effective campaign execution and reporting.

General Affairs and Ad-hoc Tasks

  • Assist supervisors with IT asset inventories and the drafting of Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation; efficiently execute other tasks assigned by management.


Qualifications:

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Fresh graduates are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Hardware Expertise: Familiar with IT equipment hardware, including but not limited to host computers/PCs, network switching equipment, etc.
  • Windows & Desktop Support: Proficient in Windows and Mac OS, highly skilled in operating system installation, and familiar with the configuration and usage of various Microsoft products. Capable of troubleshooting common desktop issues, such as Web interfaces failing to open or endpoints failing to obtain valid IP addresses.
  • Linux Service Deployment: Familiar with essential Linux OS commands and experienced in installing and deploying common services under Linux environments, such as Nginx, FTP, MySQL, etc.
  • Solid Networking Foundation: Possess robust fundamental knowledge of networking, feel comfortable with routing and switching principles, and understand VLAN segmentation and management.
  • AI Adoption: Demonstrated ability and willingness to adopt AI-powered tools to enhance infrastructure operations, automate repetitive tasks, improve troubleshooting, and increase overall operational efficiency.
  • Possess a spirit of exploration, love technology, and keep up with technological developments.
  • Strong learning ability, sense of responsibility, good communication skills, teamwork spirit.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.


Nice-to-Have

  • Proficiency in English and Mandarin are a plus due to the need to communicate with stakeholders.
  • Relevant internships, school projects, or hands-on experience in IT support, networking, or system administration.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Ministry of Education (Mobile Parents Gateway),
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

Parents Gateway (PG) is MOE’s key digital platform connecting schools and parents across Singapore. The platform consists of a parent-facing mobile application, a web platform for school staff, and the backend services and cloud infrastructure that power them. It supports key school-parent interactions such as announcements, consent forms, parent-teacher engagements and other services, with integrations across the wider MOE ecosystem.

We are entering the next phase of Parents Gateway, with an opportunity to rethink and rebuild the product for the years ahead.

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer specialising in Mobile Engineering, you will join us at an exciting stage where we are building the next generation of the PG mobile experience largely from the ground up. Beyond building individual features and screens, you will help define the mobile architecture, engineering foundations and technical practices that allow the product to evolve sustainably.

Your Responsibilities Include

  • Build the Next Generation of PG Mobile: Design and develop a high-quality mobile application that will form the parent-facing experience of the new Parents Gateway.
  • Mobile Architecture & Technical Direction: Shape key architectural and technology decisions across application structure, state management, data flows, native capabilities and integrations, balancing performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Mobile Platform Engineering: Establish reusable foundations, components and engineering patterns that enable the team to build new capabilities consistently and efficiently.
  • Performance & Reliability: Drive improvements in application startup, responsiveness, stability, crash rates, network resilience and overall mobile performance across a diverse range of devices.
  • Mobile Delivery & Operations: Strengthen automated testing, build pipelines, release processes, observability and App Store/Google Play delivery to enable safe and frequent releases.
  • Engineering Excellence: Raise the bar for mobile engineering through good software design, code and design reviews, technical standards and mentorship of other engineers.
  • You will also work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Education Officers, backend engineers and fellow mobile engineers to translate real problems faced by parents into simple, accessible and reliable mobile experiences.

[What we are looking for]

We are looking for an experienced mobile engineer who thinks beyond individual screens and features and is comfortable taking technical ownership of a mobile application as a whole.

You Should Have

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building and operating production mobile applications.
  • Strong proficiency with React Native and TypeScript/JavaScript in production mobile applications.
  • Good understanding of the React Native ecosystem and architecture, including the interaction between React Native and the underlying iOS and Android platforms.
  • Experience working with native iOS/Swift and/or Android/Kotlin code, such as integrating native SDKs, troubleshooting platform-specific issues, or developing native modules, is highly desirable.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with backend APIs, authentication services, push notifications and native device capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of mobile performance, application lifecycle, networking, offline and error handling, and debugging production issues.
  • Experience with automated testing, mobile CI/CD, application signing, build pipelines and App Store/Google Play release processes.
  • Experience with mobile monitoring, analytics, crash reporting and observability tools.
  • Ability to independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, evaluate alternatives and drive solutions from design through implementation.
  • Experience contributing to technical direction, conducting meaningful code and design reviews, and mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, design and engineering teams.



What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Job Description | Quality Engineering


Role Summary Experienced Test Automation Engineer to design, build and execute scalable automated testing for Loans / Loan IQ applications within the Credit Risk area. The role covers UI, API, database, batch and integration testing across the lending lifecycle, with strong focus on data accuracy, controls, regression coverage and release quality in a regulated banking environment.

Position Overview

Role

Test Automation Engineer / Senior Test Automation Engineer

Domain

Loans / Loan IQ, Wholesale Lending and Credit Risk

Location

Singapore

Experience

6–10+ years overall; preferably 3+ years in banking or lending automation

Engagement

Risk and Lending technology initiatives

Work Model

Hybrid / onsite based on project and client requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain automation frameworks for Loans / Loan IQ web applications, APIs, services, databases and batch interfaces.
  • Convert business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria into test scenarios, automated scripts and traceable test evidence.
  • Automate critical lending journeys including borrower setup, deal and facility creation, commitments, drawdowns, rollovers, repricing, paydowns, interest, fees and servicing.
  • Validate Credit Risk controls covering limits, exposure, utilization, approvals, data quality, exception handling and regulatory or management reporting.
  • Build API automation for REST and SOAP services, including request/response validation, authentication, negative testing and service virtualization where required.
  • Perform database and data-validation testing using SQL, including source-to-target reconciliation across upstream and downstream systems.
  • Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and enable scheduled, parallel and release-based execution with actionable reporting.
  • Execute smoke, functional, integration, regression, end-to-end and production-verification testing across releases.
  • Log, analyze and triage defects with Business Analysts, developers, data teams, operations and product stakeholders.
  • Monitor automation reliability, remove flaky tests and improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.
  • Follow secure coding, test-data protection, audit-evidence and change-management standards expected in a regulated banking environment.
  • Provide test status, quality metrics, release risks and recommendations to Singapore and global delivery stakeholders.

Domain and Functional Coverage

  • Wholesale and commercial lending, including syndicated and bilateral loans.
  • Deal, facility, tranche, commitment, borrower, lender and portfolio structures.
  • Loan lifecycle events such as drawdown, rollover, repricing, paydown, interest accrual and fee processing.
  • Credit facilities and limits, exposure and utilization, collateral and covenant concepts.
  • Risk-book and portfolio hierarchies, downstream feeds, reconciliation and reporting.
  • Loan IQ knowledge is preferred; strong Loans domain and experience automating other lending platforms may also be considered.

title: Network Engineer (Operations)
description:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer (Operations) to configure, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure based on Cisco, Cisco Meraki, Aruba, Palo Alto, Check Point and Huawei technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Cisco Technologies

  • Configure and support Cisco Catalyst switches and routers
  • Configure and support routing protocols including OSPF, BGP and EIGRP.
  • Configure and support Layer 2 technologies such as VLANs, EtherChannel and VTP.
  • Configure and support Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers and Cisco Access Points.


Cisco Meraki

  • Configure Meraki MS Switches and MR Wireless Access Points.
  • Manage Meraki Dashboard, templates, firmware upgrades, and licensing.
  • Configure SD-WAN, VPN, Auto VPN, traffic shaping, and security policies.
  • Perform cloud-based monitoring and troubleshooting.


Aruba Technologies

  • Configure Aruba CX and ArubaOS switches.
  • Configure and support Aruba Wireless Access Points and Mobility Controllers.
  • Configure Aruba Central and AirWave management platforms.
  • Configure and support Aruba ClearPass for Network Access Control (preferred).


Huawei Technologies

  • Configure Huawei switches and routers.
  • Configure and support Huawei WLAN solutions and AC controllers.
  • Configure routing protocols, VLANs, ACLs, QoS, VRRP, and MSTP.
  • Manage Huawei eSight network management platform.
  • Perform firmware upgrades and troubleshooting.


Configure and support Palo Alto & Check Point Firewall


Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network operations and support.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, routing, switching, and network security.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco, Cisco Meraki, Aruba, Huawei, Palo Alto, and Check Point technologies.
  • Experience configuring routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
  • Good understanding of Layer 2 technologies including VLAN, STP, EtherChannel, and trunking.
  • Experience with VPN technologies, SD-WAN, QoS, ACLs, NAT, and high-availability configurations.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, Zabbix, or similar platforms is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of network authentication technologies such as RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, and NAC solutions is preferred.
  • Experience with scripting or automation tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, or REST APIs) is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex network issues.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills.

description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

We are seeking a talented Lead / Senior Product Designer to join our BizSG team, responsible for designing user-centric digital products and services that streamline government-to-business (G2B) interactions in Singapore. You will play a key role in enhancing the user experience of critical government platforms, making them intuitive, efficient, and accessible for businesses.

  • Conduct user research, including interviews, surveys, and usability testing, to understand business needs, pain points, and user behaviors.
  • Translate research insights into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups for various digital products and services within the BizSG ecosystem.

  • Champion user-centered design principles throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders, incorporating feedback to refine solutions.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in UX/UI design.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence and innovation within GovTech.

[What we are looking for]

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in product design, UX design, or UI design, preferably with experience in B2B or government digital services.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing a range of design projects, demonstrating your design process, problem-solving skills, and visual design capabilities.
  • Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles, information architecture, and usability best practices.
  • Experience conducting user research and translating insights into actionable design solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Experience with government digital services or platforms is a plus.
  • Substantial product design experience, with a track record of leading design on complex, multi-stakeholder products

title: Data Scientist (Analytics), Financial Services - Payments
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

Financial Services (FS) Analytics partners with Product, Business, Risk, Design and Engineering across Payments, where we aim to be the biggest FinTech Paymemnt in the region. We sit inside the decisions, not downstream of them. You'll learn from senior analysts who have done this across Grab, and you'll get ownership early.

Most analytics roles hand you a dashboard queue, or ask you to build pipelines. We instead will hand you questions about how millions of people borrow, pay and save.

Grab Financial Services runs payments, lending, insurance and the digital banks as one team. We serve people across Southeast Asia that traditional banks often overlook. Your work will shape products they use every day.

You'll also learn analytics the way it's done now, in an AI-first world. Our analysts work with AI agents every day. Agents take the first pass at queries and analysis. You'll learn to direct them, check them and build with them. Few teams anywhere work this way yet!

Get to Know the Role

You will use data to understand user needs and be the de-facto Voice of the Customer (users, driver-partners, merchants, agents) across Payments. You will use data to unveil insights to help scale our products. You will promote data-driven decision-making within Financial Services and partner with Product Managers, Business Owners, UX Designers, and Engineers to design analytical projects that inform the Product roadmap. You will provide expertise and produce data-driven hypotheses to solve important Product and Business problems, and guide our Financial Services' strategies forward.

You will report into the Senior Analytics Manager, Payments and work onsite at our office in Singapore, Grab HQ One-North.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Deliver reliable analysis: Take clearly defined problems and deliver accurate answers.
  • Learn the experimentation craft: Help design, run and read A/B tests with support from senior analysts. Build your judgement on how to interpret experiment results.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, metric definitions and the data your partners rely on. Accuracy is non-negotiable.
  • Work AI-first: Use AI tools every day to write SQL and Python, explore data and speed up your work. Check what they give you before anyone else sees it. Automate the repetitive parts of your job.
  • Keep partners in the loop: Share progress, changes and findings early. Explain what the data says in plain language and with enough context to act on.
  • Manage your growth: Ask for feedback, act on it and pick up our best practices quickly.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 0 to 3 years in analytics, data science or a related role. Internships or research projects count.
  • A degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Solid SQL and working Python.
  • A good grasp of statistics and hypothesis testing. Hands-on A/B testing experience will be an advantage.
  • You already work with AI. You use AI tools in your daily work and can show us something you built or automated with them. A side project counts!
  • Communication - you can explain an analysis to someone who isn't a data person.
  • Curiosity and a fast learning curve. You ask good questions and don't stay stuck for long.

Nice to have: an interest in FinTech, lending or banking. 1+ years of experience with a visualisation tool.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Lead UI/UX Designer - Mobile Games
description:
About the Company


Founded in 2021, Happibits is a game publisher dedicated to the power of play. Our passionate team of developers and artists creates casual gaming experiences that bring relaxation, creativity, and a daily dose of happiness to players worldwide.


About the Role


We’re looking for a Lead UI/UX Designer to lead a team of five or more designers and own the UI/UX direction for our mobile games. You’ll stay hands-on, turning product requirements and creative concepts into polished, high-fidelity in-game experiences, including event interfaces, promotional popups, sales offers, and narrative-driven content. You’ll bring a broad view of how Art, UI/UX, Product, LiveOps, and Marketing work together to shape the player experience. You’ll use that context to guide your team’s priorities and help designers understand how their work contributes to the game. You’ll combine creative judgment and hands-on craftsmanship to make interfaces feel vibrant, intuitive, and tangible while staying true to each game’s visual style.


Responsibilities


  • Lead: Set priorities, assign clear ownership, and coach a team of five or more designers. Give actionable feedback, balance workload against production needs, and help designers build the judgment to make decisions independently.
  • Design: Lead and contribute to high-fidelity game interfaces, promotional popups, sales offers, and LiveOps visuals. Set the quality bar for color, composition, visual hierarchy, and typography. Bring together logos, event titles, AI-assisted character and environment renders, and other assets into cohesive designs.
  • Storytelling: Guide how each event’s theme, mood, and narrative come through in the player experience. Keep the visuals connected to the event and consistent with the game’s visual style.
  • Collaborate: Work with department leads across Art, Product, LiveOps, and Marketing to translate briefs into clear concepts, requirements, and deliverables. Consider how campaign messaging, in-game events, and product priorities affect one another. Build reusable templates, production workflows, and creative systems that make recurring content easier to produce.
  • Explore and plan: Listen to the people closest to the work, identify the underlying issue, and propose solutions. Stay open to creative input from across the team and explore bold ideas, including wildcard concepts, with the Head of Creative. Narrow the options based on player value, creative fit, and production feasibility. Turn the chosen direction into a strategy and an execution plan with clear priorities, owners, and milestones.
  • Deliver and Optimize: Keep work in progress, source files, and final assets organized. Coordinate deadlines with Product, keep producers informed, and ensure developers receive optimized assets and clear implementation notes. Resolve handoff questions and review implemented designs in-game.


Qualifications


  • Experience: At least five years of UI/UX design experience in mobile gaming, with experience leading and developing a design team of five or more.
  • Craftsmanship: A portfolio of mobile game work that includes UI, user flows, logos, and polished interface artwork. Strong judgment in color, composition, and visual balance, with the ability to communicate a story or theme through design.
  • Technical skills: Proficiency in Photoshop, Figma, vector design tools, asset export, and PNG optimization. Experience using FigJam or Miro to organize ideas and workflows, along with experience in AI-assisted production. Willingness to learn tools and techniques that improve quality and efficiency.
  • Initiative: Research references, study competitor apps, and play relevant games. Seek out new tools and techniques, and use strong benchmarks to evaluate your own work and coach the team.
  • Design ownership: Show how you’ve weighed creative alternatives, made clear recommendations, and turned a direction into work a team could deliver. Connect design decisions to the wider needs of the game and its players.
  • Communication: Listen actively and communicate production needs, requirements, design direction, and feedback clearly. Fluency in English is required. Conversational Mandarin Chinese is a plus.
  • Transparency: Raise issues early so teams can coordinate and adjust plans. Share progress, blockers, and uncertainties openly, and make your reasoning clear so others can contribute and make informed decisions.

title: [LPS] Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of enterprise systems in a managed services (Day 2) environment.

The role operates as a centralised reliability function across application, infrastructure, and vendor support layers, governing operational activities to ensure that incidents, changes, and patching activities are executed without impacting service stability or SLA commitments.

The SRE works closely with Application Engineers (L1.5) and Application Vendors (L2), providing oversight, risk control, and engineering-driven improvements to maintain a stable and resilient production environment.


Key Responsibilities

1. Reliability & Service Assurance

  • Own end-to-end service reliability, including availability, performance, and system stability
  • Define and track reliability metrics (e.g., uptime, latency, error rates)
  • Ensure SLA compliance through proactive monitoring and operational governance
  • Establish service health indicators and early warning mechanisms


2. Monitoring & Observability

  • Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks across application and infrastructure layers
  • Define alert thresholds and reduce alert noise to improve signal quality
  • Develop dashboards and reporting for real-time visibility of system health
  • Continuously enhance observability coverage across services


3. Incident Management & RCA

  • Lead major incident management (P1/P2) as incident commander
  • Perform end-to-end root cause analysis (RCA) across application, infrastructure, and vendor domains
  • Coordinate with Application Engineers and Vendors for issue resolution
  • Drive preventive and corrective actions to reduce incident recurrence


4. Change & Patch Governance

  • Assess operational risks associated with changes, releases, and patching activities
  • Work with Application Engineers (L1.5) and Vendors (L2) to ensure safe execution of application patches
  • Perform pre- and post-change validation to ensure system stability
  • Govern Go/No-Go decisions and support rollback planning in case of service degradation


5. Performance & Capacity Management

  • Monitor and optimise system performance across application and infrastructure layers
  • Conduct capacity planning and forecasting to ensure scalability and resilience
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks proactively


6. Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive automation of operational processes, including monitoring, recovery, and validation
  • Implement self-healing and resilience mechanisms where applicable
  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks and automation scripts
  • Continuously improve system reliability through engineering practices


7. Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with Application Engineers (L1.5) for execution of operational activities
  • Collaborate with Vendors (L2) for defect resolution and product-level fixes
  • Ensure compliance with governance, security, and audit requirements
  • Support service reviews, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives


Requirements

Core Requirements

  • Experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or production operations in enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools
  • Strong troubleshooting capability across application and infrastructure layers
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, problem, change management)


Preferred

  • Experience in system integrator or managed services (Day 2 operations) environment
  • Exposure to enterprise applications (e.g., IWMS platforms such as Archibus or similar)
  • Experience with automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell, etc.)
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and capacity planning


Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to lead during high-pressure incidents
  • Structured and governance-driven mindset
  • Proactive approach to reliability and continuous improvement
  • Strong stakeholder coordination across internal teams and vendors

Inviting applications for the role of Edge Engineer – Plant Edge-to-Cloud Ingestion

Purpose of the role

Builds and deploys the edge layer that securely and reliably moves plant data from PLC, DCS, SCADA and historian systems into the cloud platform. You own the standard, mandatory ingestion path built on AWS IoT Greengrass and SiteWise, packaged as reusable blueprints that can be rolled out plant after plant.


Key responsibilities

  • Develop ingestion services using AWS IoT SiteWise, IoT Greengrass and AWS IoT Core, including device registry, policies and message routing.
  • Deliver OT/IT integration and data ingestion for plants, bridging controller, SCADA and historian systems to the cloud securely.
  • Produce deployable edge and local application blueprints that can be rolled out to new plants and lines.
  • Develop edge ingestion services using AWS IoT Greengrass and AWS IoT SiteWise (must have), including components, stream management and local processing.
  • Implement the standardised edge-to-cloud data pipeline (the mandatory ingestion path) with consistent naming, timestamps, units and quality codes.
  • Integrate with PLC/DCS and SCADA systems via OPC-UA, MQTT or historian interfaces; configure device connectivity and telemetry collection.
  • Ensure resilient, low-latency transfer from OT to cloud: local buffering, store-and-forward, back-fill after outages, retry policies and time synchronisation.
  • Size and test throughput and latency per site; monitor ingestion health, data gaps and device status.
  • Build containerised applications for on-premise plant deployment; manage images, configuration and secrets for constrained or restricted environments.
  • Package reusable edge deployment blueprints and templates so a new plant or line is deployed through automation with no manual steps.
  • Implement secure provisioning and updates: certificate-based device identity, fleet provisioning, over-the-air updates and rollback.
  • Work within plant network zones (Purdue model, DMZ, outbound-only connectivity) with OT, IT and security teams; follow plant change and safety procedures.
  • Lead commissioning and site acceptance testing; create runbooks and train plant support teams.
  • Map plant tags to canonical assets with the Semantic Architecture team, using the approved signal-mapping process.


Platform rules you will work by

These rules apply across the programme: contract-first delivery, zero manual deployment, no custom schema, a single standard ingestion path and strict multi-tenancy. The ones most relevant to this role are:

  • Standard ingestion path: all plant data flows edge-to-cloud through the approved pipeline (AWS IoT Greengrass and SiteWise).
  • Zero manual deployment: every platform and tenant change ships through automated, auditable pipelines.
  • Strict multi-tenancy: tenant data, keys and configuration are isolated by design (namespace-based isolation).


Required qualifications and experience

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with AWS IoT Greengrass and AWS IoT SiteWise (must have).
  • Experience building containerised applications with Docker for on-premise or edge deployment.
  • Practical knowledge of industrial protocols and interfaces: OPC-UA, MQTT and historian connectors.
  • Programming experience in Python or Node.js for edge components and integration.
  • Experience designing buffering, retry and offline-tolerant data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS IoT Core alongside Greengrass and SiteWise.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Good to have

  • Experience in plant environments: PLC, DCS, SCADA and historian systems (for example Siemens, Rockwell, Honeywell, Yokogawa, ABB, Emerson, OSIsoft PI).
  • Sparkplug B, Modbus, EtherNet/IP; lightweight Kubernetes (k3s) at the edge.
  • IEC 62443 and Purdue-model network design; secure remote access to plants.
  • Terraform or similar IaC for fleet provisioning and edge deployment.

Preferred certifications

  • AWS Certified IoT or Solutions Architect – Associate (preferred).
  • ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals or GICSP (nice to have).
  • Vendor certifications for PLC/SCADA/historian platforms (nice to have).

Behavioural competencies

  • Ownership and a bias for automation: removes manual steps rather than documenting them.
  • Clear written communication: specifications, ADRs and runbooks others can act on without a meeting.
  • Comfortable bridging IT and OT: respects plant safety, change windows and operator realities.
  • Collaborative across engineering, security, data/AI and plant teams; gives and receives code and design review openly.
  • Structured problem solving under ambiguity, with sound trade-off judgement and a habit of recording decisions.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer

About Us:


Notewise (https://www.notewise.dev/) is reimagining the way people capture, organize, and make sense of their ideas.

About the Job


We're looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to help us deliver a reliable, polished, and delightful experience to millions of Notewise users worldwide.


At Notewise, quality is more than just finding bugs. It's about understanding how people use our product, anticipating what could go wrong, and making sure every interaction feels right.


You'll work closely with our engineering, product, and design teams throughout the development process, from early feature discussions to testing and release.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring products, uncovering tricky edge cases, solving problems, and taking real ownership of product quality.


What You'll Do


  • Multi-Platform Testing: Perform thorough manual testing across iOS, iPadOS, Android, and Web, ensuring a consistent and seamless user experience.
  • Test Planning & Execution: Design and execute test cases, including functional, exploratory, regression, and pre-release testing for new features and existing workflows.
  • Bug Identification & Management: Identify, reproduce, document, and track bugs with clear reproduction steps, working closely with engineers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Customer Support & Feedback: Help troubleshoot user issues, respond to support inquiries, and monitor feedback from channels such as Discord, Reddit, and app store reviews.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work directly with engineers, designers, product managers, and founders to identify potential issues early and continuously improve the product.
  • Release Quality: Help evaluate release readiness, prioritize issues based on their impact on users, and ensure that every update meets our quality standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our testing processes, workflows, and overall product experience.


Who We're Looking For


Beyond technical skills, we value people who genuinely care about the products they work on.


  • Attention to Detail: You notice the little things others might miss, whether it's a subtle UI inconsistency, an unexpected interaction, or a tricky edge case.
  • Strong Ownership: You're dependable, self-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your work without constant supervision.
  • User-Centric Mindset: You care about how real users experience the product, not just whether a feature technically works.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: You don't just report issues. You investigate, ask questions, and actively contribute to finding solutions.
  • Curiosity & Willingness to Learn: You enjoy exploring new technologies, understanding how things work, and continuously improving your skills.
  • Team Player: You communicate clearly, collaborate openly, and enjoy working in a small, fast-moving team.


Job Requirements


  • At least 1 year of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or a related role.
  • Strong understanding of manual testing methodologies and software testing fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with mobile applications and the iOS, Android, and Web ecosystems.
  • Ability to identify, reproduce, and clearly communicate software issues.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.


Nice to Have:


  • Experience testing consumer mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools such as Linear or Jira.
  • Experience with test automation or AI-assisted testing tools.
  • A personal interest in productivity apps, note-taking, or AI-powered products.


Why Join Us?


  • Make a Real Impact: Your work will directly influence the experience of millions of users around the world.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Take meaningful responsibility for product quality, with the freedom to propose ideas and drive improvements.
  • Work Closely with the Team: Collaborate directly with founders, engineers, and designers, with minimal hierarchy and fast feedback loops.
  • Learn & Grow: Gain hands-on experience across multiple platforms, complex product workflows, and emerging AI technologies.
  • Build Something Meaningful: Help shape the next generation of tools for how people capture knowledge, think, and create.


We're looking for people who care about building great products and want to grow alongside us.


Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Apply through LinkedIn.

title: Network Engineer

  • Design, build, and run evaluations and benchmarks for AI models on real-world Singapore government tasks — including constructing the underlying datasets, defining metrics and scoring, and standing behind results that inform agency and vendor decisions
  • Build functional prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions for agency engagements spanning smart city video analytics, document intelligence, generative media, and content authentication
  • Stay current with the latest developments in applied AI and assess what translates from research settings to practical government applications
  • Support the development of our multimodal AI showcase and prototyping platforms, and advise on deployment considerations such as on-premise vs cloud, hardware, and cost
  • Produce technical write-ups and contribute to knowledge artefacts such as handbooks, reports, and evaluation findings

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Lead/ Senior Data Scientist who sits at the intersection of exploration and applied AI. Someone who can pick up a new model or technique, understand how it works, and turn it into something users can actually try — and who can then show, credibly, how well it works.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years applied ML/data science, with meaningful depth in at least one non-text modality — computer vision, video understanding, audio/speech, or generative image/video
  • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model training, evaluation methodology, and experiment design — comfort with sampling, uncertainty, and metric selection is a strong plus
  • Foundational knowledge of computer vision concepts and/or hands-on experience working with image, video, or audio data
  • Exposure to multimodal AI systems, vision-language models, and generative AI — including fine-tuning (e.g. LoRA) and synthetic data generation
  • Practical sense for running models: GPU/VRAM constraints, open-weight vs commercial API trade-offs, and the cost implications of each
  • Working knowledge of cloud solution architecture on GCP and/or AWS — able to stand up and structure prototypes using managed compute, storage, and model-serving services
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) to accelerate your work
  • Treats AI as a collaborator, using it to learn new libraries, debug, and move faster — and re-tests frontier model capability first-hand rather than relying on secondhand claims
  • Curious and outcome-oriented. You enjoy going deep on a problem but ultimately care about whether it works in practice
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Government AI work means scoping problems that aren't always well-defined, running several workstreams at once, and accepting that not every prototype ships
  • Comfortable leading a small team of junior data scientists — setting technical direction, breaking down problems, giving feedback, and growing capability alongside your own delivery.
  • Strong communicator. You can explain what you built and why it matters to both technical peers and non-technical agency stakeholders — including turning a metric into a recommendation someone can act on

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programmes.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.
