MoneyHero Group (Nasdaq: MNY) is a market leading financial products platform in Greater Southeast Asia, reaching 9.8m monthly unique users and working with more than 270 commercial partners across five markets including Singapore, Hong Kong S.A.R., Philippines, Taiwan, and Malaysia.


What We Offer

You will be entitled to a competitive salary and attractive benefits, including:

  • Annual leave, birthday leave, tenure leave, international remote work leave, and more
  • Five-day work week, hybrid work arrangement or fully remote work set-up (depending on the location)
  • Professional trainings, career advancement and internal mobility opportunities
  • Competitive benefits including insurance and mental wellness program


About The Job

MoneyHero Group (MHG) is hiring a Product Design Lead who is an equal parts product thinker, systems designer, and AI-powered creator. You’ll shape intuitive, high-performing experiences that help millions across Singapore, Hong Kong, the Philippines, and Taiwan make smarter financial decisions.


As part of a lean, high-velocity design team, you won’t just design interfaces - you’ll shape product strategy, challenge assumptions, and use AI tools to supercharge how fast we ideate, validate, and ship. You’ll move fluidly between deep product work and rapid campaign execution, bringing first-principles thinking and an obsession with user outcomes to every problem.


The Lead, Product Design Will Be Responsible For

  • Design end-to-end product experiences - from problem framing and conceptual exploration to polished UI, prototypes, and developer-ready specs.
  • Use AI copilots as leverage, integrating tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Figma AI to ideate, generate flows, run UX writing, produce variants, analyze research, and accelerate production work.
  • Prototype rapidly to test hypotheses early, influence product direction, and align cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborate with product managers to shape problem statements, sharpen requirements, and bring clarity through design thinking and user-centered reasoning.
  • Own UX/UI for multiple markets and verticals, creating experiences across credit cards, loans, insurance, and more.
  • Design for conversion across both core product flows and growth surfaces = campaign pages, microsites, and high-impact landing experiences.
  • Apply and evolve our Figma design system, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and scalability across platforms.
  • Integrate insights from analytics, experimentation, and user feedback to iterate and continuously improve user journeys.
  • Partner closely with engineers to ensure design intent carries through implementation and contribute to QA when needed.
  • Introduce, champion, and document AI-accelerated design practices to help the team work smarter, faster, and with higher quality.


In This Role, We Are Looking For Someone With

  • 7+ years of experience in UX/UI or product design, with a portfolio showcasing both product features and marketing or growth work.
  • Proficient in Figma, with experience working with component libraries and modern design systems.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, responsive layouts, and UX best practices.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as core extensions of your workflow, from ideation to production.
  • Bonus: Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or familiarity with engineering workflows.
  • Fluent in English; Mandarin or Cantonese is a plus.


You’ll Fit Right If You Have

  • A strong product mindset and a bias toward shipping meaningful impact—not just making screens look good.
  • A first-principles approach to problem-solving and the ability to influence PMs and stakeholders through clear reasoning, structured thinking, and evidence-backed design decisions.
  • Experience designing high-conversion, consumer-facing web or mobile experiences.
  • Comfort context-switching between deep product work and fast-turnaround campaign or growth projects.
  • Natural curiosity and enthusiasm for pushing the boundaries of what AI can enable in modern product design.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills - especially when working with remote and cross-functional teams.


#MoneyHeroGroup

What can you expect from us?

Impact: We are actively empowering and connecting people to a better financial future. Join us if you want to help us achieve our mission.

Work: We have a team of over 350 talented individuals in 4 markets who are hyper passionate about building innovative financial solutions and making an impact on people’s lives.

Culture: We take our work seriously but don’t hesitate to keep things light. We can only create magic when we have a little bit of fun.

Thrive: We launched in 2014, and now help over 10 million monthly users make the best financial decisions. Accelerate your career and become a pioneer in your field with a leading fintech company that seeks to push the boundaries of your imagination and is committed to growing your career.

Reputation: We are backed by world-class organizations and companies and have raised over US$110 million from investors including Experian, Pacific Century Group, IFC - a member of the World Bank Group

EEO Statement

MoneyHero Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value, support and respect all individuals and is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse working environment. Decisions in hiring are based on business needs, requirements of the job and individual qualifications and shall not be influenced by any consideration of race, ethnic or national origin, religion, sex (including gender identity and/or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Fullstack Engineer (RAG/LLM)
description:
Key Responsibilities:

The Full-Stack Engineer will play a key role in developing and delivering innovative AI-powered digital services that enhance how users discover, access and interact with data. The role involves end-to-end development of public-facing applications, including AI chatbots, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and other AI-enabled data dissemination solutions.

Working in an agile and collaborative environment, the engineer will engage with internal stakeholders, cross-functional teams and technical teams to ensure seamless system integration and successful delivery of AI initiatives.


  • Develop, deploy and maintain scalable, secure and high-performance AI-enabled web applications, including frontend interfaces, backend services and APIs hosted on cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop AI-powered applications, including chatbots with session and context management, streaming responses and robust error-handling capabilities.
  • Develop and integrate MCP servers and clients to enable AI agents and applications to securely access approved data, tools and internal or external services.
  • Implement application and AI security controls, including authentication, authorization, access management, data protection and safeguards against AI-related vulnerabilities.
  • Develop automated tests and evaluation processes for application functionality, AI chatbot responses, MCP integrations and interoperability to ensure system reliability and quality.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and Quality Assurance (QA) teams to implement CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments and monitor application performance and availability.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, AI response quality, latency and resource utilization. Maintain technical documentation and evaluate emerging technologies where appropriate.


Experience and Skills Required

AI Technologies

  • Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Model (LLM) APIs or SDKs (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent), including prompt management, structured outputs and tool/function calling.
  • Hands-on experience developing MCP servers and integrating MCP clients using relevant SDKs, including tool definitions, resources (where applicable), access controls and schema validation.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including data ingestion, embeddings, semantic or hybrid retrieval, and vector stores where appropriate.

Added Advantage:

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI agents using development frameworks (e.g. OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph) or managed platforms (e.g. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), including workflow orchestration, tool integration, context and memory management, testing and monitoring.


Full-Stack Development

  • Knowledge of computer science and software engineering principles, supported by a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of relevant working experience in software development or a related IT field.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience in frontend and backend development using technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript (React or Next.js) and Python (FastAPI) or Node.js, including responsive web application development and API integration.
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs using REST, GraphQL or gRPC, as well as implementing real-time communication using WebSockets where required.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and containerised deployments (e.g. Docker), with knowledge of container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g. Terraform or AWS CloudFormation).
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) and automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing for applications, APIs and AI/MCP workflows.
  • Knowledge of application monitoring, logging and tracing, including AI service latency, API usage, tool-call failures and operational costs.
  • Knowledge of backend scalability techniques, including caching, rate limiting, load balancing, autoscaling and performance optimisation.


Added Advantage:

  • Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Whole-of-Government Application Analytics (WOGAA) or Google Analytics (GA) for monitoring website traffic, user behaviour and application usage to support performance analysis and continuous improvement.


Security Best Practices

  • Knowledge of web application and cloud security practices, including Content Security Policy (CSP), secure Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) prevention, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, JSON Web Token (JWT) validation, Identity and Access Management (IAM), secrets management, encryption and relevant OWASP guidelines.
  • Understanding of AI and MCP security risks, including prompt injection, sensitive data leakage and unauthorised tool execution, as well as appropriate mitigation measures such as least-privilege access controls and input/output validation.


Added Advantage:

  • Knowledge of the Singapore Government Instruction Manual on Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT&SS) Management (IM8), including relevant security and data protection requirements.

title: Senior / Data Scientist (Model Training and Evaluation) , Giant Robots Labs
description:
The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better. We empower our people to master their craft through continuous and robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Our GovTechies embody our Agile, Bold and Collaborative values to deliver impactful solutions.

GovTech aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

What you will be working on

GovTech is building an in-house capability to evaluate, select and adapt AI models for government use. The team will establish evaluation standards for comparing models on government tasks, behaviours and costs, operate the hosting and evaluation infrastructure behind them, and, where evaluation shows that changing model weights is justified, post-train open-weight models to close the gaps. The emphasis is on building a repeatable capability: reproducible evaluations, documented training recipes and measured costs, rather than one-off experiments.

As a Data Scientist on this team, you will work across the full model engineering lifecycle, from evaluation and diagnosis through data preparation, training and validation. This is hands-on work: you will run experiments, build the datasets and tooling the capability depends on, and document what worked and what did not.

  • Design and build evaluation suites to compare models on government-relevant tasks, behaviours and costs, and establish baselines across prompting, retrieval and tool use
  • Diagnose model weaknesses through observational and controlled evaluations, and determine which gaps persist after prompting, retrieval and tool-use improvements
  • Set up and operate model hosting and evaluation infrastructure, and measure inference performance and cost under realistic workloads
  • Prepare authorised training data: curate demonstrations and preference data, generate and filter synthetic examples, implement quality checks, and maintain strict separation between training and evaluation data
  • Run post-training experiments such as supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient tuning, preference optimisation and distillation, varying data composition and hyperparameters in a controlled way
  • Evaluate trained models against untrained baselines, quantify improvements, regressions and costs, and document training recipes so that results can be independently reproduced
  • Work with government agencies to assess data readiness, identify usable data sources, and assemble training examples and evaluation cases
  • Engage external partners, including research institutes and local companies, for technical exchange and knowledge transfer
  • Write clear technical documentation: evaluation reports, training specifications, cost analyses, and records of both successful and unsuccessful approaches

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, AI/Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field, with at least 2-3 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates will be assessed based on their experience and may be considered at the intermediate or senior level.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with the modern deep learning stack (e.g. PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers)
  • Practical experience fine-tuning or post-training language models (e.g. supervised fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, DPO or similar preference optimisation methods), with the ability to debug training runs and reason about failures
  • Strong grounding in evaluation methodology and experiment design: constructing baselines and held-out test sets, controlling variables, and drawing honest conclusions from results, including negative ones
  • Experience building and cleaning datasets for model training and evaluation, including data pipelines, deduplication, filtering and data quality assessment, and the patience to do this work well
  • Working knowledge of GPU infrastructure and inference serving (e.g. vLLM, SGLang or similar), including quantisation and the measurement of throughput and cost, in cloud or on-premises environments
  • Effective and critical use of LLMs and AI coding tools: able to leverage them to move fast, while exercising judgment on output quality
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and evaluation findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a disposition towards evidence: willing to report what the results show, including when an approach does not work

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience fine-tuning models that span multiple GPUs (e.g. with FSDP or DeepSpeed)
  • Experience with reinforcement learning based post-training (e.g. RLHF, PPO, GRPO) or model distillation
  • Experience with continued pre-training or large-scale pre-training of language models, including building and curating large training corpora
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for language models, including LLM-as-judge pipelines
  • Experience with synthetic data generation for model training
  • Experience handling sensitive data or working in regulated environments, including data governance and data handling requirements
  • Experience engaging stakeholders across organisations, such as sourcing data from partner agencies or coordinating with external research partners

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programmes.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: AI Agent Engineer - TikTok LIVE (Singapore)
description:
Responsibilities
Team Introduction
We are the core team responsible for the performance experience of TikTok LIVE, dedicated to safeguarding and continuously enhancing the end-to-end experience for billions of users worldwide—from discovering a live stream to the moment creators go live.
In the context of globalization, with diverse network environments, device ecosystems, and user behaviors, we proactively identify performance bottlenecks and experience gaps by building a systematic end-to-end metrics framework and diagnostic system.
We champion “AI-driven” and “proactive leadership” as our core value creation principles. Our mission is to build industry-leading performance analysis agents and intelligent platforms—automating repetitive analysis into scalable insights, and leveraging technological innovation to directly improve live streaming experience and drive business growth at a global scale.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:
- Work at the forefront of technology: Help build industry-leading performance analysis agents and redefine the paradigm of performance optimization in the live streaming domain.
- Create real business impact: Your work will be applied to one of the world’s largest live streaming platforms, solving complex, high-impact technical challenges.
- Unlock significant growth opportunities: Grow in a fast-moving, innovation-driven global team, and collaborate with top talent worldwide.
We believe the best talent is driven to solve the most important problems using cutting-edge technologies. If you are passionate about AI, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences, we look forward to building a smoother and smarter LIVE future with you.
Core Responsibilities
As a core member of the team, you will be deeply involved in the design, R&D, and platform implementation of the Performance Analysis Agent, transforming cutting-edge AI technologies into a powerful engine that drives business growth.
1. Design and develop the core capabilities of the Performance Analysis Agent
Lead or contribute to developing AI-powered capabilities for the performance analysis workflow, including but not limited to:
- Automatic Data Inspection and Attribution: Real-time monitoring, anomaly detection, and minute-level automated attribution of massive performance metrics.
- Automation of Experimental Analysis: Automatically generate scientific and rigorous A/B experiment reports to improve decision-making efficiency and quality.
- Thematic Analysis Assistance: Provide AI support for complex performance topics (e.g., power consumption, smoothness, loading speed) and produce in-depth insights at scale.
- Shift-Left Code Performance Review: Integrate AI into the Code Review (CR) phase to automatically detect performance risks, identify issues early, and address them at the source.
2. Build and evolve the Agent platform and services
Contribute to the development and evolution of the team’s Agent platform, upgrading traditional APIs to a more powerful and flexible MCP (Model-Controller-Proxy) service framework. Strengthen the data and tooling foundation to enhance overall scalability, reusability, and reliability.
3. Continuously improve Agent core performance
Leverage industry-leading technologies to enhance the Agent’s accuracy and efficiency in understanding, retrieval, decision-making, and response, including:
- Prompt Engineering and Chain of Thought (CoT): Design and optimize prompts to fully unleash large model capabilities.
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Combine with high-quality knowledge bases to improve accuracy and timeliness of responses.
- Function Calling: Extend the Agent’s ability to interact with external tools and data sources.
- Memory Mechanism and Evaluation Iteration: Enable the Agent to learn and iterate while establishing a robust, scientific evaluation system.
4. Drive the AI value closed loop
Deeply understand live streaming business and technical pain points, identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation, and work closely with business, product, and R&D teams to turn AI solutions into measurable outcomes—improving R&D efficiency, service quality, and user experience metrics.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
We value your passion for technology, understanding and insight into business, as well as past achievements. We hope you possess excellent fundamental capabilities and growth potential:
1. Strong engineering and implementation skills
Possess excellent coding ability and solid software engineering fundamentals. Familiar with at least one mainstream backend development language (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Rust, C++), and capable of independently designing and implementing complex systems.
2. Familiarity with the LLM and Agent technology ecosystem
Have a deep understanding of large language models (LLMs), be familiar with mainstream Agent paradigms, and have practical experience integrating AI technologies into real-world workflows (partial experience is also acceptable).
3. Excellent problem decomposition and system design skills
Able to clearly break down and abstract complex, ambiguous business problems into scalable system architectures and reusable technical solutions.
4. Strong technical curiosity and learning ability
Maintain a high level of enthusiasm for cutting-edge technologies, continuously follow industry best practices, and quickly learn and apply new knowledge to practical work.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Hands-on project experience with AI Agents or related fields, including leading or deeply participating in Agent design and implementation.
- In-depth understanding or work experience in performance analysis, observability, or data analysis.
- Basic knowledge of the live streaming technology stack (e.g., audio/video, network transmission, rendering).
- Active participation in high-quality open-source projects or recognized influence in the technical community.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

title: Manager, Government Relations
company: The Chamber of Commerce for Greater Philadelphia
description:
The Greater Philadelphia Chamber (The Chamber) brings area businesses and civic leaders together to amplify the impact of business in the region, advocate for a competitive business climate and grow a vibrant and diverse business community in order to achieve our vision: The Greater Philadelphia Region is a top global destination for business and a leader in inclusive growth.

About This Role


The Chamber is seeking an experienced government relations professional to help execute its state and federal government relations strategy and advance the organization’s policy priorities. This individual will build and maintain trusted relationships with government officials, monitor political, legislative, regulatory, and budget developments, provide timely intelligence and strategic guidance, and engage members and stakeholders in support of Chamber priorities. The position reports to the Vice President, Government Relations, and operates within the Chamber’s External Affairs and Government Relations Business Unit.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


State Government Relations (approx. 35%): Advance and execute the Chamber’s state government relations agenda by engaging policymakers, providing political and policy intelligence, informing members, and helping move priority legislation, budget items, and regulatory issues, including:

  • Monitor and assess relevant legislative, budget, regulatory, and political developments, identifying opportunities, risks, and key decision points; prepare regular updates for members and governance;
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with members and staff of the General Assembly, the Governor’s Administration, and other state officials, and conduct direct outreach on Chamber policy priorities;
  • Draft legislative briefing materials, correspondence, testimony, and other communications for members, governance, and policymakers; and
  • Coordinate with Advocacy and External Affairs when member voices, coalition partners, stakeholder engagement, or public communications can strengthen the government relations strategy.


Federal Government Relations (approx. 20%): Lead day-to-day execution of the organization’s federal government relations agenda to advance a focused set of high-impact priorities for Greater Philadelphia, including:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the regional congressional delegation and staff and relevant federal officials;
  • Monitor federal policy and political developments and engage national partners, including the U.S. Chamber, ACCE, and the Businesses for Federal Research Funding Coalition, to identify opportunities, manage risks, and amplify regional priorities; and
  • Serve as the organization’s point of contact for federal communications, gatherings, issue response, and letters of support.


Events & Cross-Functional Coordination (approx. 30%): Coordinate execution of government relations priorities across the organization in partnership with Advocacy, Board Relations, Events, Member Engagement, Sponsorship, and Marketing, including:

  • Lead signature government relations events, including the Congressional Staff Reception, Governor’s event, and Harrisburg Reception;
  • Develop, manage, and engage government affairs contacts, including convening, preparing for, and executing several gatherings annually, while coordinating state, federal, and local work when issues or political dynamics cross jurisdictions; and
  • Convene internal cross-functional teams as needed to support government strategy, communications, stakeholder engagement, Board materials, activities, and member and investor engagement and retention.

ChamberPHL PAC (approx. 15%): Support and strategically grow ChamberPHL PAC as a Chamber asset that strengthens political engagement and the broader government relations strategy, including:

  • Manage the ChamberPHL PAC Board of Directors through regular engagement, agenda-setting, and board communications;
  • Develop an internal PAC solicitation toolkit of collateral and talking points to integrate and increase visibility of the PAC at Chamber activities and in relevant communications; and
  • Support of PAC candidate assessment process.


Job Specifications & Requirements

Required

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain productive relationships with elected and appointed officials and their staff, and to use those relationships to advance policy priorities.
  • Professional experience in government, government relations, public affairs, or a related field, including direct engagement with legislators, executive branch officials, or their staff on policy issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Ability to travel regularly within the Greater Philadelphia area, including monthly or quarterly visits to Harrisburg, PA, and/or Washington, D.C.
  • Strong knowledge of state and/or federal legislative, regulatory, budget, and political processes; sound political judgment and discretion; and the ability to translate complex policy into clear business impacts.
  • Experience drafting testimony, public comments, briefing materials, or other policy communications.
  • Experience planning and executing events or convenings involving elected officials or senior stakeholders, including invitations, run of show, briefing materials, and follow-up.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage concurrent state, federal, and PAC priorities and to coordinate cross-functional teams toward shared deadlines.
  • Ability to support member and investor engagement and retention in partnership with revenue-generating teams.

Preferred

  • Experience working in or directly with Pennsylvania state government, including the General Assembly or the Governor’s Administration.
  • Experience engaging the regional congressional delegation, federal agencies, or national partners such as the U.S. Chamber or ACCE.
  • Experience with PAC, political fundraising, campaign, or development operations, such as soliciting contributions, setting and tracking participation and contribution goals, and supporting a board or committee.
  • Master’s degree in Public Administration or a related field.


Working at the Chamber

Working at the Chamber offers the resources and stability of a mid-sized business with the purpose-driven mission of a nonprofit. Our team of about 65 is large enough to offer strong support, yet small enough to give you room to lead, grow, and make your mark—with access to a wide regional network, professional development, competitive compensation, and an outstanding benefits package.

The Chamber operates in a hybrid environment, with employees working in person at least two days per week; exceptions may be made based on departmental needs. This role requires attending Chamber-hosted or partner events outside regular business hours and outside Center City Philadelphia.

Compensation

The hiring range for this position is $65,000–$75,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus the opportunity to earn an additional performance-based bonus.

Application Instructions

Qualified candidates should submit a cover letter and resume. Applications that fail to fulfill this requirement will not be considered.

The Greater Philadelphia Chamber is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to building a culturally diverse staff. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Scientist to support 4–5 product squads delivering AI-enabled solutions and workflow transformation initiatives for government agencies. This role focuses on leveraging large-scale operational data to uncover insights, identify anomalies and risk patterns, and develop predictive models that enhance decision-making and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across the full data science lifecycle, from exploratory analysis and model development to building scalable data pipelines and deploying production-ready solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze large operational datasets to identify trends, anomalies, outliers, and risk indicators.
  • Develop analytical solutions involving anomaly detection, clustering, segmentation, and risk-scoring methodologies.
  • Build and evaluate supervised machine learning models using historical and labeled datasets.
  • Perform feature engineering using both structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Design and execute model evaluation frameworks, including precision, recall, false-positive, and false-negative analysis.
  • Collaborate with domain experts to integrate analytical outputs into operational workflows and business processes.
  • Build and maintain scalable data processing and feature engineering pipelines.
  • Develop and deploy production-ready models and scoring solutions integrated with applications used by delivery teams.
  • Monitor model performance, data quality, and potential data drift post-deployment.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover opportunities for workflow optimization and automation.
  • Support the adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI techniques alongside traditional statistical and machine learning approaches.
  • Develop reusable analytical frameworks, assets, and components that can be leveraged across multiple government agency engagements.


Requirements & Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Atleast 5 years of experience working with large-scale, complex operational or transactional datasets.
  • Hands-on experience in applied data science, including statistical analysis, feature engineering, machine learning, and model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with techniques such as anomaly detection, classification, clustering, and risk modeling.
  • Experience building robust data pipelines and deploying machine learning models into production environments.

Technical Competencies

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Ability to translate business or operational challenges into analytical problems and identify the most suitable modeling approach.
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices, including Git, APIs, and automated testing.
  • Strong understanding of model performance trade-offs and the ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to containerization technologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps/ModelOps practices.
  • Experience with modern AI technologies, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and ambiguous environment.
  • Effective collaboration skills with engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on delivering practical, scalable solutions that drive operational outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Only Singaporeans may apply

Network & Connectivity

Certification Authority (CA) Management

FinOps & Cost Optimisation

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and incident reports.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives.


Operational Support

  • Participate in after-hours/weekend/public holiday support for maintenance, deployments, and critical incident response.
  • Perform OS/software patching and hardware maintenance during off-peak hours.


What you’ll gain

At SimplyGo, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We ASPIRE to create a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive.

Professional

Individual

  • Comprehensive benefits to support your lifestyle and wellbeing.
  • Flexibility with hybrid work options and supportive arrangements.
  • Wellbeing initiatives designed to keep you healthy, balanced, and engaged.


How to Apply

title: Applied Behavioral & Organizational Science - Adjunct Instructor
description:
Sacred Heart University’s Institute for Applied Behavioral & Organizational Sciences in the College of Arts & Sciences invites applications for Adjunct Professors to join a pool of qualified instructors for the Master of Science in Organizational Development & Psychology (MSODP). Adjunct assignments are made course by course, as program needs arise.
We’re looking for scholar-practitioners: people who have done this work in real organizations and want to help graduate students learn to do it well. If you can explain the theory, show where it holds up in practice, and admit where it doesn’t, we’d like to hear from you.
The MSODP prepares graduates to improve organizations by understanding and facilitating change in both people and systems. The 36-credit program is taught online asynchronously with three optional live, synchronous sessions, and students can finish in one year full-time or two years part-time. Its curriculum is built from ongoing analysis of real job descriptions and emerging workforce demands. Small classes and close faculty mentorship help students do three things: lead human-centered change, demonstrate measurable impact, and graduate with a meaningful career advantage.
Our faculty work as a team. Courses are being redesigned together so that each one builds the same core capabilities from a different angle, and adjunct faculty are invited into that work rather than handed a finished syllabus and left alone.
Teaching Areas:
The program seeks adjunct faculty with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Research, Measurement & Analytics
Industrial-Organizational Psychology & Talent
Organization Development, Leadership & Change
Applied Practice

For a complete list of courses and course descriptions, please visit the MS Organizational Development & Psychology curriculum.
Applicants should identify the course(s) or teaching areas they are qualified and interested in teaching in their letter of interest.
Across all of these courses, the Adjunct Professor will help students move from analysis to application, using real or simulated organizational cases to show how evidence-based decisions improve both performance and well-being.
Requirements:

Master’s or doctoral degree in Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Organization Development, Organizational Behavior, Human Resource Development, Human Factors/Ergonomics, or a closely related field.
Applied professional experience in the area(s) you wish to teach, such as research and analytics, assessment and selection, training and development, organizational design, change leadership, or consulting.
Working knowledge of the professional, ethical, and legal standards relevant to your teaching area (for example, the SIOP Principles and the Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures for assessment and selection courses).
Demonstrated commitment to excellence in graduate teaching, including the ability to lead engaging live online sessions.
Prior college-level teaching experience is preferred.
Familiarity with the Blackboard online teaching platform.
Willingness to work with program faculty on course alignment, including applied cases, analytics or assessment activities, and sociotechnical systems perspectives.
Commitment to fostering a collegial and supportive learning environment that reflects the University’s mission and values.

Application Instructions:
Qualified applicants are invited to submit a letter of interest that names the course(s) or teaching area(s) they are prepared to teach, a current CV, a statement of teaching philosophy, and relevant examples from courses taught or applied projects completed (if applicable; please remove any confidential client information).
Upon offer of employment, the selected candidate will be required to provide one formal letter of recommendation on professional letterhead and an official transcript showing their highest earned degree.
Questions about this position may be addressed to Dr. William Brendel, Director of the MS Program in Organizational Development & Psychology at the Institute for Applied Behavioral & Organizational Sciences.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted as teaching needs arise. Courses are offered in modules throughout the academic year.
Online submissions only, please.

title: POS & IT Support Specialist

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience in POS system support, retail or F&B technology, application support, or IT helpdesk operations is preferred.
  • Familiarity with POS software, hardware peripherals, and basic troubleshooting procedures.
  • Basic understanding of networking, databases, SQL, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Experience supporting inventory management or warehouse management systems would be an advantage.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to support both technical and non-technical users.
  • Able to manage multiple tasks, prioritise issues, and work independently as well as within a team.
  • Willingness to provide after-hours or weekends if necessary
  • Experience in project management and system implementation.
  • Strong vendor management and budgeting experience.
  • Knowledge of IT governance, risk management, and business continuity planning.
  • Available in short notice is an advantage.


Core Competencies

  • Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Customer service and user support
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Vendor and stakeholder coordination
  • Project coordination and execution
  • Time management and prioritisation
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced operational environment


Perks and Benefits

  • Company Culture: Our company values teamwork, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We celebrate diversity, inclusivity, and a sense of belonging, ensuring that you feel valued and appreciated as part of our family!
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary package that will be commensurate with your experience and skills, ensuring that your hard work and dedication are rewarded.

title: Admissions Representative
description:
Help prospective students take the next step in their education
Do you enjoy connecting with people, learning about their goals, and helping them explore educational opportunities? Southern Careers Institute is looking for an Admissions Representative who brings initiative, strong communication skills, and dependable follow-through to our Austin Campus.
Your ability to listen, explain options, and guide the admissions process can help someone make an informed decision about career training. If you have experience in student recruitment, admissions, community outreach, recruiting, or customer service and want to help people pursue their educational goals, we want to hear from you.
The opportunity
You will build relationships with prospective students, conduct admissions interviews and campus tours, and help applicants navigate enrollment and prepare for their start. You will also represent SCI in the community and develop additional sources of prospective-student interest through networking, events, referrals, and approved social media outreach. The role includes clear recruitment goals, regular coaching, and accountability for timely, accurate student support.
What you will do

Connect promptly with people exploring career training through calls and approved text and email outreach.
Understand their goals, explain relevant programs, and address questions with accurate information.
Help prospective students understand their next steps and follow through on appointments, applications, and enrollment requirements.
Keep your CRM organized, manage competing priorities, and coordinate with campus teams to prepare students for their start.
Work toward activity and enrollment goals while respecting student decisions and ethical recruitment standards.

Build connections in the community
An important part of this position is helping new prospective students discover SCI through relationships you develop in the community.

Build a network of schools, employers, workforce organizations, nonprofits, and other local partners.
Participate in community events, career fairs, and educational outreach activities.
Share approved content and engage with interested individuals through professional social media outreach.
Foster referral relationships with students, alumni, and community contacts, and invite interested individuals to campus tours and information sessions.
Follow up with community-generated inquiries and track outreach activities and admissions progress.

What you bring

Experience building relationships and achieving goals in admissions, student recruitment, community outreach, recruiting, customer service, or a comparable role.
Confidence on the phone, strong listening skills, and the discipline to follow up consistently.
Resilience, coachability, and ownership of your daily work.
High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

Why SCI
At Southern Careers Institute, your work can help someone see a future they may not yet believe is possible. As an Admissions Representative, you have the opportunity to listen to a person’s goals, help them explore their options, and support the next step in their education and life. That first conversation can be the beginning of a journey you follow from a campus visit to the first day of class—and ultimately to graduation.
Make an impact in your community
SCI averages more than 4,000 graduates per year, sending people with new skills and qualifications into their communities. Behind each graduate is an individual working toward a different future, often with family members and others sharing in that journey. Your work helps connect people to education that can expand their opportunities while supporting the workforce needs of local employers.
SCI also awards millions of dollars in scholarships to students, helping reduce financial barriers to education. As part of the admissions team, you help prospective students discover the opportunities available to them and connect with the teams that can explain eligibility and support.
Help students feel excited about their future
Be part of the moments when uncertainty begins to turn into a plan: a prospective student discovering a career field, visiting a classroom, meeting an instructor, or preparing to return to school. This role gives you the opportunity to encourage people, recognize their progress, and help them move forward with a clearer understanding of what comes next.
The relationships you build matter. A thoughtful conversation, a timely follow-up, or help navigating an unfamiliar process can make a meaningful difference in a student’s experience.
Grow with an institution that keeps evolving
SCI continues to introduce new programs in response to market demand and changing workforce needs. That ongoing development gives the admissions team new educational pathways to discuss, new communities to reach, and new opportunities to learn. You will work alongside colleagues in education, financial aid, student services, and career services, gaining a broader understanding of how a career education institution supports its students.
Build a lasting career in education
SCI offers onboarding, ongoing training, coaching, and professional development to help you strengthen your communication, student recruitment, community engagement, and admissions skills. As you build experience and demonstrate results, you can pursue opportunities for greater responsibility and career growth within the institution.
For someone who enjoys helping people and wants to keep developing professionally, admissions can be the foundation of a lasting career in education. At SCI, you can contribute to students’ futures while building your own.

As one of Singapore’s key trade systems, TradeNet is being brought in-house to strengthen technology ownership and long-term sustainability.

How we build

Designated as critical IT infrastructure, we favor simple, durable technology choices over the latest trends. We prioritize systems that are easy to reason about, operate, and maintain for the long term.

We operate with high autonomy. Engineers are expected to think deeply, exercise sound judgement, and take ownership of technical decisions. You own the code from technical design through to production. We practice and value honest feedback, practical decision-making and real impact.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and support the software products underpinning the TradeNet Rebuild
  • Take complex problems from an ambiguous brief through to a production-ready state, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Advocate for your technical proposals using data and sound judgment, while remaining receptive to feedback and diverse perspectives
  • Identify bottlenecks and improvements to our systems, tooling, and ways of working and drive those changes through to completion
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and non-technical stakeholders to translate complex trade requirements into resilient, performant systems

[What we are looking for]

  • Relevant degree or diploma in Computer Science or a related field
  • Around 3-4+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally with experience working on complex, large-scale systems or projects
  • Solid engineering fundamentals across the full development lifecycle, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and security
  • Experience deploying and operating applications on cloud platforms, with familiarity in containerisation and orchestration
  • Either full stack specialist with Kotlin and ReactJS experience, or backend specialist with deep experience in Kotlin and relational databases (such as PostgreSQL).
  • Proactive ownership: A self-starter who takes accountability for code from initial design through to production support
  • Collaborative growth mindset: Dedicated to continuous learning and fostering a transparent culture through knowledge exchange
  • Technical courage: Ability to challenge assumptions respectfully with reasoned and practical technical proposals

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

title: L&I Vocational Services Specialist 2 (Spanish Bilingual)
description:
Description

Our Mission: Keep Washington Safe and Working!
Our Values: Customer Focus, One L&I, Respect, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Learning and Growth, Reliability

Employees with bilingual responsibilities receive a 5% increase in pay in addition to the base salary listed above.

Job Highlights

Bring your skills and talent to the Department of Labor & Industries (L&I), the employer of choice. Join our team and work in a positive, goal-oriented atmosphere as our next Vocational Services Specialist 2 (VSS2) with the Early Return to Work Consultation (ERTWC) team.

As the ERTWC VSS 2 you will utilize your vocational experience and knowledge along with your bilingual Spanish skills to educate and assist employers in setting up return to work programs. In this position, you will support the state’s economic well-being by assisting employers to return injured workers to work as quickly and safely as possible.

Why Work for us:

The Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) is a diverse state agency dedicated to the safety, health, and security of Washington's workers. We help employers meet safety and health standards and inspect workplaces when alerted to hazards. As administrators of the state's workers' compensation system, we are similar to a large insurance company providing medical and limited wage-replacement coverage to workers who suffer job-related injuries and illness. Our rules and enforcement programs help ensure workers are paid what they are owed, that children and teens' work hours are limited, and that consumers are protected from unsound business practices.

Insurance Services is the largest division within the agency and administers one of the premier workers’ compensation organizations in the nation serving over 3.8 million employees working for 260,000 employers.

The Employer Services program within the Insurance Services Division is responsible for establishing and maintaining industrial insurance accounts for over 180,000+ employers and 2.5 million employees doing business throughout the state of Washington. The program provides a wide array of services to employers in the State Fund from helping new businesses get workers’ compensation coverage to specialized underwriting.

The Early Return to Work Consultation (ERTWC) team provides expertise and assistance to employers and workers, even before an on the job injury, by helping remove barriers that prevent injured workers from maintaining employment.

Here is what we are looking for:

  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to listen and connect with others to build and maintain positive, respectful working relationships and partnerships with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex information clearly and succinctly in a way that is easy to understand for a variety of audiences both orally and in written format.
  • Ability to conduct outreach, training and present information to a variety of audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt to changes.
  • Your proven knowledge or ability to conduct research, analyze policies, rules, or regulations.
  • An individual who is detail-oriented, and able to effectively prioritize assignments to produce work products that are accurate, thorough and on-time.
  • Your willingness to learn by showing self-initiative to develop and upgrade your skills, enhance your knowledge, and learn new technology.
  • Knowledge and experience with workers’ compensation systems, disability management, and Return to Work. Experience with WA State’s system is a plus.

Duties

Some of what you will do:

  • Communicate with employers and employees in Spanish and English via phone, email, in person, and letters to resolve questions or complaints.
  • Research and identify employers that could benefit from outreach services.
  • Assist workers with understanding the Return-to-Work (RTW) process.
  • Assist and educate employers in identifying and developing light duty jobs, job descriptions, and job offer letters.
  • Educate employers on RTW processes, best practices and assist them to implement an effective return to work program.
  • Inform and educate employers on the Light Duty Return to Work, WA Stay at Work, and Preferred Worker Programs.
  • Develop job analyses, following WAC 296-19A-137 and WAC 296-19A-170.
  • Conduct ergonomic evaluations.
  • Provides on-site evaluations of worksites to complete job descriptions, job analysis, ergonomic evaluations, and modification of jobs.
  • Refer employer to internal partners, such as Risk Management and Safety.
  • Use flexible and agile communication skills to persuade and inform all contributors about requirements and expectations in the RTW process.
  • Present on-site educational workshops for employers, employees, and other professionals in the field of worker’s compensation on topics concerning return to work.
  • Meet with employers, workers, medical providers, claim managers, and other contributors to facilitate return to work.
  • And much more!

Qualifications

Required:

  • Master's Degree AND a CRC*, CDMS* or ABVE* certification.
    AND
  • ONE (1) year of full-time industrial insurance, disability management, or related field experience.

OR

  • Bachelor's Degree AND a CRC* or CDMS* certification.
    AND
  • TWO (2) years of full-time industrial insurance, disability management, or related experience.

*CRC = Certified Rehabilitation Counselor; CDMS = Certified Disability Management Specialist; ABVE = American Board of Vocational Experts.

AND

  • The ability to take action to learn and grow.
  • The ability to take action to meet the needs of others.
  • Bilingual Skills. The ability to read, write, translate and converse fluently in both Spanish and English.

AND

Please Note: Driving is an essential function of this position. Individuals selected to fill this role must possess a valid unrestricted driver’s license and show proof of personal liability insurance.

• Quarterly Oracle patch testing : analyse release notes for impact on RMCS, Revenue Accounting, AR and Tax; define sanity → focused → full regression scope by revenue-recognition risk; prepare environments and data; execute scenarios, capture evidence and own the tracker.

• Integration and data validation: validate the chain upstream source → Fusion → RMCS → revenue accounting → GL → reporting; interfaces (OIC, REST/SOAP, SFTP); Fusion-to-RMCS migration correctness; SQL queries as reconciliation evidence.

• Project and enhancement testing: functional, integration/E2E and regression testing for revenue projects — reconciliation migration to out-of-the-box Oracle Revenue Management, RMCS data-model and upstream application changes, contract-compliance validation; test strategy, scenarios, cases and RTM.

• Defect management: log defects with repro steps, evidence, severity and functional RCA; adhere to SLAs and escalation protocol.

• Close, control and reporting: support quarter-end revenue close and reporting; production validation after deployment; SOX-style evidence and audit support; status updates, test summary and sign-off packs; work with Revenue/Controllership SMEs, engineering and Oracle consultants.

Required Skills (Must Have)

• Hands-on functional knowledge of Oracle Revenue Management (RMCS) — contracts, performance obligations, recognition, scheduling, ESS jobs — and Oracle Fusion Receivables.

• Strong revenue accounting fundamentals: recognition principles, deferred vs. recognised revenue, billing-to-revenue reconciliation, subledger-to-GL flows; working knowledge of transaction tax / WHT.

• Test scenario/case design, execution and evidence; defect lifecycle and triage; SIT/UAT support; ERP patch and regression testing; release-note impact analysis; RTM, test summary reports and sign-off packs.

• Clear, numbers-first status reporting; thinks like a functional consultant, not a script-runner.

Good to Have

• Automation and data (strongly preferred): automating long-running ESS/job-dependent flows, Playwright, AI-agent test execution, SQL for revenue reconciliation.

• Jira / ALM; Postman / API testing; Claude-assisted test authoring.

title: Software Engineer, AI Integrations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, AI Integrations based in Mexico.

The Software Engineer, AI Integrations will play a key role in expanding how developers and businesses access web data through AI-powered tools and integrations. You will design, build, and maintain integrations connecting APIs and data services with coding agents, developer frameworks, cloud platforms, and automation tools. Working primarily with Python, TypeScript, and emerging AI technologies, you will help create seamless workflows that make complex data capabilities easier to adopt. You will contribute to the development of command-line tools, SDKs, connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based solutions. Collaborating with cross-functional teams in a globally distributed environment, you will help drive developer adoption through reliable integrations and high-quality documentation. This is an opportunity to shape an evolving integration ecosystem at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and developer tools.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will build and maintain developer-focused integrations that make web data services accessible through AI coding agents, frameworks, cloud platforms, and automation ecosystems. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and publish integrations that connect web data services with coding-agent environments such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Docker, building on existing MCP infrastructure.
  • Design, develop, and release a shared command-line interface (CLI), publishing packages through PyPI and npm.
  • Build and maintain packages, tools, and connectors for developer frameworks and agent SDKs, including LangChain and LlamaIndex, as well as browser automation tools.
  • Implement recurring data delivery solutions for customer cloud and data platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and Snowflake, leveraging existing export capabilities where possible.
  • Evaluate application-building and automation platforms such as Dify, Flowise, Make, Zapier, Lovable, and Replit, developing prototypes and templates where they can generate sustained product adoption.
  • Assess potential integrations by estimating technical feasibility, development effort, dependencies, and long-term maintenance requirements.
  • Implement tracking mechanisms to measure signups and usage attributable to individual integrations, identifying any gaps in attribution.
  • Create clear setup guides, technical documentation, and practical examples for developers and AI coding agents across public repositories and documentation platforms.
  • Manage submissions to partner directories, registries, and marketplaces, including addressing technical feedback and review requirements.
  • Maintain and improve existing integrations by monitoring partner tool updates, resolving issues, and managing releases and versioning.
  • Collaborate with Product, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations teams on product launches, positioning, and developer community engagement.
  • Work with SaaS and Platform engineering teams to ensure the stability and reliability of the underlying API and cloud infrastructure.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and regular team activities within an agile, cross-functional environment.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with practical experience building developer tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows. You should be comfortable working independently, navigating evolving technical requirements, and delivering solutions that drive measurable developer adoption. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

  • Strong programming skills in Python, with solid experience in TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Proven experience developing SDKs, client libraries, command-line interfaces, plugins, or third-party integrations used by external developers.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-calling interfaces.
  • Experience publishing and maintaining software packages through PyPI and npm, including version management, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and release processes.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure credential management across client-side and server-side environments.
  • Strong outcome-oriented mindset, with a focus on developer adoption, product usage, and continuous improvement through data-driven decisions.
  • Excellent written English skills, particularly for producing technical documentation, setup instructions, and practical code examples.
  • Ability to work effectively with ambiguity, independently assess technical challenges, and scope projects in an evolving team environment.

Additional Qualifications (Preferred)

  • Experience working in a distributed, remote-first international team.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other AI agent development frameworks and SDKs.
  • Experience with AWS or Google Cloud data services, including S3, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery, or with Snowflake.
  • Knowledge of web scraping technologies, Scrapy, or browser automation tools such as Playwright and Selenium.
  • Previous experience maintaining open-source projects or working in Developer Relations.

Benefits

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the freedom to work from the location where you are most productive.
  • Flexible working environment that supports autonomy and work-life balance.
  • 35 days of paid holidays.
  • Opportunity to join a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural international team.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge open-source technologies, AI tools, and modern software development practices.
  • Opportunity to contribute to innovative developer tools and integrations at the intersection of AI and data technology.

title: Laser Operator - Skid Steer Direct FAB
description:
Company Profile
With over 80 years of innovation, JCB is the world’s largest privately owned manufacturer of construction and agricultural equipment. Operating 23 manufacturing facilities across four continents—including the United States, the United Kingdom, India, and Brazil—JCB produces a diverse portfolio of more than 300 products. These include telescopic handlers, backhoe loaders, excavators, wheel loaders, compact excavators, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, access aerial work platforms, rough terrain forklifts, and tractors.

At the heart of JCB’s success are its people. As a family-owned business, we are accountable to our customers—not shareholders—which gives us the flexibility to focus on long-term innovation and delivering real value. This independence allows us to continuously develop advanced technologies and integrate them into equipment designed to perform in the toughest environments while maximizing customer productivity.

At JCB, we stand behind our products—and our name—with pride and commitment to quality.

Position Purpose
The CNC Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining advanced laser cutting, brake press and plasma equipment to support the production of heavy-duty construction and industrial equipment at JCB North America. This role ensures precision cutting, quality output, and optimal machine performance while maintaining safety, efficiency, and adherence to production schedules.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced fabrication environment, supporting continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Position Type
Full Time, Non-Exempt

Location
2000 Bamford Blvd, Pooler, Georgia 31322

Benefits and Other Compensation
JCB offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401 (k) retirement plan; paid time off and paid holidays.

Application Process
Applications will be accepted through Careers | JCB Careers | JCB Jobs | JCB or via LinkedIn. The anticipated application window will close on November 16, 2026.
Major Tasks, Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities
Laser Operations & Machine Setup

Set up, program, and operate CNC laser cutting, brake press and plasma equipment to perform precision cutting operations on metal components
Select appropriate cutting programs, fixtures, and tooling based on part specifications and production requirements
Adjust and maintain laser beam focal points, alignment, and cutting parameters to ensure optimal performance and quality
Perform machine setup and changeovers to support production schedules and minimize downtime

Equipment Maintenance & Calibration

Perform routine machine maintenance, including:
Optic cleaning (lenses and mirrors)
Tape shots
Preventative maintenance checks
Conduct minor troubleshooting and adjustments to maintain equipment at peak operating performance
Monitor machine performance and document operational metrics

Quality Assurance & Inspection

Perform dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring tools to ensure parts meet specifications
Identify, troubleshoot, and report defective materials or process issues to Team Lead or Supervisor
Ensure all work meets quality standards and engineering specifications

Material Handling & Production Support

Prepare and stage raw materials for production
Safely load and unload materials using appropriate equipment
Support overall fabrication workflow to ensure continuous production and meet output targets

Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

Apply problem-solving tools and lean manufacturing principles to improve laser cutting operations
Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and eliminate defects
Partner with fabrication, quality, and engineering teams to drive process improvements

Safety & Housekeeping

Maintain a clean and organized work area in accordance with 5S and safety standards
Adhere to all safety procedures and PPE requirements
Ensure safe operation of all machinery and equipment at all times
Perform other duties as assigned to support manufacturing operations

Minimum Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent
Certificate in Laser Technology or related field from an accredited technical school
Minimum 2+ years of experience operating CNC laser cutting equipment
5+ years of experience working in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
Ability to pass all pre-employment requirements (drug screen, background check, etc.)
Must pass any drug screens, background checks, and any pre-employment tests, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable law.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in heavy equipment or industrial manufacturing environments
Familiarity with CNC programming and nesting software
Experience working with structural steel, plate, or heavy-gauge materials
Forklift certification (or ability to obtain)

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies

Strong understanding of laser cutting processes, machine setup, and material properties
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and work instructions
Proficiency in operating laser systems, press brakes, and fabrication equipment
High attention to detail with a focus on precision and quality control
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Ability to multi-task and adapt in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy
Effective communication and teamwork skills
Flexibility to work overtime or varying shifts as required
Must wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times

Job Conditions

Both office environment and occasionally manufacturing/factory environment.
Subject to noise and temperature changes.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those required of an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

Must be able to work flexible schedule, including Friday - Sunday 6am -6pm
Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10lbs, frequently and/or move up to 35lbs, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50lbs.
Must be able to perform continuous, repetitious physical activities. These activities may involve fine movements or large motions.
Must be able to grasp/pinch small items, reach out and up, and turn wrist.
Must be capable of keeping pace with current production speed.
Must be able to push/pull with reasonable force.
Must be able to perform the following requirements of bending, stooping, climbing, kneeling, and standing for extended periods of time.
Must be able to work in multiple climates including hot/cold temperatures, and dusty environment.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Overseas Business – Business Performance Analytics
description:
Responsibilities

1. Business Target Setting and Management

2. Initiative Contribution Measurement and Performance Tracking

Distinguish baseline growth from incremental contributions and account for overlapping effects across initiatives. Track execution and realized contributions, assess gaps against targets, and support timely adjustments to strategies and action plans.


3. Budget Planning and Consolidation

Coordinate the collection, consolidation, and assessment of budget requests across business teams. Help stakeholders clarify spending purposes, investment timing, cost drivers, and expected outcomes, ensuring that budgets align with business targets and key initiatives. Use scenario modeling, return analysis, and budget execution reviews to identify resource gaps and allocation opportunities, supporting budget development, adjustments, and resource allocation decisions.


4. Metric Frameworks and Ongoing Performance Monitoring

Develop a deep understanding of the business model and the drivers of core metrics. Translate established top-level business metrics into measurable, trackable operational metrics with clear ownership for each business team, supported by consistent definitions and evaluation criteria. Establish regular performance monitoring and review processes to quantify business output, identify deviations against target trajectories and expected business patterns, and provide timely risk alerts.


5. Business Diagnostics and Decision Support

Conduct deep-dive analyses into target shortfalls, performance fluctuations, and resource efficiency to identify key drivers and emerging risks. Deliver actionable recommendations, partner with business teams on implementation, and evaluate results to inform subsequent decisions and planning.


6. Cross-functional Collaboration and Data Foundations

Work closely with overseas local teams, Product, Operations, Finance, and Engineering to align definitions across targets, budgets, and performance data. Improve data foundations and analytical tools to increase transparency and efficiency in business management across markets.


Requirements

1. Experience

5+ years of experience in data analytics, business performance analytics, business analysis, or strategic analysis within the internet industry. Experience in target management, budget planning, or resource efficiency analysis is preferred, as is experience supporting overseas business.


2. Business Acumen and Target Management

Strong business judgment and structured thinking, with the ability to translate business targets into key drivers, initiatives, and operational metrics. Able to work closely with diverse stakeholders to clarify plans, identify critical assumptions, and independently model targets and initiative contributions.


3. Budgeting and Return Analysis

Sound understanding of budget planning principles, with the ability to assess resource requirements, cost structures, and expected returns in the context of business plans. Able to conduct scenario and return analyses to support realistic budgeting and effective resource allocation.


4. Analytical and Technical Skills

Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets; familiarity with Hive/Spark is preferred. Ability to use Python/R or BI tools for analysis and visualization. A solid foundation in statistics, with the judgment to apply forecasting, attribution, experimentation, or causal inference methods as appropriate and clearly communicate assumptions and limitations.


5. Communication and Execution

Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate information gathering, align definitions, and drive planning across teams. Able to make evidence-based judgments amid incomplete information or differing perspectives, translate findings into clear recommendations, and follow through on implementation and review.


6. Language Skills

Professional working proficiency in both English and Chinese, including day-to-day communication, analytical presentations, and collaboration across international teams.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Scientist 2, Data Science
description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.



Job Description

Role Overview

The Data Science team within our Operations function builds analytics and machine learning solutions that develop advanced analytics tools and machine learning models to solve complex business problems using mathematics, statistics, and machine learning methods, and take ideas from concept through data preparation, model building, application development, and system integration. You will work hands-on across advanced analytics and machine learning model development, data preparation, and application development, using tools and environments including Python, GitHub, Linux, Docker, and machine learning algorithms.
