  • Develop advanced machine learning and deep learning models to support operational excellence, predict outcomes of interest, and identify patterns across enterprise datasets
  • Build and deploy end-to-end analytics applications, covering data preparation, model development, and system integration
  • Visualize analytical findings and model outputs using enterprise BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms to create intelligent dashboards that support operational decision-making.
  • Validate and monitor deployed models in production, tracking performance drift and retraining as needed to maintain accuracy and reliability.
  • Document model methodologies, data pipelines, and application architecture using version-controlled repositories to support reproducibility and team collaboration.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and present results to engineering and operations partners across functions.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate workflows, while critically evaluating outputs before use.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Data Science, AI, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, pipeline development, and model implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms spanning regression, classification, clustering, and deep learning methods.
  • Familiarity with software development tools and environments including version control, Linux-based systems, and containerization tools
  • Experience building data visualizations or dashboards using enterprise BI tools (e.g., Tableau or Power BI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying machine learning models to production environments using MLOps practices or containerized workflows.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure for data storage, model training, or deployment.
  • Exposure to generative AI or large language model (LLM) applications in an analytical or engineering context.
  • Knowledge of statistical modeling techniques including time series analysis, anomaly detection, or survival analysis
  • Experience with R for statistical analysis and modeling.

Skills

  • Ability to work across the full data science lifecycle, from messy raw data to a deployed, monitored model, without losing sight of the business problem being solved.
  • Strong statistical reasoning and the ability to choose the right modeling approach for the problem at hand, not just the most complex one.
  • Clear communicator who can translate model outputs and analytical findings into conclusions that engineering and operations partners can act on, reflecting a commitment to enabling customer and stakeholder success
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to contribute meaningfully within a team of engineers, data scientists, and business partners while driving progress on independent workstreams.
  • Disciplined approach to code quality, documentation, and reproducibility, treating version control and peer review as standard practice rather than optional steps.
  • Curiosity-driven problem solver who brings both rigor and creativity to analytical challenges, identifying improvement opportunities large and small.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer – Project Implementation & Network Transformation


Role Summary

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Network Engineering and Operations, this role is a key member of the Infrastructure Technology team, responsible for the design, implementation, and delivery of network infrastructure projects across the global enterprise.


The Senior Network Engineer will work closely with technology vendors, system integrators, managed service providers, and internal IT stakeholders to deliver network transformation, modernization, and infrastructure deployment initiatives. The role will lead technical implementation activities from project initiation through production deployment, ensuring solutions meet business, security, and operational requirements. In addition, the engineer will provide governance and transition support to operational teams following project completion.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead the implementation and deployment of network infrastructure projects, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, security, cloud connectivity, and data center networking initiatives.
  2. Participate in project planning, solution design reviews, technical workshops, and implementation activities to ensure successful project delivery.
  3. Develop and execute detailed migration, deployment, testing, rollback, and cutover plans for infrastructure changes.
  4. Configure, install, and integrate network technologies including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless solutions, VPNs, and SD-WAN platforms.
  5. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, cloud, application, and business teams to deliver scalable and secure network solutions.
  6. Work closely with system integrators and technology vendors to manage project implementation, validate deliverables, and ensure adherence to technical standards.
  7. Support network modernization initiatives including data center transformation, cloud connectivity, SASE adoption, SD-WAN deployments, and network security enhancements.
  8. Conduct proof-of-concepts (POCs), pilot deployments, solution testing, and performance validation activities.
  9. Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, implementation guides, operational handover documentation, and technical standards.
  10. Ensure deployed solutions meet security, compliance, availability, and performance requirements.
  11. Provide technical leadership during project cutovers, major changes, and production go-live activities.
  • Support root cause analysis and post-implementation reviews to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Facilitate knowledge transfer and transition of implemented solutions to operations and managed service teams.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation support for complex network issues related to newly implemented technologies and solutions.


Qualifications & Requirements

  1. Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  2. Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in network engineering with significant involvement in infrastructure implementation, deployment, and transformation projects.
  3. Proven experience delivering end-to-end network projects, including design validation, implementation, migration, testing, and production cutover activities.
  4. Possess basic Day 1 knowledge and stronger Day 2 operational experience in Fortinet SD-WAN and firewall support.
  5. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco technologies, including Nexus, Catalyst, routing and switching platforms, and Cisco or Meraki wireless solutions.
  6. Experience implementing and managing routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and related network services.
  7. Hands-on experience with SD-WAN deployment and migration projects.
  8. Experience implementing network security technologies including firewalls, VPNs, SASE, NAC, and secure remote access solutions.
  9. Good understanding of datacentre networking, internet connectivity, cloud networking, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  10. Experience working with system integrators, managed service providers, and telecommunications vendors during project delivery.
  11. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and implementation planning skills with the ability to manage technical risks during deployments.
  12. Familiarity with ITIL processes, particularly Change Management, Incident Management, and Service Transition.
  13. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.
  14. Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, Meraki, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or SD-WAN certifications will be highly regarded.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Emerging Business - TikTok BRIC
description:
Responsibilities
Business Risk Integrated Control (BRIC) is a global team protecting ByteDance users, platform health, and the authenticity of community and business ecosystems. We build the risk control algorithms, AI technologies, platforms, and infrastructure behind that work, across products including TikTok, CapCut, Lemon8, and Lark.

Our work spans account and content integrity, and safety across advertising and e-commerce. We apply machine learning across areas such as graph learning, anomaly detection, and multimodal models to understand users, content, behavior, and the relationships between them. The challenge is recognizing genuine activity accurately, so the people using our products never notice the systems working.

You will shape the trust, safety, and sustainable growth of ByteDance's global platforms, applying advanced AI to some of the hardest real-world problems in the field.

TikTok's Emerging Businesses encompass fast-growing products and innovative business models, including TikTok Drama, TikTok AI, and TikTok Open Platform, spanning content creation, AI capabilities, open ecosystems, and monetization opportunities. Operating in complex global regulatory and highly adversarial environments, the team focuses on critical risks such as AI feature and model capability abuse, advertising fraud and fake conversions, traffic and engagement manipulation, large-scale account farming, and account abuse.

Our mission is to build scalable and intelligent risk control systems across AI safety, advertising anti-fraud, traffic integrity, account security, and platform capability protection, safeguarding sustainable business growth, maintaining a trustworthy commercial ecosystem, and ensuring the secure and compliant use of platform resources.

Responsibilities
- End-to-end Risk System Development: Lead the design and development of risk control algorithms and systems across TikTok Drama, TikTok AI, TikTok Open Platform, and other emerging businesses, focusing on detecting and mitigating AI capability abuse, advertising fraud, fake conversions, traffic and engagement manipulation, account farming, account hijacking, and API abuse.
- Multimodal Risk Model Development & Optimization: Develop high-precision, low-latency, and reliable real-time risk detection and scoring models using large-scale multimodal data, including account attributes, device fingerprints, content signals, AI feature usage logs, advertising conversion funnels, user behavior sequences, and API invocation logs.
- Adversarial Defense & Risk Discovery: Analyze sophisticated abuse patterns, identify emerging threats through data analysis and risk mining, and develop robust adversarial strategies and hybrid rule-model defense systems to protect emerging businesses against evolving attacks.
- Cutting-edge Research & Implementation: As a technical owner, drive technology research, solution evaluation, architecture design, proof-of-concept (PoC) validation, and production implementation. Explore and apply advanced technologies, including Agentic AI, LLM post-training and fine-tuning, multimodal representation learning, behavioral sequence modeling, and graph learning, to enable automated risk discovery, investigation, reasoning, and decision-making.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Own the full lifecycle of algorithm development, from technical architecture and model evaluation to deployment and continuous optimization. Collaborate with engineering, product, advertising, growth, strategy, moderation, and data teams to drive technical innovation and establish scalable, reusable risk control capabilities across emerging business scenarios.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
- Algorithmic Foundation: Strong theoretical foundation in machine learning and deep learning, with proficiency in classification, ranking, sequence modeling, and anomaly detection techniques, including XGBoost, DeepFM, Transformers, and Graph Neural Networks.
- Engineering Skills: Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, C++, or Go, with hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Core Competencies: Strong analytical thinking, data intuition, and a passion for adversarial risk control and complex problem-solving. Demonstrated ability to design technical solutions, validate proofs of concept (PoCs), drive technical initiatives, and collaborate effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field is preferred, particularly with research experience in machine learning, deep learning, or AI-related domains.
- Agentic AI Experience: Experience building LLM agents, integrating tools, planning complex tasks, and deploying automated risk investigation and decision-making solutions.
- Multimodal & Behavioral Modeling: Experience in content understanding, behavioral sequence modeling, device fingerprinting, account anomaly detection, advertising fraud detection, or traffic manipulation detection.
- Industry Experience: Proven experience developing machine learning algorithms for AI safety, advertising anti-fraud, traffic integrity, account risk control, Open Platform API risk control, or internet ecosystem integrity, with experience developing large-scale distributed risk control systems, offline training pipelines, and online inference systems.
- End-to-end experience in risk technology research, proof-of-concept (PoC) validation, and scaling solutions from initial pilots to large-scale production environments.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer - Cognitive Maintenance
description:
This role is posted on behalf of Groundup.ai, a startup supported by SGInnovate.


Background

As an innovative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer - Cognitive Maintenance, you will work on combining advanced data science and artificial intelligence know-how with industrial operation systems. Your main goal is to develop algorithms and intelligent models to forecast equipment failures before they occur, optimize asset reliability, prescribe corrective actions, and ultimately reduce unplanned downtime. You’ll face complex challenges involving large-scale time-series data, IOT sensor data processing, and machine learning applications; all these are your tools to ensure our cognitive maintenance solutions remain the gold standard reference for the global industrial AI industry. The ideal candidate is passionate and has a professional track record of combining artificial intelligence with physical data (vibration, temperature, sound, pressure, etc.), thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is eager to make an impact on the industrial world.


Qualifications:

- Proven experience and expertise in machine learning, time-series analysis, and anomaly/failure detection.


Technical Skills:

- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Java.

- Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for AI deployment.

- Strong understanding of signal processing concepts and hands-on experience with industrial sensor data (e.g., vibration, current, temperature, pressure).

- Ability to read, interpret, and apply insights from academic literature and state-of-the-art research in condition monitoring and fault diagnosis.

- Experience designing experiments to validate hypotheses and benchmark models.


Soft Skills:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Effective communication and collaboration abilities to work across teams.

- A curious mindset and a drive to innovate and experiment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle noisy, high-dimensional data.


Preferred: - Prior experience working in industrial or manufacturing environments.

- Familiarity with both academic research and real-world applications in condition monitoring, fault diagnosis, and prognostics (e.g., vibration-based methods, model-based vs. data-driven approaches).

- Experience translating academic methods into robust, production-ready algorithms.


What We Offer: 18-month hyper-growth trajectory for your career. We eliminate corporate bureaucracy and tenure-based politics—your velocity is determined purely by your impact. High performers can fast-track into clear leadership tracks within 18 months:


  • The Technical Track (Senior AI Engineer / Tech Lead): Command deeper architectural ownership, pioneer core AI strategies, and drive high-stakes technical decisions, or the
  • Leadership Track (AI Engineering Lead / Team Lead): Scale your impact through people management, project orchestration, and elite team-building.


  • We provide the launchpad; your ambition defines the altitude. If you are looking for an artificial ceiling on what you can achieve, you won't find one here.
  • Zero bureaucracy, direct executive alignment. Bypass middle management and work face-to-face with the founders, CTO, and AI leaders to architect solutions and steer the company’s technological future.

title: Data Architect
description:
About Signant Health
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health, you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
About the Role
The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture and strategy that brings data from Signant Health's diverse operational systems into Snowflake, our primary enterprise data platform. As an individual contributor reporting to the Head of AI, this role combines strategic architectural thinking with hands-on data engineering — building the frameworks and reference pipelines that engineering teams adopt and scale. This is an opportunity to break down data silos, reduce redundant integrations, and enable data-driven decision making and AI across the organization.
Key Accountabilities
Data Architecture & Strategy

Define and maintain the target-state enterprise data architecture and multi-year roadmap, with Snowflake as the central data platform.
Document the current-state data landscape across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, and enterprise SaaS applications; perform gap analysis and develop a prioritized onboarding roadmap.
Establish architectural principles, reference architectures, and standard patterns for data ingestion, storage, transformation, and consumption; evaluate and recommend tooling via build-vs.-buy analysis.

Data Integration & Engineering

Design and build ingestion patterns — CDC, batch, streaming, and API-based — using AWS-native and Snowflake-native services (AWS DMS, Glue, Kinesis/MSK, Snowpipe, dbt) and establish engineering standards for pipelines, CI/CD, observability, and error handling.
Develop source-to-target reconciliation and validation frameworks consistent with ALCOA+ data integrity principles; optimize Snowflake performance and cost as data volumes grow.

Data Modeling & Master Data

Design enterprise and canonical data models and a layered Snowflake architecture (raw, conformed, and curated/medallion layers), including conformed business entities shared across products.
Establish master and reference data management approaches; guide selection of dimensional, Data Vault, or other modeling techniques appropriate to each use case.

Data Governance, Quality & Compliance

Define the enterprise data governance framework including ownership, stewardship, data contracts, quality monitoring, metadata management, and end-to-end data lineage.
Design data protection controls (classification, RBAC, masking, tokenization of PII/PHI) and ensure the architecture supports GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 requirements.

Analytics, AI & Technical Leadership

title: Founding AI Engineer – Industrial Vision Language Models
description:
Celotti Tech Talent is an Australian technology recruitment firm specializing in AI, Data, Deep Tech and Robotics, with a presence across Australia and Singapore.


About Our Client

Our client is building AI systems that connect engineering design with manufacturing execution and business decisions.

At the core of their products is an industrial vision-language model that reads engineering drawings the way an experienced manufacturing engineer does understanding annotations, GD&T, materials, notes, and manufacturing features, and reasoning across views and between 2D and 3D.

Our client's mission is to turn fragmented industrial information into actionable intelligence and deliver measurable improvements in engineering productivity, manufacturing quality, and operational efficiency.


Position Overview

Hiring Founding AI Engineers to build and own industrial vision-language models (VLMs).

You will work directly with our founders, Chief Scientist, and manufacturing domain experts to turn open multimodal models into a model that reliably understands engineering drawings and CAD and to prove it with rigorous benchmarks on real customer data.


This is a hands-on model-development role spanning data, training, evaluation, and serving. You will own the model end to end, not the application layer around it.

You will have access to a large GPU cluster with no budget cap on compute model quality, not hardware, is the constraint.


What You’ll Build

Drawing & CAD Understanding Model

  • Adapt and train VLMs to read 2D engineering drawings: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T frames, surface finish, title blocks, bills of materials, notes, and section and detail views.
  • Extend the model to multi-view and 2D–3D reasoning: linking drawing views to 3D CAD/STEP geometry and recognizing manufacturing features such as holes, threads, pockets, fillets, and chamfers.
  • Train the model to call tools - OCR, symbol detectors, geometry and CAD kernels where they are more reliable than pixels alone.


Industrial Data Engine

  • Build pipelines to collect, clean, and de-identify industrial drawings and CAD models, and to generate synthetic drawings from CAD at scale.
  • Design annotation schemas and semi-automated labeling tools with engineer-in-the-loop review.
  • Turn engineer corrections from production use into new training and evaluation data.


Training & post-training

  • Run continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and preference or RL-based post-training (e.g., DPO, GRPO) for high-resolution, text-dense technical images.
  • Make deliberate choices on vision encoders, image resolution and tiling, and parameter-efficient versus full fine-tuning.
  • Run large-scale, multi-node training efficiently and keep experiments reproducible and well documented.


Evaluation & Deployment

  • Build benchmarks for field-level extraction accuracy, GD&T and tolerance interpretation, feature recognition, and cross-view consistency, with error analysis by drawing type and failure mode.
  • Calibrate model confidence so uncertain outputs are flagged for engineer review instead of guessed.
  • Serve models efficiently (e.g., vLLM, quantization) and track performance on real customer drawings.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the industrial VLM end to end from data and training recipes to benchmarks, deployment, and iteration.
  • Shape the multimodal model roadmap with the Chief Scientist, balancing model quality, research bets, and customer timelines.
  • Decide when to train, when to fine-tune, and when to combine the model with OCR, geometry processing, or rules.
  • Report results with clear metrics and honest failure analysis.
  • Work with manufacturing engineers and customers to define what “correct” means on real drawings.
  • Publish or open-source selected work where it strengthens our technical position.


Qualifications

Required

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning vision-language or multimodal models not only prompting or retrieval with results you can show.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including multi-GPU or distributed training (e.g., DeepSpeed, FSDP) and the Hugging Face ecosystem.
  • Experience building multimodal training and evaluation datasets and improving models through systematic error analysis.
  • A builder’s mindset: strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and drive to make models work on real industrial data.


Preferred

  • Document AI, OCR, or understanding of text-dense images such as tables, forms, or technical drawings.
  • Experience with engineering drawings, GD&T, STEP/B-Rep, CAD APIs, or 3D geometry learning.
  • Post-training with preference optimization or reinforcement learning; synthetic data generation.
  • Large-scale, multi-node training and inference optimization (e.g., vLLM, quantization, high-resolution or long-context serving).
  • Publications at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or ACM MM, or significant open-source contributions.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes, DFM, or industrial standards.


Why Join?

  • Build the company’s core model as a member of the founding engineering team.
  • Train on real industrial drawings and CAD from manufacturing customers data most AI teams never see.
  • Train at scale on a large GPU cluster, with no budget cap on compute.
  • Work directly with the Chief Scientist and manufacturing domain experts on technically challenging problems.
  • Receive competitive salary, meaningful equity, and significant opportunities for professional growth.
  • Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship support for eligible candidates.

Position: Senior/Lead Software Engineer (C++ stack) for Semiconductor Equipment Control – FAB Feature Integration (MFC/Qt)


As a Senior/Lead Software Engineer for semiconductor equipment control software, you will be involved in the full software engineering lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, analysis, and maintenance, with a growth path towards technical leadership. This role is focused on FAB feature integration and delivery, primarily using C++, and building/integrating desktop and engineering tooling using MFC/Qt.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with architects and tech leads to define design decisions and interfaces within your domain (e.g., module boundaries, integration interfaces, dependencies).
  • Perform requirement analysis and deliver feature integration in FAB environments.
  • Implement and test software features; support integration, regression, debugging, and maintenance.
  • Conduct peer reviews and follow quality practices to ensure maintainability and delivery readiness.
  • Work as part of a Scrum/Agile team, delivering user stories across the stack and collaborating with cross-functional members.


The Job Scope

In practice, you will mainly work on:

  • Desktop and engineering tooling and UI integration using MFC/Qt.
  • Aligning with the broader equipment control software context (e.g., host interfaces such as SECS/GEM and EDA, simulation/testing environments, and a layered architecture).

Technically, this role focuses on developing testable, maintainable, high-quality semiconductor equipment control software features, primarily in C++, and delivering feature integration in FAB environments. In practice, you will mainly work on desktop and engineering tooling and UI integration using MFC/Qt, while aligning with the broader equipment control software context (e.g., host interfaces such as SECS/GEM and EDA, simulation/testing environments, and a layered architecture).

Specifically, the job scope covers the following layers and integration points:

  • Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL): enable programmable access to equipment components.
  • Devices / Domain layers: model module behavior and state machines; integrate across module boundaries.
  • Application layer: support higher-level functions such as recipe management and calibration.
  • UI / HMI layer: implement and integrate on-site engineering tools and desktop UI using MFC/Qt.
  • Simulation & Testing: leverage system/unit testing and simulators to validate integration and regressions.
  • Host Interfaces: collaborate around SECS/GEM, GEM300, and EDA / Interface A as needed to ensure FAB usability.


Job requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Master's or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automation, or a related field.
  • Experience in equipment control or industrial software development is a plus.
  • Strong C++ object-oriented programming skills; familiarity with the C++ standard library (STL).
  • Desktop UI and engineering tooling experience using MFC and/or Qt.
  • Familiar with git workflows and continuous integration (CI) tools.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or Kanban teams.
  • Proficient with multi-threaded and asynchronous programming.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and orchestration tools (Kubernetes).
  • Proficient understanding of GIT for versioning.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and optimization skills.
  • Affinity with hardware and physical systems is a strong plus.
  • Good command of spoken & written English.


DESIRABLE SKILLSET

  • Understanding of factory software context (e.g., Host/EAP, SECS/GEM, EDA) and related integration scenarios.
  • Strong system integration and on-site debugging capability in FAB integration contexts.
  • Experience with unit testing and TDD/BDD practices (e.g., xUnit, Boost.Test, reqnroll).

  • Experience supporting major incidents and performing root cause analysis (RCA) and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience working with Singapore Government agencies or Statutory Boards is highly desirable.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring to L1/L2 engineers and coordinate with infrastructure, security, cloud, application, and vendor teams.


Technical Expertise:

Candidates should have strong hands-on knowledge in:

Enterprise & Data Centre Networking

  • Campus LAN/WAN

  • Core, Distribution and Access Switching

  • ExpressRoute

Routing & Switching

  • VXLAN
  • QoS

Troubleshooting Capability:

The candidate should be capable of independently troubleshooting complex issues involving routing convergence, asymmetric routing, BGP/OSPF adjacency, VLAN/trunking, packet drops, MTU/MSS, latency, DNS resolution, NAT, VPN tunnels, hybrid-cloud routing, load balancers, firewall paths, and application connectivity.

For an L3 Engineer, I would specifically avoid making “network architecture governance” and “technical consultancy” the primary responsibility. title: Application Support Engineer

Opportunity

As an Application Support Engineer at S64, you'll ensure the smooth operation of S64 client-facing platforms by offering technical and functional assistance to both external and internal clients. Qualifications

  • You value in-person collaboration and understand the benefits of face-to-face interactions for fostering stronger connections and improving outcomes.

Why S64?

S64 offers a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of private markets, technology, and institutional distribution at a time of structural change.


You will be part of a firm that operates behind the scenes of some of the most sophisticated investment platforms globally, helping bring private markets to scale without compromising on quality or control. Roles at S64 offer early responsibility, global exposure and the chance to develop deep expertise in a complex and evolving market.


We are building long‑term infrastructure, not short‑term products. If you want your work to matter, and to be trusted with real responsibility, S64 offers that opportunity. In return, we offer competitive compensation, global opportunity, and the ability to grow alongside a firm shaping how private markets are delivered.


S64 evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

title: Director, Local Government Relations
company: The Chamber of Commerce for Greater Philadelphia
description:
The Greater Philadelphia Chamber (The Chamber) brings area businesses and civic leaders together to amplify the impact of business in the region, advocate for a competitive business climate and grow a vibrant and diverse business community in order to achieve our vision: The Greater Philadelphia Region is a top global destination for business and a leader in inclusive growth.

About This Role


The Chamber is seeking an experienced government affairs professional to lead its day-to-day engagement with Philadelphia city government and provide the local political, legislative, and regulatory expertise needed to advance the Chamber's policy priorities. This individual will build and maintain trusted relationships with City officials, provide timely political and policy intelligence, and help develop and execute strategies that integrate government relations, and member input. The position reports to the Vice President, Government Relations and operates within the Chamber’s External Affairs and Government Relations Business Unit.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Monitor City Council legislative activity, municipal budget and regulatory developments, and the local political environment, providing strategic guidance on the Chamber's positioning, timing, risks, and opportunities.
  • Represent the Chamber at City Council meetings, hearings, government meetings, and other public forums, including drafting and delivering formal testimony as needed to advance organizational goals.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the Mayor’s Office and Administration, City Council leadership, members and key staff, City Row Offices, and other influential local government and political stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute local government relations strategies that identify the desired outcome, key decision-makers, political dynamics, potential champions and opposition, and the path to advancing, modifying, or stopping proposals.
  • Convene roundtable discussions and stakeholder sessions to gather member perspectives, understand business impacts, and bridge conversations between government officials and the business community.
  • Provide timely political and policy intelligence to the Chamber’s Board, senior leadership, members, and government affairs colleagues, including emerging opportunities, risks, and stakeholder dynamics that could affect Chamber priorities.
  • Staff the Chamber's Public Policy Committee, the State and Local Tax Advisory Board, and other relevant groups so members stay informed, involved, and aligned around policy objectives.
  • Partner with Advocacy and External Affairs to determine when member voices, community stakeholders, coalitions, public engagement, and communications can strengthen the government relations strategy and advance the desired outcome.
  • Coordinate local government strategy with the Chamber’s broader city, county, state, and federal government relations work, particularly where policy priorities or political dynamics cross jurisdictions.
  • Exercise sound judgment on timing, tactics, and messengers, including when an issue is best advanced through direct government engagement, broader stakeholder involvement, or public advocacy; support departmental and organizational revenue goals.

Job Specifications & Requirements

Required

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain productive, trusted relationships with elected and appointed officials, legislative staff, and other government and political stakeholders, and to use those relationships to advance policy objectives.
  • Professional experience in government, government relations, public affairs, or external affairs, including independently leading engagement on legislative, budget, or regulatory issues.
  • Strong understanding of local or state legislative, budget, regulatory, and political processes, including how and when decisions are made and the stakeholders who influence them.
  • Demonstrated political judgment, discretion, and ability to manage complex relationships and competing stakeholder interests.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex policy into clear business impacts and actionable strategy.
  • Experience developing and executing government relations strategies that advanced, modified, or stopped a proposal, including direct policymaker engagement, coalition or stakeholder coordination, and adapting tactics as conditions change.
  • Experience drafting and delivering testimony, public comments, policy materials, or other communications for government audiences.
  • Experience facilitating committees, roundtables, or stakeholder groups, including preparing agendas and materials and building alignment among participants with differing perspectives.
  • Ability to support departmental and organizational revenue goals by engaging members, sponsors, and investors through policy programming and events.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Ability to travel regularly within the Greater Philadelphia area, including frequent visits to City Hall, government offices, stakeholder meetings, community engagements, and events outside regular business hours.

Preferred

  • Direct experience in Philadelphia city government or in government relations focused on Philadelphia city government.
  • In-depth knowledge of Philadelphia’s legislative, budget, regulatory, and political processes and the stakeholders who influence them.
  • Familiarity with state and local tax policy or other business-climate issues.
  • Master's degree in Public Administration, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related field.


Working at the Chamber

Working at the Chamber offers the resources and stability of a mid-sized business with the purpose-driven mission of a nonprofit. Our team of about 65 is large enough to offer strong support, yet small enough to give you room to lead, grow, and make your mark—with access to a wide regional network, professional development, competitive compensation, and an outstanding benefits package.

The Chamber operates in a hybrid environment, with employees working in person at least two days per week; exceptions may be made based on departmental needs. This role requires attending Chamber-hosted or partner events outside regular business hours and outside Center City Philadelphia.

Compensation

The hiring range for this position is $90,000–$100,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus the opportunity to earn an additional performance-based bonus.

Application Instructions

Qualified candidates should submit a cover letter and resume. Applications that fail to fulfill this requirement will not be considered.

The Greater Philadelphia Chamber is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to building a culturally diverse staff. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Accessories Designer (Bags & Soft Goods)
description:
We’re looking for a Product Designer (Bags, Accessories and Soft Goods) to join The Paper Bunny team.


This is a physical product design role focused on bags, accessories, and soft goods - from concept and materials to sampling and production. It is not a digital, UI, or UX design role.


At The Paper Bunny, we design thoughtfully considered fashion and lifestyle pieces that balance form, function, and intention - products made to support and elevate everyday life. In this role, you’ll work closely with our Creative Director and team to design and bring to life pieces that are practical, beautiful, and deeply considered.


This role is best suited for a mid-level to senior designer who has hands-on experience with materials, construction, and manufacturing, and who enjoys seeing ideas through from sketch to finished product, and has a keen interest in fashion, lifestyle and social media trends.


Key Responsibilities

  • Research market, material, and design trends relevant to bags, accessories, and soft goods
  • Design bags, accessories, and soft goods across both seasonal and core collections
  • Develop product concepts from ideation through to execution, sampling, and production
  • Produce clear, detailed technical drawings, measurements, and production-ready specifications
  • Research, source, and propose materials, trims, colours, and finishes aligned with the brand’s aesthetic and functional standards
  • Work closely with suppliers and factories to manage sampling, revisions, and production feasibility
  • Collaborate with the product team on quality checks to ensure all final products meet design intent, specifications, and quality standards
  • Support the development of product packaging, labels, and all elements required for products to be market-ready
  • Ensure all designs meet functional, aesthetic, and quality benchmarks while remaining aligned with customer needs and brand ethos


Requirements

  • Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Background/education in fashion design, product industrial design, or product development (physical goods)
  • Relevant experience or background in accessories, bags, or soft goods design
  • A keen interest in fashion and lifestyle trends
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction, and sampling processes
  • Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable balancing creativity with execution
  • A collaborative team player who communicates clearly and thoughtfully


To Apply, please email the following to hello@thepaperbunny.com:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio showcasing your creative work and relevant experience
  • A short 100–200 word write-up on why you feel you are the right fit for this role
  • Work location: Singapore (Alexandra area), hybrid arrangement


Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: End User Computing Engineer
description:
The End User Computing Engineer provides technical support and administration across end‑user computing (EUC), Microsoft 365 services, and on‑premises Active Directory environments. He/she is responsible for day‑to‑day operations, incident resolution, system administration, and user access management.


The role ensures service levels are met by maintaining endpoint reliability, managing identity and access, supporting collaboration platforms, and troubleshooting infrastructure issues. The End User Computing Engineer collaborates with IT teams to implement changes, supports business users with technology needs, and contributes to medium‑term operational improvements.


He/she possesses hands‑on expertise in EUC platforms, Microsoft 365 administration (including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint), and Active Directory services, with a strong focus on security, compliance, and operational excellence.


Job Responsibilities: -

Support EUC operations

  • Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices and peripherals.
  • Monitor endpoint health, patch compliance and performance
  • Troubleshoot hardware and software incidents.
  • Administer EUC management platforms to deliver remote support, automate patching and enforce endpoint security policies.


Administering Microsoft 365 and Entra

  • Manage Exchange Online mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and related collaboration services.
  • Configure and enforce policies for collaboration, security and compliance across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
  • Administer MS Entra ID including user lifecycle management, conditional access, MFA, role assignments and application integrations.
  • Implement and monitor identity governance, security baselines and compliance controls.


Maintain Active Directory, DNS and Scripting

  • Administer user accounts, groups, organizational units and group policies.
  • Implement and enforce access controls.
  • Support backup restoration and automation scripting
  • Monitor and manage replication health, domain controllers and DNS integration
  • Working knowledge in DNS domains and troubleshooting name resolution issues.


Compliance, Governing and Policing

  • Respond to IT service requests and escalations.
  • Assist in change management and deployment of updates.
  • Perform server and endpoint patching management
  • Maintain documentation of SOPs and knowledge base articles.


IT Asset Management

  • Maintain accurate IT asset inventory (software and hardware)
  • Plan and perform asset refresh where applicable


White Glove support

  • Personalized support for the company VVIP devices and accounts


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in end user computing, helpdesk / ITSM scope.
  • Technical Skills: Sound, practical experience managing Microsoft centric environment support; such as Windows troubleshooting, AD, printer setup, mailbox management, etc.
  • Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for system task automation is desirable.
  • Highly desired traits/experience for the applications:
  • White glove support for VVIP.
  • Pleasant partner with end users
  • Independent contributor in the lean support environment

title: Linux System Engineer
description:
Linux Platform Operations Engineer

Singapore | Permanent | Financial Markets Technology


EC1 Partners is working with a leading global financial markets technology business that is building out its Singapore infrastructure team. This is an opportunity for a Linux Platform Operations Engineer to join a highly technical environment supporting critical trading platforms, low-latency infrastructure, and globally distributed production systems.


The role would suit a hands-on Linux engineer with strong experience across production infrastructure, on-premise systems, hardware support, automation, and operational troubleshooting. Financial markets experience would be helpful, but the priority is strong Linux depth, reliability, ownership, and the ability to support business-critical environments.


The Role


You will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving Linux infrastructure across production, disaster recovery, and test environments. The current environment is heavily weighted towards on-premise infrastructure, with gradual cloud adoption expected over time.

This is a hands-on engineering role covering Linux systems administration, hardware support, configuration management, automation, incident response, performance troubleshooting, and operational reliability. You will work closely with infrastructure, engineering, SRE, security, and operations teams across multiple regions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain Linux server infrastructure across global production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex Linux issues across operating systems, hardware, storage, networking, performance, and application support layers.
  • Support bare-metal infrastructure, OS lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, and system configuration.
  • Work with internal automation tooling and contribute to improvements using Python, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term remediation.
  • Support monitoring, observability, reporting, and operational health checks across critical infrastructure.
  • Work with engineering teams on capacity planning, performance tuning, infrastructure projects, and production change activity.
  • Operate in a highly trusted environment with access to critical low-latency trading systems.


Experience Required

  • Strong hands-on experience in Linux systems administration within a production environment.
  • Excellent Linux command-line skills and strong troubleshooting capability.
  • Experience supporting on-premise, bare-metal, or hardware-based infrastructure.
  • Good scripting ability, ideally with Python and/or Shell.
  • Experience with configuration management, patching, monitoring, and operational tooling.
  • Storage experience across SAN, NAS, multipath, RAID, NVMe, or capacity planning would be beneficial.
  • Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Salt, RPMs, Terraform, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP would be advantageous.
  • Financial markets, trading, exchange, or other low-latency infrastructure experience would be useful but is not essential.
  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work calmly in a critical production environment.


This role offers the opportunity to join a growing Singapore infrastructure team supporting highly critical financial markets technology. You will work in a deeply technical, hands-on environment with exposure to Linux infrastructure, automation, production reliability, low-latency systems, and global engineering teams, with long-term career development as the business continues to invest in its Singapore capability.


Please contact Andrew Scotts at EC1 Partners for a confidential discussion.

title: Corrections Specialist 4 - Domestic Violence Treatment
description:
Description

Corrections Specialist 4 (CS4)
Reentry - Domestic Violence Treatment Program
Spokane, WA and Wenatchee, WA
Salary Range: $7,066 - $9,506 per month

The employer anticipates making an offer at Step L depending on candidate qualifications and internal equity


The Department of Corrections is hiring for two Corrections Specialist 4 (CS4) positions to support the Domestic Violence Treatment Program. These positions are located in Spokane, WA and Wenatchee, WA. Applicants will indicate their preferred location(s) when applying.

The mission of the Department of Corrections is to improve public safety by positively changing lives. The Reentry Division’s Domestic Violence Treatment Program (DVTP) is responsible for the delivery and implementation of evidence-based assessment and treatment practices and the operational support to facilitate the participation of individuals in treatment designed to decrease recidivism, which increases the safety of staff, clients, and the public. The incumbent in this position is responsible for providing competent evidence-based clinical services to those clients assigned to their caseload who are currently incarcerated or have recently released from incarceration. The provision of domestic/intimate partner violence specific assessment and treatment has been demonstrated to reduce clients’ risk of re-offense upon release to the community.

This Corrections Specialist 4 is considered an expert level position with statewide responsibilities within the Domestic Violence Treatment Program. This position will be considered as an expert resource in Domestic Violence assessment and treatment for the Reentry Division and other correctional divisions statewide. The incumbent will conduct risk assessments to determine treatment targets, facilitate group and individual therapy to address treatment needs, prepare all program required documentation, and provide expert level guidance and contributions to policy development, implementation, and improvements. In addition, the incumbent will work collaboratively with our internal and external criminal justice partners to ensure clients are held accountable and remain safe in the community.


A completed application packet will include:

  • A cover letter regarding your interest in this position with our agency
  • A detailed resume
  • Three professional references
  • Transcripts, if applicable
Please note: Incomplete application packages may disqualify an application from the selection process. The information provided in your application must support your selected answers in the Supplemental Questions section of this application.

This position is represented by the Washington Federation of State Employees (WFSE)

Duties

Corrections Specialist 4, duties include:


Provide group and individual evidence-based domestic violence treatment to adult men and women in both field and Reentry Center settings. Facilitate behavioral change in clients. Complete all required documentation in a timely manner.

  • Conduct group and individual therapy following the approved curriculum and program guidelines. Complete documentation to include initial treatment plans, group and individual progress notes, and a comprehensive treatment summary for external distribution. Additionally, some clients may require treatment summary addendums and/or additional documentation.
  • Contribute to the development, implementation, review, and improvements to DVT policies and statewide and local unit processes on an ongoing basis.
  • Contribute to the development of internal statewide quality assurance and continuous quality improvement standards and processes and provide those services as part of the unit’s internal QA/CQI process.
  • As an expert in the DVT field, provide insight and involvement in ongoing implementation and curriculum improvements as well as resolving complex, critical, and precedent setting issues using their field expertise and knowledge, experience, and understanding of the field’s most up to date and relevant research findings.

Assess client treatment needs and risk using DSHS-approved risk and behavioral assessments.

  • Conduct individual assessment interviews.
  • Review file material and collateral information.
  • Compete risk and behavioral assessments to determine level of service.
  • Document assessments and recommendations in both case files and the electronic file.

Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to address risk and assist in developing protective factors for clients.

  • Regularly attend and participate in local domestic violence task force, intervention committee, or work group in service area.
  • Work directly with guardian and victim advocates concerning the management of those with domestic violence related offenses.
  • Present client information to committees related to client planning.
  • Confer with case managers to assist in case planning and management.

Participate in required team meetings, unit meetings, and trainings. Meet with supervisor for clinical and administrative supervision.

  • Participate in regular meetings with supervisor.
  • Be available and participate in team, unit, division, and department meetings and trainings.
  • Complete continuing education credits to maintain DSHS certification.
  • Complete Annual In-service trainings as required.
  • Complete continuing education credits to maintain DSHS certification.
*Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Apply, obtain/maintain Washington State Agency Affiliated Counselor registration per RCW 18.19.030 within 30 days of hire.

**An agency affiliated counselor may only provide counseling services as part of his or her employment for a recognized agency. Applicants for an agency affiliated counselor credential who apply within 30 days of employment may provide services within the agency for up to 90 days while the Department of Health processes your application.

AND

A Bachelor’s Degree in a behavioral science, such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or closely related field from an accredited college or university whose accreditation is recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or foreign equivalent.

**NOTE:

(a) In accordance with WAC 388-60B-0210, DSHS may grant an exception or waiver from education compliance with this requirement if the exception would not violate an existing local, state, federal, or tribal law;

(b) In order to qualify for an exception, the employee must possess year-for-year professional level experience equivalent to a related bachelor's degree in counseling, psychology, social work, or similar social service field and the department determines this equivalency at the discretion of the DSHS program manager responsible for monitoring domestic violence intervention treatment programs

AND

Two (2) years of demonstrated experience providing individual or group domestic violence intervention treatment, mental health treatment, chemical dependency treatment, or sex offense treatment. Demonstrated experience must include six (6) months of work experience providing treatment and/or therapy specifically to groups.


NOTE: A Master's degree in a behavioral science, such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or closely related field from an accredited college or university whose accreditation is recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or foreign equivalent, may be substituted for one (1) year of demonstrated experience providing individual or group domestic violence intervention treatment, mental health treatment, chemical dependency treatment, or sex offense treatment.

Additional clarification: Work experience in treatment and/or therapy to "groups" is defined as, "group experience where responsibilities have included treatment and/or therapy planning, treatment program implementation and/or direct delivery of client treatment services. This work experience may also be obtained during master's degree program internships."

title: Senior Director, Protein Sciences & Biopharma Discovery
description: The Senior Director, Protein Sciences Biopharma Discovery leads biotherapeutics discovery and preclinical sciences at the Ceva Biopharma Campus (CBC) in Philadelphia. Reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer, this leader sets the scientific direction for a multidisciplinary team of approximately 12 scientists spanning protein and antibody engineering, AAV vector development, preclinical sciences, and assay development, and is accountable for advancing Ceva’s pipeline from early discovery through proof of concept (PoC) studies. The role calls for a rare combination of deep scientific expertise, strategic vision, and hands-on leadership, and for someone who is equally effective at the whiteboard, at the bench, and in the boardroom. As the CBC’s senior scientific voice, the Senior Director is the primary link between Philadelphia and Ceva’s global R D organization, particularly the Pharma Biopharma Discovery teams in Libourne, France, and partners closely with veterinary science, regulatory affairs, CMC/industrial development, and business development to turn scientific opportunity into portfolio value. Direct reports: Head of Protein Sciences; Head of AAV Sciences; Head of Preclinical Sciences; Principal Scientist, Assay Development. Responsibilities and Key Duties • Scientific strategy and roadmap. Define and execute the CBC biotherapeutics discovery roadmap in line with Ceva’s Pharma/Biopharma R D strategy. Contribute to portfolio prioritization with the CSO and R D leadership, and identify and integrate new assests relevant to veterinary biologics. • Protein and antibody discovery, more particularly in protein engineering. Direct rational design and directed evolution strategies that improve protein function and achieve species specificity across canine, feline, equine, and production animal targets, including species adaptation, multispecific formats, and half-life extension approaches. • Platform and program oversight. Provide expert scientific oversight across the different biopharma technologies, preclinical, and assay platforms so that studies are well designed, scientifically robust, and delivered on time and within budget. Oversee CHO and alternative expression system work to produce material of appropriate quality to support proof-of-principle and PoC studies in species. • PoC delivery and stage-gate readiness. Lead certain programs through PoC and bring clear data packages and recommendations to Ceva’s innovation governance bodies. Ensure materials, process platforms, and documentation are fit for purpose and ready for tech transfer into development beyond the development D0 stage-gate. • Team leadership and development. Lead, coach, and develop up to four direct reports and a team of approximately 12 scientists. Own performance management, development planning, and succession, and recruit and retain top scientific talent in line with site growth plans, building a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and collaboration. • Global and cross-functional collaboration. Serve as the primary scientific liaison between the CBC and Libourne R D for joint project management and knowledge transfer. Partner with veterinary science, regulatory affairs, CMC/GID, and business development, and represent the CBC in global R D governance meetings and portfolio reviews as required. • External opportunity evaluation. Lead the scientific evaluation of external biotherapeutic assets and technologies, including data room analysis and due diligence, and provide clear, well-reasoned recommendations to the CSO and business development. • Intellectual property and knowledge management. Drive IP generation and protection in partnership with IP and Legal, maintain a scientific and patent watch across relevant technologies, and ensure knowledge is captured and shared across Ceva’s global R D network. • Regulatory and quality alignment. Ensure discovery and preclinical work is designed with downstream regulatory requirements in mind (e.g., USDA CVB, FDA CVM, EMA CVMP, VICH), apply GLP-compliant practices to PoC study materials where applicable, and contribute scientific expertise to regulatory strategy in partnership with Regulatory Affairs. • Operational excellence. Manage the CBC biologics discovery budget, resource allocation. Oversee laboratory operations and equipment lifecycle management, and establish and monitor KPIs for scientific productivity, quality, and timelines across all programs. Core Competencies • Shape solutions out of complexity – Challenges the status quo and translates scientific trends and competing priorities into clear, actionable discovery strategies; makes sound decisions in a fast-moving, sometimes resource-constrained environment. • Entrepreneurial mindset innovation — Turning scientific opportunities into innovative biopharma solution • Client focus – Keeps the needs of veterinarians, animal owners, and internal partners at the center of target selection and candidate design, and instills that focus across the team. • Collaborate with empathy – Drives collective effectiveness across the US/France matrix, role-modeling collaboration across geographies, functions, and organizational cultures. • Engage and develop – Builds a mid- to long-term talent strategy for the CBC and creates the conditions for scientists to grow alongside a changing portfolio. • Drive ambition and accountability – Pushes self and others toward challenging goals, sets high standards, brings a bias for delivery, and makes difficult people decisions when needed. • Influence others – Builds buy-in with global R D leadership and governance bodies, aligning stakeholders transparently around short- and long-term Ceva goals. Technical / Functional Competencies • Scientific skills (Expert) – recognized reference in biotherapeutics discovery, including protein and antibody engineering, species adaptation, half-life extension, recombinant expression systems. Analytical skills (Bio) (Expert) – able to direct bioanalytical and assay strategy, introduce new technologies, and resolve complex troubleshooting situations. • Drug discovery, preclinical and clinical development (Advanced) – builds preclinical plans and leads their implementation; critically assesses discovery and development dossiers from partners. • Networking, influencing, negotiating and scouting (Advanced) – identifies external concepts and partners, coordinates advisory input, and organizes scientific assessments. • Project management (Expert) – delivers large, strategic programs within time, budget, and quality constraints across a multidisciplinary team. • Communication and presentation (Advanced) – presents with impact to KOLs, and senior leadership; excellent command of spoken and written English. • Scientific writing (Advanced) – authors white papers, study protocols, reports, and publications, and critically reviews the work of others. • Regulatory and quality knowledge (Intermediate) – understands veterinary medicinal product development requirements in the US and EU and applies relevant GxP expectations to early-stage work. Qualifications Minimum requirements • Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Protein Science, Immunology, Bioengineering, or a closely related discipline; postdoctoral training strongly preferred. • 12+ years of progressive experience in biotherapeutics discovery and development, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multidisciplinary scientific teams. • Demonstrated track record of advancing biotherapeutic candidates from early discovery through PoC or IND-enabling (or veterinary equivalent) stages. • Deep experience in protein engineering (rational design and directed evolution) and antibody engineering, including species adaptation (humanization, and ideally caninization, felinization), monospecific and multispecific formats, and alternatives to IgG. • Hands-on knowledge of half-life extension technologies (Fc fusion, PEGylation, albumin binding, HLE mutations). • Proficiency with mammalian (CHO, HEK293), microbial (E. coli), and/or yeast (Pichia pastoris) expression systems. • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and international collaborations in a matrix organization. • Strong peer-reviewed publication record and patent portfolio reflecting innovation in protein sciences or biologics. Preferred • Background in structural biology (X-ray crystallography, cryo-EM, or computational structural analysis). • Experience with PK/PD modeling in veterinary species. • Experience with AAV vector development or other gene therapy modalities, including non-viral gene delivery platforms.rior experience in veterinary biologics or the animal health industry will be a real plus • Experience managing sample repositories and biological material traceability systems. Physical Requirements While performing the responsibilities of the position, the employee is required to talk and hear, and to sit and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and laboratory equipment. The employee regularly stands and walks throughout office and laboratory areas and may occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Close vision is required to review data on a monitor and to work in the laboratory. Laboratory work requires the use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). Working Conditions Combined office and laboratory environment at the Ceva Biologics Center. Laboratory areas may involve exposure to biological materials (including recombinant proteins, cell lines, and viral vectors), chemicals, and laboratory equipment, managed under site biosafety and EHS procedures. Close partnership with colleagues in France and other time zones will require periodic early-morning or evening meetings. Travel Required Overnight travel required, including international travel to Ceva R D sites (primarily Libourne, France) and scientific conferences; approximately 10–20%. title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, AI Products & Platform, Ministry of Education
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[About the Team]

The Ministry of Education is building AI products and shared platform capabilities that can improve how students learn, how teachers work, and how HQ teams run complex operational workflows.

The AI Platform & Capability Programme sits at the centre of this work. We build and support AI-native products such as learning assistants, marking tools, procurement agents, multimodal prototypes, and the shared evaluation, observability, model-access, and governance capabilities needed to scale them responsibly.

We are hiring software engineers who can take ambiguous problems from brief to production. This is not a pure research role and not a demo-building role. The work is to build reliable, maintainable, policy-sensitive AI systems that can survive real users, real operational constraints, and public-sector trust requirements.

AI will support how we build. Engineers still own the design, judgement, quality, and consequences of what ships.

How we build

We prefer simple, durable engineering choices over novelty for its own sake. The stack may vary by product, but the principles do not: clear architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, secure-by-design delivery, and systems that are easy to reason about after launch.

The team’s operating model is product-led and platform-amplified. Product squads prove value in real education or HQ workflows; shared platform capabilities make those products observable, testable, governable, and reusable across MOE. Engineers may work inside a product squad, on the shared AI platform, or in a forward-deployed model where they help a vertical team build AI capability before bringing reusable patterns back to the centre

[What you will be working on]

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate AI-enabled products and platform components across MOE.
  • Work on areas such as LLM integration, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, observability, guardrails, model access, retrieval/memory patterns, and multimodal AI use cases.
  • Take ambiguous education or corporate operations problems and turn them into maintainable software with clear success metrics.
  • Build production features for products such as procurement automation, teacher-facing AI tools, learning assistants, and evaluation/monitoring platforms.
  • Create engineering patterns that other product teams can reuse, including templates, playbooks, test harnesses, and reference implementations.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, governance colleagues, and business owners.
  • Use AI coding and development tools to accelerate delivery while retaining human accountability for design and quality.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident response, and technical decision-making.
  • Push for root-cause fixes rather than surface-level patches.

[What we are looking for]

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, testing, version control, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainable code.
  • Good engineering judgement: you can explain trade-offs clearly and defend a technical position without becoming attached to it.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can move from unclear policy, education, or operational needs into a working product shape.
  • Appetite for AI-native engineering: LLM applications, evaluation, agentic workflows, RAG/memory, multimodal models, or AI-assisted development.
  • Pragmatic taste in technology: you choose boring, durable tools when they are right, and newer AI tooling only when it genuinely improves the system.
  • Ownership mindset: you do not stop at prototype handoff; you care about deployment, monitoring, user feedback, and maintainability.
  • Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders in sensitive public-sector domains.
  • Bias for measurable quality: you care about evals, regression checks, traceability, and evidence before scaling.

Nice to have

  • Experience building production LLM or AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks, prompt/context engineering, model monitoring, Langfuse/OpenTelemetry-style tracing, or AI safety guardrails.
  • Experience with Python, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, containerised deployment, cloud services, or government/cloud-restricted environments.
  • Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or reusable engineering kits.
  • Familiarity with education, public-sector operations, procurement, or high-trust digital services.

What success looks like

In the first 6 months, you should have shipped meaningful production work in at least one product or platform area, improved the team’s engineering quality bar, and helped convert one-off AI delivery into reusable capability. The best engineers in this role will not just “build features”; they will help define how MOE builds, evaluates, governs, and scales AI products.

Why this role matters

MOE’s AI work is moving beyond experiments. The next challenge is to make AI useful, safe, measurable, and maintainable across real education and HQ workflows. This role is for engineers who want to build public-good AI systems with national-scale relevance, while shaping the operating model for how product teams use AI responsibly.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description


Data Warehouse Design & Architecture:

  • Work with business users and Data Analysts to gather requirements and turn them into data models.
  • Design and implement highly scalable, performant, and cost-effective data warehouse solutions (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
  • Develop and maintain robust data models (Dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or hybrid approaches) that support complex business analytics.


Data Pipeline Development:

  • Build, orchestrate, and optimize highly reliable ELT/ETL pipelines using tools like Python, SQL, dbt, and Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data pipelines are fault-tolerant, scalable, and fully monitored with automated alerting for data quality issues.
  • Optimise SQL and pipeline design for cost and performance on ETL Job.


Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Creation:

  • Partner with cross-functional business stakeholders to define, standardize, and calculate core business metrics.
  • Develop a robust semantic layer to ensure standardized definitions and metrics are exposed consistently across all downstream tools.
  • Implement rigorous data quality checks and data contracts to build absolute trust in the enterprise data assets.
  • Lead the onboarding of new sources and the migration from legacy systems, using ID mapping, parallel-run reconciliation and controlled cutover to keep downstream consumers stable.


Enterprise Data Agent Development:

  • Design and build "Data Agents" (using LLMs, RAG frameworks, and Text-to-SQL technologies) that act as an intelligent interface over the SSOT and enterprise knowledge bases.
  • Integrate unstructured enterprise metadata (glossaries, wiki pages, process docs) with structured data models to give the Data Agent full business context.
  • Continuously refine prompt engineering, semantic search embeddings, and guardrails to ensure the agent returns accurate, hallucination-free insights.


Job Requirements

  • Core Engineering Experience: 3+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or software engineering.
  • Advanced SQL & Python: Expert-level SQL skills for complex transformations and deep proficiency in Python for pipeline development and API integration.
  • Data Warehousing & Modeling: Proven experience with modern cloud data warehouses and strong practical knowledge of data modeling methodologies (Kimball, OBT, etc.).
  • Transformation & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with dbt (data build tool) for transformation and Airflow/Dagster/Prefect for orchestration.
  • AI & LLM Integration (Bonus/Highly Preferred): Experience with or a strong desire to learn GenAI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus), and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex business logic into scalable data models and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Strong advocate for CI/CD, version control (Git), automated testing, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Domain (Bonus): Retail or e-commerce data such as orders, refunds, promotions, loyalty and GST.
  • AI-assisted engineering (Bonus): Uses AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code) productively, and verifies their output rather than trusting it.

Test industrial protocols such as Modbus/TCP, DNP3, EtherNet/IP/CIP, S7comm, OPC UA, BACnet and IEC 60870-5-104/61850 for authentication, integrity and logic manipulation weaknesses.
