Map findings to ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, with remediation guidance realistic for plant operations. Conduct vulnerability research on binaries, firmware, embedded/IoT devices, web applications and enterprise software using reverse engineering, source code review and fuzzing. Write reliable proof-of-concept and weaponized exploits for memory corruption, logic flaws and authentication bypasses. Deliver client engagements end to end and communicate findings clearly to engineers and executives. 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing and offensive security, including depth in at least two areas: OT/ICS, exploit development/vulnerability research, or AI/LLM security. Demonstrated OT/ICS penetration testing experience on real industrial environments or high-fidelity labs, with strong safety-first testing practices. Showcase of original vulnerability research through CVEs, advisories or exploits, conference talks, or bug bounty/CTF results. Hands-on experience testing LLM applications or agentic AI systems, understanding how models, retrieval, tools and permissions create attack surface.

title: Platform Infrastructure Engineer - Networking
description:
Platform Infrastructure Engineer

GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

We are looking for a network engineer to design, implement, and operate the network infrastructure for our on-premises private cloud platform spanning multiple government data centres. This role involves hands-on delivery of production network services and active participation in establishing and evangelizing SRE practices including observability, incident response, and reliability engineering.

  • Design, implement, and operate spine-leaf network topology with eBGP, ECMP, MLAG, multi-plane VRF architecture, routers, switches, firewalls, DNS, NTP, OpenShift networking (OVN-Kubernetes, ingress, load balancers), DWDM equipment, L3 and L2 EVPN, and telco circuits for inter-site connectivity.
  • Implement network security zones, firewall policies, ACLs, traffic segmentation, design CI/CD processes and out-of-band zones to ensure traceability, accountability, and speed of rollback, and automate network configuration using Ansible, Python, and/or infrastructure-as-code, and integrate with platforms/dashboards.
  • Establish network observability, SLIs, SLOs, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, develop runbooks, and participate in SRE on-call rotation, incident response, and blameless postmortems.

[What we are looking for]

Required Skillsets

  • Education & Experience: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience in a related field.
  • Understanding of spine-leaf topology, eBGP, iBGP, ECMP, MLAG, VRF isolation, routing, switching, VLANs, TCP/IP, DNS architecture, NTP architecture, DHCP, TLS, load balancing, Ansible, Python, Prometheus, syslog, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, operating, and automating data centre networks using infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Understanding design of eBGP configuration including AS-path, route filtering, and multi-path load balancing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues using packet capture, protocol analysis, and BGP debugging tools.
  • CCIE or equivalent industry certification preferred.
  • Understanding of DNS and NTP architecture design.
  • Multi-site or multi-data-centre network design with DNS, WAN routing, and failover.
  • Network performance tuning including MTU optimisation, jumbo frames, and QoS policies.
  • Experience with network observability, monitoring, SLIs, SLOs, alerting, and capacity planning.
  • Experience developing runbooks, participating in SRE on-call rotation, and driving reliability improvements from incident analysis.
  • Experience with AI/ML workload networking including RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU-direct communication, and network tuning for distributed training workloads.
  • Knowledge/Hands-on with DWDM equipment is an advantage.
  • OpenShift, Kubernetes, OVN-Kubernetes, CNI, Ceph storage networking, VXLAN, and EVPN experience is an advantage.
  • Appreciation of data centre cabling and equipment design standards such as ANSI/TIA-568-D and EIA-310-E / IEC 60297-3-100 is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with modern software engineering practices — clean code, code review, testing strategies, and version control discipline — and experience with AI-assisted coding workflows including Spec-Driven Development (SDD), prompt engineering for code generation, and the use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in an engineering context.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Assistant Manager, Data Analytics
description:
This role is responsible for building the analytics framework that enables Eu Yan Sang to gain a clear understanding of business, ecommerce and customer performance, and to turn data into actionable recommendations. Operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong and International Markets, the role partners closely with Ecommerce, Marketing, CRM, Strategy & Planning and other cross-functional teams to establish reporting frameworks, define KPIs and scorecards, analyse ecommerce and customer lifecycle performance, and enable data-driven planning.


The role combines strong hands-on analytical capability with the ability to work independently with stakeholders, translating business objectives into data requirements and communicating insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. As data capabilities mature, the role will also contribute to CDP-driven analytics, including customer segmentation, churn analysis, propensity modelling and customer lifetime value forecasting.


Job Description


Analytics Framework, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Design and maintain regional dashboards, scorecards and reporting frameworks across Ecommerce, CRM, customer engagement and paid media.
  • Establish consistent KPI definitions, measurement methodologies and reporting standards across all markets.
  • Automate recurring reporting and improve the accessibility, accuracy and usability of performance data.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business objectives into measurable KPIs, reporting requirements and success metrics.
  • Drive adoption of dashboards and reporting frameworks by enabling teams to interpret and apply performance data effectively.


Ecommerce & Customer Lifecycle Analytics

  • Analyse ecommerce performance, including traffic, conversion, basket behaviour, revenue and funnel drop-offs, to identify performance drivers and optimisation opportunities.
  • Analyse customer lifecycle performance across acquisition, engagement, retention, reactivation and churn.
  • Conduct cohort, segmentation, purchase frequency, retention, customer lifetime value and behavioural analysis.
  • Support CRM, Marketing and Ecommerce teams in identifying priority customer segments and opportunities for cross-sell, upsell and repeat purchase.
  • Support CRO initiatives through test analysis, performance evaluation and statistical validation.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear business recommendations for market teams and senior stakeholders.


CDP, Data Enablement & Governance

  • Support CDP implementation by defining business requirements, customer attributes, event tracking, data taxonomy and analytical use cases.
  • Work with IT and development partners to ensure required data is available, accurate and fit for reporting and analysis.
  • Identify tracking and data gaps and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
  • Maintain data quality standards, KPI documentation, business rules and analytical methodologies.
  • As capabilities mature, contribute to advanced analytics such as churn modelling, propensity scoring and customer lifetime value forecasting.


Business Partnership & Strategic Analytics

  • Partner with Group and country teams to define business objectives, analytical approaches and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Develop reusable analytical templates and scorecards for Ecommerce, Marketing, CRM, Loyalty and other functions.
  • Provide analytical support for new products, new business opportunities, operational improvements and strategic initiatives.
  • Define baselines, success criteria and measurement approaches before implementation, and assess impact after launch.
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and promote data-driven decision-making across the organisation.


Job Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications such as Google Analytics or Power BI are a plus.
  • 5 - 8 years of experience in a data analyst or business intelligence role, in eCommerce, retail, or consumer brands.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI/Big query; experience with Tableau or Looker is also welcome.
  • Solid SQL skills: comfortable writing and optimising queries across relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, and eCommerce event tracking.
  • Experience building and maintaining reports using CRM or marketing automation platforms
  • Familiar with CDP concepts and data pipeline architecture is a plus.
  • Competence in Python or R for data manipulation is desirable but not essential.
  • Understanding or experience in TCM and wellness is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in English is required; additional language proficiency (e.g., Mandarin) may be beneficial for role-related communication needs
  • Strong analytical rigour: you do not just report numbers but analyses them.
  • Clear communicator: you can explain what the data means to people who do not live in spreadsheets.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven: you care about data quality as much as data insight.
  • Collaborative and curious: you will work across a wide range of teams and platforms.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.


Together, we make the extraordinary happen.


Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.


Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer, DNS & Proxy
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

We are constantly looking for Network Infrastructure Engineers with broad and deep technical expertise across multiple domains, best practices and technologies. You will help to execute new initiatives and enhancements that result in innovative use of your domain technology knowledge to meet the needs of forward-looking Public Service agencies.

  • Operate and continuously improve production DNS, DNSSEC, protective DNS and secure web proxy services as an in-house capability.
  • Perform hands-on troubleshooting, incident response, change implementation, lifecycle management, backup, recovery and root-cause analysis.
  • Engineer DNS zones, records, delegations, forwarding, caching, split-horizon DNS, access controls, DNSSEC signing and proxy policies.
  • Build and maintain automation scripts, playbooks, pipelines and reusable modules using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs or equivalent tools.
  • Codify infrastructure, configurations and policies using Infrastructure as Code, configuration-as-code, Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Analyse DNS queries, proxy logs and threat intelligence to detect malicious domains, tunnelling, command-and-control traffic and policy violations.
  • Integrate DNS and proxy services with identity, firewall, cloud, monitoring, SIEM, ITSM and threat-intelligence platforms.
  • Explore practical network AI and AIOps use cases for anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive analysis, troubleshooting and governed remediation.
  • Work with vendors and partners where required while retaining internal technical ownership, operational control and accountability for production outcomes.

[What we are looking for]

  • At least five years of relevant experience in enterprise network, infrastructure or security engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for production DNS and proxy services.
  • Deep knowledge of authoritative and recursive DNS, zone delegation, record lifecycle management, forwarding, caching, split-horizon DNS, DNSSEC, encrypted DNS and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise DDI platforms covering DNS, DHCP and IP address management; experience with Infoblox, Bluecoat or an equivalent platform is advantageous.
  • Strong experience operating enterprise proxy or secure web gateway platforms, including access controls, URL filtering, authentication, TLS inspection, certificate management, bypass policies and log analysis.
  • Sound knowledge of protective DNS, response policy zones, domain reputation, DNS logging, query analytics and DNS-based threat detection.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancing, Anycast and common application traffic flows.
  • Proficiency in Python or PowerShell, REST APIs and automation tools such as Ansible or Terraform, with practical exposure to Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration management.
  • Experience with monitoring, telemetry, observability, log analytics, SIEM or event-correlation platforms, and the ability to turn operational data into action.
  • An interest in AI-enabled network operations, with the discipline to validate recommendations, protect operational data and retain appropriate human oversight over production changes.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the confidence to work through ambiguity and resolve difficult multi-layer or multi-vendor problems.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, technical documentation, stakeholder-engagement and vendor-management skills.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech
